scripts.text: All first-time visitors to Eclage must fill out the necessary forms here before entering.
scripts.translation: 首次到访埃克拉珠的访客，都必须在这里填写相关表格才能入城。

scripts.text: Please understand because of a recent increase in the influx of people from Midgard through Bifrost, we had to create this process.
scripts.translation: 最近经由彩虹桥从米德加尔特前来的人越来越多，我们才不得不设立这套手续，还请谅解。

scripts.text: Of course, the documents will be secured away after their use in access regulations, so you don't have to worry.
scripts.translation: 当然，表格用于入城管理后会妥善收存，请不必担心。

scripts.text: Please note that you would not be able to enter the city without filling out the forms.
scripts.translation: 请注意，不填写表格就无法进入城市。

scripts.text: Please fill out your name, occupation, and level here.
scripts.translation: 请在这里填写您的姓名、职业和等级。

scripts.text: If you completed your forms, please submit them to the administrator over there.
scripts.translation: 如果表格已经填好，请交给那边的管

scripts.text: There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
Please submit your forms to the administrator over there after writing in your name, occupation, and level.
scripts.translation: 请填写姓名、职业和等级，然后把表格交给那边的管理员。可能需要等一会儿，请耐心等待。

scripts.text: There may be some waiting time, so take your time.
Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠受到彩虹桥的影响，各个种族之间可以顺畅交流。

scripts.text: There would be no need for any separate translation, and there are enough bridges for on-foot races, so I hope you have a comfortable visit.
scripts.translation: 因此不需要另外安排翻译，而且这里也有足够的桥梁供步行的种族通行。祝您在此访问愉快。

scripts.text: Welcome to Eclage, the capital of the Laphines.
Since Eclage is under the influence of Bifrost, there is fluent communication among the races.

scripts.text: As you can see, I'm really busy here, so unless you need something, please don't bother me.
scripts.translation: 您也看到了，我忙得不可开交。没什么事的话，请别来打扰我。

scripts.text: There's still a lot of people before you. Could you please wait until your turn?
scripts.translation: 您前面还有不少人，请等轮到您再过来。不

There are just too many visitors.
So if you will place your forms here...
scripts.translation: 那么，请把表格放在这里...

scripts.text: Here!! These are my completed forms!!
scripts.translation: 在这里！！这是我填好的表格

scripts.text: This time it's all good, right?
I'm taking care of visitors in the order they arrived, so please wait for your turn.
scripts.translation: 我会按来访者抵达的先后顺序办理，请耐心等候。

scripts.text: I was waaaay before all of these guys!
scripts.translation: 可比他们早到老半天了！

scripts.text: Well, your turn was delayed because you had to fill out your forms, so you have to wait until later.
scripts.translation: 可是您得先填写表格，所以轮到您的时间往后延了，只能再等等。

scripts.text: What?! You just said you take care of visitors in the order they arrived!!!
scripts.translation: 什么？！你刚才明明说按抵达顺序办理的！！！

scripts.text: Yes, I did say that but...
OW!! Why did you hit me?
My stupid friend here is causing trouble.
scripts.translation: 我这个笨蛋朋友又在给您添麻烦了。

scripts.text: If you hadn't filled out my name incorrectly in the first place, we wouldn't be waiting like this!
scripts.translation: 要不是你一开始把我的名字填错，我们哪用在这儿等这么久！

scripts.text: Mark Esha or Madrid, they're all the same!
scripts.translation: 马克·艾沙也好，马德里也好，不都差不多嘛！

scripts.text: They're not at all the same!
And what's more, how can you not know the name of your friend of 15 years?
scripts.translation: ，你怎么会连认识了十五年的朋友叫什么都不知道？

scripts.text: It's not that I didn't know- I did it on purpose!!
scripts.translation: 我不是不知道——我就是故意的！！马

scripts.text: Hu... I am so sorry that my friend is this stupid.
scripts.translation: 呜...真抱歉，我这朋友实在太蠢

scripts.text: Please don't mind us and do what you need to do.
scripts.translation: 了。请别介意我们，您忙您的吧。

scripts.text: How long do I have to wait out here!!!
scripts.translation: 去！！！！我还要在外面等多久啊！！！

scripts.text: Would you stay put just for a second?!!!
scripts.translation: 你就不能安分一会儿吗？！！！抱

scripts.text: Oh wow, this is just so crazy.

And Mr. Deu Lean, please take your group and enter. It's just way too noisy.
scripts.translation: 杜连先生，也请带上您的同伴进城吧。这里吵得实在受不了了。

scripts.text: Thanks to me, we got through faster!
scripts.translation: 吧？！多亏了我，我们才能这么快通过！

scripts.text: A real man does not get bogged down by the past!!
scripts.translation: 真正的男子汉才不会纠结过去！！

scripts.text: I may have been slow with the documentation but I will be the one to enter Eclage first!
scripts.translation: 办手续时我虽然慢了点，但我可是第一个进埃克拉珠的人！哇哈

scripts.text: Mr. Mark, Mr. Du is already gone.
Oh wow, this is just so crazy.
You may enter the city when you go talk to the security guard.
Alright, next person in line please!
scripts.translation: 好了，下一位请上前！下一位

scripts.text: I don't think it's all for the best to have so many visitors.
scripts.translation: ..访客这么多，看来也不全是好事。

scripts.text: I can't believe I have to wait this long......
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信要等这么久...到

scripts.text: When is it going to be my turn?
I'm actually done with my documentation, but I'm just sticking around to appreciate all of these flowers.
scripts.translation: 我的手续其实已经办好了，只是想留下来欣赏这些花。

scripts.text: I'm just getting through the night with my sleeping bag!
scripts.translation: 我带了睡袋，干脆就在这里过

scripts.text: It's alright as long as you can withstand the security guard's annoyance with you.
scripts.translation: 夜！只要受得了保安的白眼，倒也没什么。

scripts.text: I wonder how beautiful of a city Eclage would be.
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠到底是座多么美丽的城市

scripts.text: It just makes my heart beat thinking about it.
scripts.translation: 呢？光是想想就让我心跳加速。

scripts.text: No, I'm not a visitor. I'm an Eclage citizen!
scripts.translation: 不，我不是游客。我是埃克拉珠的居民！

scripts.text: I can't believe I can't even enter because of all these tourists!
scripts.translation: 真不敢相信游客这么多，害得我连家都进不去！

scripts.text: I hear their acorns are delicious without a hint of bitterness.
scripts.translation: 听说那里的橡果很好吃，一点苦味都没有。

scripts.text: You could probably make the world's best acorn jello.
scripts.translation: 说不定能做出全世界最好吃的橡果凉粉。

scripts.text: It's important to keep your belongings light when traveling.
scripts.translation: 旅行时，行李还是轻便些好。

scripts.text: It's going to increase as you go along anyways.
scripts.translation: 反正走得越远，行李只会越变越多。

scripts.text: Perhaps you could consider it as the weight of life?
scripts.translation: 或许可以把它当成人生的重量吧？

scripts.text: Oh! Are you also from Midgard?
scripts.translation: 哦！你也是从米德加尔特来的吗？

scripts.text: It's encouraging to see so many Midgard people nowadays.
scripts.translation: 最近能看到这么多米德加尔特人，真让人振奋。

scripts.text: You're saying I have to wait after all this traveling through Bifrost?!
scripts.translation: 的腿...一路穿过彩虹桥来到这里，居然还得继续等？！

scripts.text: Why are there so many people...?

scripts.translation: 我只想一个人待着...（抽泣）

scripts.text: - The bridge is broken. There should be some kind of a solution. -
scripts.translation: - 桥断了，应该有办法可以修好。 -

scripts.text: Did you talk to the security guard before coming into the city?
scripts.translation: 进城前你有和保安谈过吗？

scripts.text: The bridge is kind of broken so please be careful.
This area is kind of broken, so be careful.
scripts.translation: 这附近有些地方坏了，小心

scripts.text: Otherwise, you'll fall aaaaaall the way down.
scripts.translation: 点。不然会一路摔到底的。

scripts.text: The work being done right now
The reason for the bridge being broken

scripts.translation: 如你所见，我正在做木工。最

scripts.text: There are more visitors to Eclage nowadays, so I'm primarily working on building bridges.
scripts.translation: 近来埃克拉珠的访客多了起来，所以我主要负责修建桥梁。

scripts.text: In fact, Laphines can fly around so bridges are technically not necessary, but we are building them since there are many visitors who have been getting hurt by falling while climbing trees.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族会飞，所以严格来说并不需要桥。不过，许多访客爬树时会摔伤，我们才修建这些桥。

scripts.text: Oh, just a minute ago, there was a human being who took a misstep and broke a tree branch while falling.
scripts.translation: 哦，就在刚才，有个人类一脚踩空，摔下来时撞断了一根树枝。

scripts.text: Being close to the entrance and all, this really needs to be fixed soon.
scripts.translation: 这里离入口很近，得尽快修好。

scripts.text: I'm trying to decide whether I should put up a warning sign, gather the necessary materials for repair, or call a friend to help.
scripts.translation: 我正琢磨着该立警告牌、收集维修材料，还是叫朋友来帮忙。

scripts.text: You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
scripts.translation: 修好之前你没法从这里

scripts.text: You are going to help me?!
I can't believe there's still this kind of kindness left in the world... Hmm, sweaty eyes...
scripts.translation: 真没想到，这世上还有这么善良的人...呜，我都感动得眼眶湿了...

scripts.text: Would you then bring me a new bridge to use for repair?
scripts.translation: 那能麻烦你带一段新的桥材来吗

scripts.text: Since other people can get hurt, I'll use my magic to maintain this bridge in the meantime.
scripts.translation: ？为了不让其他人受伤，我会先用魔法稳住这座桥。

scripts.text: You can't get past here until it's repaired, so please be careful.
What if you use magic to repair it?
Hmm, it's not impossible, but magic that deals with creation of life requires much magic power and shouldn't be used so freely.
scripts.translation: 嗯，也不是办不到。不过，创造生命的魔法需要消耗大量魔力，不能随便使用。

scripts.text: If I were to describe how stupid that would be... Well, it's like turning a deliciously baked chocolate cake back into flour.
scripts.translation: 要说这有多蠢...就像把烤好的巧克力蛋糕重新变回面粉。

scripts.text: Since the broken part is about 19 meters from here...
scripts.translation: 断掉的地方离这里大约有19米...

scripts.text: Ahh! Now that I remember, before we used to be able to order the exact necessary length, but because they are mass-producing them nowadays, they only provide preset lengths.
scripts.translation: 啊！我想起来了，以前可以按需要订做特定长度的桥材。不过现在都改成批量生产，只能买到固定长度的了。

scripts.text: To maximize the stability, it's better to avoid connecting multiple bridge pieces together,
scripts.translation: 为了让桥尽可能稳固，最好不要把多段桥材拼接起来。

scripts.text: and this broken bridge... from here to there it's about 19 meters and the prepieces come in 3 meters = 5 meters, and 10 meters......
scripts.translation: 这座断桥从这里到那边大约有19米，而预制桥材有3米、5米和10米三种长度...

scripts.text: - It's probably just my imagination that smoke is coming out of his head, right? -
scripts.translation: - 他头上好像在冒烟？大概是我看错了吧。 -

scripts.text: To make a bridge of 19 meters in length with the fewest number of pieces possible, how many of each 3, 5, or 10 meter length pieces would I need?
scripts.translation: 要用最少的桥材搭出一座19米长的桥，3米、5米和10米的桥材各要几段？

scripts.text: Please write the number of pieces necessary for each length. If no pieces for that length are necessary, please write 0.
scripts.translation: 请填写每种长度所需的桥材段数。不需要的长度请填0。

scripts.text: Would there be a better way?
Especially since there wouldn't be a need to make them so straight.
scripts.translation: ？这样也不用把桥材削得那么笔直了。

scripts.text: Okay, if you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.
scripts.translation: 好，去找在城外高塔附近工作的戈利。他会给你新的桥材。

scripts.text: If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.

scripts.text: If you talk to [Golie] who works outside the city near the tower, he will give you the new bridge pieces.

scripts.text: Oh man, he's still worried about that kind of thing.
scripts.translation: 哎，他居然还在操心那种事。

scripts.text: He's too serious for no reason.
Whoa! This isn't the time to be doing this. I should repair the bridge quickly and help out all the people who fell through.
scripts.translation: 糟了！现在可不是做这个的时候。我得赶快把桥修好，去帮那些掉下去的人。

scripts.text: I would have been toast if it weren't for that tree branch.
scripts.translation: 要不是那根树枝接住了我，我可就完蛋了。

scripts.text: I told you to be careful!
Exactly how much trouble do you want to cause?
I thought I got rid of them, but it looks like they aren't going to be that easy.
scripts.translation: 喂！我还以为已经甩掉他们了，看来没那么容易啊。

scripts.text: We just have not been our best ever since we met.
scripts.translation: 自从遇见我们以后，你就一直没遇上什么好事。

scripts.text: Well, I'm going to let it pass this time around, but if you break the bridge again, I'm going to put you in jail!
scripts.translation: 这次就算了。要是你们再把桥弄断，我就把你们关起来！我

scripts.text: You should know that I am pretty busy myself.
I'll take special caution, so please don't worry.
But for a bridge to break so easily after running a bit, isn't it just too weak?
scripts.translation: 不过，跑了几步桥就断了，也太不结实了吧？这样一来，巨人

scripts.text: Giants couldn't even visit Eclage in this wa...
scripts.translation: 岂不是根本没法来埃克拉珠了...

scripts.text: Wait! No, it's really a mistake this time!
Even this warning sign tells you that you have to grab onto the hand rails since the bridge is so dangerous.
scripts.translation: 意的！你看！警告牌上都写着桥很危险，要抓紧扶手。

scripts.text: All I did was just place my hand on it!
scripts.translation: 我只是把手搭上去而已！

scripts.text: Get out of here you troublemaker!!!!
I will come by to help out later even if it's by tying this guy up to a pole.
scripts.translation: 。我晚些会来帮忙，哪怕得先把这家伙绑在柱子上。

scripts.text: I thought today I might be able to see my friends after finishing up my work.....
scripts.translation: .我还以为今天忙完就能去见朋友...看来

scripts.text: Looks like a long night again.
Since it's not a big fix, I'm sure I can take care of this somehow.
scripts.translation: 这不是什么大工程，我想办法应该能修好。唉.

scripts.text: {0} Well, you should get going to Eclage.
You just need to follow this path to the northern part of the city.
scripts.translation: 拉珠了。沿着这条路往前走，就能到城北。

scripts.text: You'll find the main plaza as soon as you enter Eclage, and I'm sure you'll have easy time getting information from all the people there.
scripts.translation: 进城后就是中央广场，那里的人应该能告诉你不少消息。

scripts.text: And on your way, do you mind letting my friend Glasses that I won't make it today?
scripts.translation: 顺路帮我转告朋友格拉西斯一声，就说我今天去不了了，可以吗？

scripts.text: I need to start repairing soon...
I really ask you this favor because I'm supposed to meet with my friends to discuss a birthday coming up, but I can't just keep them waiting.
scripts.translation: 我本来约好和朋友们见面，商量即将到来的生日，可眼下实在走不开。真要拜托你帮忙了，不能让他们一直等。

scripts.text: I wanna see my friends real soon.
scripts.translation: 真想早点见到朋友们啊。

scripts.text: - There are just too many types that -
They say that life is nature's greatest invention and death is just a scheme to obtain more life.
scripts.translation: 常有人说，生命是大自然最伟大的发明，而死亡不过是孕育更多生命的一种安排。

scripts.text: However, how about these sprouts that were born by magic- do they have life or not?
scripts.translation: 不过，这些由魔法催生的嫩芽究竟算不算有生命？魔

scripts.text: Would a bridge born by magic be considered dead or not?
scripts.translation: 法造出的桥，究竟算死物还是活物？

scripts.text: Because I spend so much time nurturing a bridge from a seed, it hurts me to see so many getting broken and replaced.
scripts.translation: 我花了那么多心血，从种子开始培育这些桥。看到它们一再损坏、被替换，实在令人心痛。

scripts.text: Would this be how the times are changing...? That must be why I am creating these objects of tragic destinies.
scripts.translation: 这就是时代变迁吗...？也许我创造的这些东西，注定要承受这样的命运。

scripts.text: This seed is named [Goliath] after my name, and it's a plant used as a bridge for its strange ability to grow into two stems and one leaf.
scripts.translation: 这颗种子以我的名字命名为“戈利亚斯”。它会长出两根茎和一片叶子，形状奇特，因此被用作桥梁。

scripts.text: Thanks to Goliath, the dire need for bridges has been resolved, but I cannot shake the concern that one day, there are going to be fearsome consequences for utilizing magic to ignore the rules of nature.
scripts.translation: 多亏了戈利亚斯，桥梁短缺的问题总算解决了。但我仍担心，有一天，滥用魔法、违背自然法则会酿成可怕后果。

scripts.text: I am recently finding encouragement bit by bit as I work with the great Fili who stands next to me here, but one day, I assure you that all of this will be fixed.
scripts.translation: 最近我和身旁这位了不起的菲利一起工作，渐渐又有了干劲。不过我向你保证，总有一天这一切都会得到解决。

scripts.text: Whenever you are disheartened and discouraged, try approaching Fili with your concerns. You will probably find new insights.
scripts.translation: 若你感到灰心沮丧，不妨找菲利谈谈，也许会有新的收获。还有...

scripts.text: And... Mm... the bridge was done while we were just jibber-jabbering.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我们聊着聊着，桥已经修好了。

scripts.text: Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation: 好了，现在可以把这个交给丰了。还有，虽然知道最近

scripts.text: Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.
scripts.translation: 最近我一直忙着帮菲利做事，不过桥梁似乎也坏得太频繁了。

scripts.text: I will give you another since you are busy, but please take care.
scripts.translation: 看你这么忙，我再给你一份，不过这次可要收好了。

scripts.text: Alright, you may now deliver this to Fon. Also, while I know that it is difficult in these busy times, would you also tell him that I said, 'please take more precious care of them?'
scripts.translation: 大家都很忙，能不能顺便替我转告他：请好好珍惜它们？

scripts.text: Surely, I am busy nowadays helping with Fili's work but it also seems that the bridges are breaking too often.

长老树精要生长，从春天起，
大嘴鸟便开始如此啼鸣。

scripts.text: the alarm in the clock tower
again must have cried as such.

scripts.translation: 真是的，你怎么一点都不累..

scripts.text: Ok, I'm going to rest here with the others, so do what you need to do.
scripts.translation: .好吧，我和大家在这里休息，你去忙你的吧。

scripts.text: I thought you said you'll bring a whole bunch of acorns~~
scripts.translation: ！！！你不是说要带一大堆回来吗~~

scripts.text: Whoa, what a delicious looking acorn!
scripts.translation: 哇，看起来好好吃的橡果！

scripts.text: You have to eat a lot when you're young. That's how you'll grow!
scripts.translation: 多吃点。小孩子就该多吃，才能长高长壮！

scripts.text: Hey Oliver, don't suddenly be so lazy now...
scripts.translation: 喂，奥利弗，别突然就懒洋洋的...

scripts.text: I thought this was all a dream, but I guess it's not seeing how sleepy I am.
scripts.translation: 我还以为刚才是在做梦，不过困成这样，看来不是梦。

scripts.text: I'm going to take a nap, so wake me up when we're leaving... Don't leave without me now~
scripts.translation: ...我要睡一会儿，出发时记得叫醒我...别丢下我先走哦～

scripts.text: I'll mail it safely, so you won't have to worry about it.
scripts.translation: 吗？我会妥善寄送，请放心。

scripts.text: The road from Splendide to Eclage used to be dangerous, but nowadays, it's actually better to come all the way to Eclage.
scripts.translation: 以前从辉煌领域到埃克拉珠的路很危险，不过现在直接送到埃克拉珠反而更方便。

scripts.text: I don't know why people can't just make small amounts of pickled Poring for themselves instead of mailing them...
scripts.translation: 大家为什么不自己腌一点波利，非要寄过来呢...

scripts.text: I need to get going in order to make it on time.
Is it actually better to deliver it later...
I remember seeing so many boxes of pickled Poring in the storage waiting to be delivered...
scripts.translation: 我记得仓库里堆了好多箱腌波利，都还等着寄出去呢...

scripts.text: - The weight is just too much that -
I didn't sense any use of magic or other things of the sort...
scripts.translation: 我没感觉到有使用魔法之类的迹象...

scripts.text: Wait! Here's the hood that Oliver was wearing...
scripts.translation: 等等！这是奥利弗戴过的兜帽...

scripts.text: And... doesn't it feel like this room is different from before?
scripts.translation: 而且...你们不觉得这个房间跟刚才不一样了吗？

scripts.text: .........is also known as the dreaming novelist...
scripts.translation: 佩特......也就是那位“梦境小说家”...

scripts.text: Why didn't I remember this book when Oliver was around?
scripts.translation: ..奥利弗在的时候，我怎么没想起这本书？

scripts.text: Did you just take that book out from your bag?
scripts.translation: ..你刚才是从包里拿出那本书的吗？

scripts.text: Yeah, that's because I'm a fan...
Why didn't you remember the book when you are such a fan..?
scripts.translation: 既然是粉丝，怎么之前没想起这本

scripts.text: Not only that, do people usually carry books with them when they're fans?? Especially hardcover books?
scripts.translation: 书？再说，粉丝会随身带着书吗？还是这么厚的精装书？

scripts.text: You are a little bit weir...
More importantly... The title of this book...
scripts.translation: 先不说这个...这本书的书名是..

scripts.text: It's been many years since this book was published...
But this is Volume 1. Does that mean there's more?
scripts.translation: 但这是第一卷。难道还有后续？

scripts.text: It has a total of 3 volumes.
Wow, how many are you carrying with you...
Why are you bringing all of them around...
scripts.translation: 嘛把它们全都随身带着...

scripts.text: This has to be some kind of a dream!
Why are you hitting me, calling it a dream and all!
scripts.translation: 你说这是梦还打我干嘛！好痛

scripts.text: Ahhhh maybe it really isn't a dream after all!!!
scripts.translation: 啊啊啊，看来真的不是梦！！！

scripts.text: I... I should have.. I should have gotten his autograph!!!
scripts.translation: 我...我应该...应该找他签名才对！！！

scripts.text: - You cannot carry any more items. -
Ah... Is there anyone with more experience with this...
scripts.translation: 唉...有没有人在这方面更有经验呢...

scripts.text: I haven't seen your face before... You aren't from around here?
scripts.translation: 我没见过你...你不是本地人吧？

scripts.text: If you are a person who has enough courage and wisdom to go to a foreign land all alone, I'm sure you have a lot of experience as well.
scripts.translation: 你有胆识和智慧，能独自去异国闯荡，想必也有丰富的阅历。

scripts.text: I would like to learn the name of a great adventurer like you, so that I can talk about you elsewhere.
scripts.translation: 我想知道你这位大冒险家的名字，这样也能向别人聊起你的事迹。

scripts.text: Wow! The name sure sounds like it has defeated many in the mountains, seas, and skies! It's amazing!
scripts.translation: 哇！一听这名字，就知道你在山川海空间击败过不少强敌！太厉害了！

scripts.text: I am not really all that great.
Um... {0} I ask because you look so dependable.
scripts.translation: 那个……{0}，我看你很可靠，才想冒昧拜托你。

scripts.text: Could I please ask you a favor?
scripts.translation: 问一句。能不能请你帮个忙？

scripts.text: I'm kind of busy right now...
For me, I have a ^0000cd big brother^000000.
My brother is... not an extremely well-known scholar.
Although his fame lost a bit of flare these recent years because he was stuck at home getting too fond of housework.
scripts.translation: 名的学者。这几年他总待在家里忙家务，名气也淡了不少。

scripts.text: It's been long since the last time I saw his face because I was all over the place for a while.
scripts.translation: 之前我到处奔波，已经很久没见过他了。

scripts.text: I don't mean to brag, but I am also a distinguished intellectual myself, so I'm sought after by many, haha.
scripts.translation: 我不是自夸，我自己也是个出色的学者，所以总有人来找我，哈哈。

scripts.text: Anyways, we wrote letters to each other regularly, but with a sudden drop in contact, I hurriedly came to see him to find out that ^0000cdhe was taken to jail^000000.
scripts.translation: 我们一直定期通信，可后来联系突然中断了。我急忙去找他，才发现他被关进了监狱。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: They said something about his research but I don't know the details myself. I would like to find out more, but I am not in a situation to make my way there.
scripts.translation: 他们只说和他的研究有关，具体情况我也不清楚。我想打听更多，可眼下没法亲自过去。

scripts.text: {0} would you mind ^0000cdvisiting my big brother in my place^000000 to find out what's going on and let me know?
scripts.translation: {0}，能不能替我^0000cd探望哥哥^000000，查清楚发生了什么再告诉我？

scripts.text: I would like to help you but...
I would really lke to help you, but...
Yeah, I would like to help, but...
I can't really express my desire to help any other way...
scripts.translation: 我也不知道该怎么表达我想帮忙的心情...

scripts.text: But, I'm really sorry. I can't.
Oh, no, no. I am sure you are really busy. I'm sorry to have asked such a favor.
scripts.translation: 没关系，我知道你一定很忙。抱歉还拜托你做这种事。

scripts.text: Sure. It's not a big deal.
It seems that a person with so much experience like you has a wonderful heart as well.
scripts.translation: 你了。像你这样经验丰富的人，心地也这么好。

scripts.text: I was just wondering how things are coming along.
scripts.translation: 我只是想问问事情进展得怎么样了。
没什么...事情还没有进展...

scripts.text: I can't do anything in my own strength... Nothing at all...
scripts.translation: 光靠我自己什么也做不了...真的什么都做不了...

scripts.text: I just couldn't pass by without doing something about it.
scripts.translation: 我只是觉得不能袖手旁观。

scripts.text: Does that mean you would meet up with my brother?
scripts.translation: 你愿意去见我哥哥吗？太感

scripts.text: The prison is inside the palace, but to find it, it might be a bit difficult.
scripts.translation: 监狱就在宫殿里，不过可能不太好找。

scripts.text: By the way, my brother ^0000cddoesn't talk very well to strangers.^000000
scripts.translation: 对了，我哥哥不太会和陌生人交谈 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He's typically very shy and introverted.
So you might have to be a bit patient with him. Please give this ^0000cdletter^000000 to him.
scripts.translation: 跟他谈话时请多点耐心。麻烦把这封信交给他。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Well, you must have a long way to go, so please be on your way.
scripts.translation: 你还得赶很远的路，快出发吧。

scripts.text: Have you met my brother yet?
Um... {0} It looks like what you have in your coat is my letter...?
scripts.translation: 那个……{0}，你衣服里露出来的好像是我的信？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll write you another one {0}. Compared to the trouble you have to go through, this is not a problem at all.
scripts.translation: 当然，我再给你写一封，{0}。比起你要费的工夫，这点事不算什么。

scripts.text: I know I'm the one asking a favor, but could you please hurry?
scripts.translation: 虽然是我拜托你的，但还是想请你尽快一些。

scripts.text: I am really concerned about him.
Oh, {0} Have you met my brother yet? How is he doing?
scripts.translation: 哦，{0}，你见过我哥哥了吗？他还好吗？

scripts.text: Your brother seems to be doing well.
Compared to how he was when I first met him, he surprisingly had... lots to say...
scripts.translation: 和我第一次见到他时相比，他居然...说了好多话。

scripts.text: Yeah... He's pretty talkative, isn't he?
scripts.translation: 是啊...他确实挺健谈的，对吧？
- 乌哈里听说了乌胡鲁的事 -

scripts.text: Why did he do such a thing...
Well, I guess he always had a negative self-image of his physical self.
scripts.translation: 他一直对自己的体格很自卑。他觉得只

scripts.text: He thought that he would be able to do anything if he was big and beautiful.
scripts.translation: 要自己长得高大又好看，就什么都能办到。

scripts.text: No, I don't have any complaints at all.
He always told me that since we are disadvantaged physically, we need to at least be smart and taught me very diligently.
scripts.translation: 他总说我们身体条件不如别人，至少要靠头脑取胜，还很用心地教我。

scripts.text: For that, I am now able to support myself well, and my relationship with him is really strong.
scripts.translation: 多亏了他，我现在能照顾好自己，和他的感情也一直很好。

scripts.text: And since my physique is so small, many people adore me even when I age.
scripts.translation: 而且我个子小，年纪再大也有不少人喜欢我。

scripts.text: Thanks to that, many gave us lots of good things to eat, heh heh.
scripts.translation: 所以有很多人送我们好吃的，呵呵。

scripts.text: Your brother asked me to figure out a way for him to recover his body.
scripts.translation: 你弟弟请我想办法帮他恢复原来的身体。

scripts.text: Yes, that's not even a question. We need to not only recover his body but also rescue him from imprisonment.
scripts.translation: 那是当然的。我们不只要帮他恢复身体，还得把他从监狱里救出来。

scripts.text: With regards to that, I actually have another ^0000cdfavor^000000 to ask.
scripts.translation: 说到这件事，我还想再拜托你一件事：帮个忙。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Yes, of course, you would be very busy. I am grateful for even letting me know about my brother.
scripts.translation: 当然，我知道你很忙。你愿意把我弟弟的消息带来，我已经很感激了。

scripts.text: Oh man, even the people we found are so apathetic... What could I possibly do now...?
scripts.translation: 唉，连找到的人都这么冷淡...我现在还能怎么办呢？

scripts.text: Oh dear~ Is there anyone who can help~~ This world is so ruthless~
scripts.translation: 哎呀~有人能帮帮我吗~~这世道真是冷酷无情啊~

scripts.text: Are you doing this because I look so sad?
scripts.translation: 我？是看我这么难过才答应的吗？

scripts.text: Whatever it is, I thank you so much!
scripts.translation: 不管怎样，真的太感谢你了！

scripts.text: First, if we were to figure out how to recover his body, we have to know exactly what happened at that moment.
scripts.translation: 首先，要想找到恢复他身体的方法，就必须弄清楚当时究竟发生了什么。

scripts.text: It would be helpful to know on what basis he carried out his research. But, I don't really know despite listening to his story.
scripts.translation: 要是能知道他当初依据什么进行研究就好了。可听完他的说法，我还是不太明白。

scripts.text: It looks like we don't have ways to figure that out right now. To explore it on my own, it just seems too difficult...
scripts.translation: 看来现在没办法查清楚。要我一个人调查，实在太难了...

scripts.text: It is probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople who may be familiar with what happened then^000000.
scripts.translation: 最好去问问可能了解当时情况的人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Please, I ask you. In the meantime, I'll carefully think about what my brother has said.
scripts.translation: 拜托你了。我会趁这段时间仔细想想哥哥说过的话。

scripts.text: I see... I ask you, please take care of it.
scripts.translation: 我知道了...这件事就拜托你了。

scripts.text: What happened? Did you find out anything?
They told me to give this to you.
scripts.translation: 他们让我把这个交给你

scripts.text: This is... ^0000cda research report^000000. My brother, he must have seen this and...
scripts.translation: 这是...一份研究报告。弟弟一定是看了这个，才... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But hmm... this is... Were there any other reports?
scripts.translation: 不过，嗯...这是...还有别的报告吗？

scripts.text: No, that was the only one I was given.
scripts.translation: 没有，他们只交给我这一份。

scripts.text: Well, I'll have to analyze this in more depth. I would need some ^0000cdtime^000000.
scripts.translation: .看来我得仔细研究一番，需要一些时间。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Umm... What is it that you brought?
I must have dropped it on the way here.
scripts.translation: 我一定是来的路上把它弄丢了。

scripts.text: I'm still in the process of looking through the report. It's very complex, so I'll need more time.
scripts.translation: 我还在看这份报告。内容很复杂，还得再花些时间。

scripts.text: Great, you got here at the right time.
scripts.translation: 太好了，你来得正是时候。

scripts.text: I looked into this report, but I still don't really understand what it is telling.
scripts.translation: 我看过这份报告，还是不太明白它的内容。

scripts.text: The ingredients are written here but they were difficult to gather and the application methods are a bit hard to understand...
scripts.translation: 上面列了所需材料，可材料很难收集，使用方法也不容易看懂...

scripts.text: Why would they use a piece of a high-level Laphine's wings and hair from a Sapha?
scripts.translation: 为什么要用高阶拉菲尼的翅膀碎片和萨法的毛发？

scripts.text: It's not only difficult to obtain them, but the ways you would have to obtain them are brutal...
scripts.translation: 这些材料不但难找，取得它们的手段也很残酷...

scripts.text: What do you mean exactly by that?
His body was bigger and glowing blue like a Sapha, and his wings were much bigger than that of a normal Laphine.
scripts.translation: 他的体型变得更大，像萨法一样泛着蓝光，翅膀也比普通拉菲尼大得多。

scripts.text: I wonder if it's ^0000cda method to merge the unique characteristics of both races^000000...
scripts.translation: 这会不会是把两个种族的独特特征融合起来的方法... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: But even for his own experiments, my brother would have needed someone's wing and someone's hair... Would he really...
scripts.translation: 可是就算是哥哥自己的实验，也得用到别人的翅膀和毛发...他真的会...

scripts.text: According to your brother, he received the ingredients from a high-level Laphine.
scripts.translation: 听你哥哥说，这些材料是高阶拉菲尼给他的。

scripts.text: The more I look at it, the stranger it gets... To think of this in the first place...
scripts.translation: 越看越觉得可疑...竟然一开始就有人想到这种研究...

scripts.text: Regardless, to figure out a way to recover my brother's body, I would have to study this.
scripts.translation: 不管怎样，为了找到让哥哥恢复原状的方法，我得研究这份报告。真

scripts.text: I wish the instructions were more detailed.
scripts.translation: 希望上面的说明能写得更详细些。

scripts.text: Then should I go and ask your brother again?
That's probably no use. My brother also must have used these instructions to experiment, but he must have become that way because he failed.
scripts.translation: 恐怕没用。哥哥也是照着这份说明做实验的，他会变成那样，想必就是实验失败了。

scripts.text: To understand these instructions accurately, we have to ^0000cdfind the Laphine who provided this report^000000.
scripts.translation: 要弄懂这些说明，我们必须找到提供报告的那位拉菲尼。 ^0000cd^000000
这听起来也太不靠谱了

scripts.text: Shall I look for that Laphine?
Yes. I know. That's why {0} I asked you to help.
scripts.translation: 是啊，我知道。所以才请你帮忙， {0}

scripts.text: {0} You have much experience and have the necessary skills.
But I guess it's still too much.
scripts.translation: 不过，这要求还是太过分了吧。

scripts.text: Wow, your veteran sensibilities are truly amazing.
In any case, thanks so much!
It looks like I'll have to depend on you again! Thank you!
scripts.translation: 看来我又得拜托你了，真的谢谢！

scripts.text: First, please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation: 先去找那位拉菲尼，问问怎样才能让哥哥恢复原状。也请问问他，当初为什么把报告交给我哥哥。

scripts.text: It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
{0} Are you going to help me?
Awesome! The world hasn't let me down just yet! I know it was too big of a favor..
scripts.translation: 太好了，这世界还没让我失望！我知道这个请求实在有些过分...

scripts.text: Please go find that Laphine and ask how to return his body back. And also please ask why the report was given to my brother in the first place.
scripts.translation: 请去找那位拉菲尼，问问怎样才能让哥哥恢复原状。也请问问他，当初为什么把报告交给我哥哥。

scripts.text: It's probably best to ask the ^0000cdpeople in the village first^000000.
But I'm a little busy right now.
Did you find that high-level Laphine?
Did you find that high-level Laphine?

scripts.translation: 那个...那位拉菲尼已经死了。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: - It's probably better not to tell him Wuhuru's story -
scripts.translation: - 还是别把乌胡鲁的事告诉他比较好。 -

scripts.text: You see, when I went to the field where he was last seen, he was already dead.
scripts.translation: 我去他最后出现的野外时，他已经死了。

scripts.text: Could it be that the palace noticed how a risky research was being done and sent a person to take care of things?
scripts.translation: 会不会是宫里发现有人在进行危险研究，派人去处理了？

scripts.text: But why of all people did they entrust my brother with that research?
scripts.translation: 可是为什么偏偏把这项研究交给我哥哥？

scripts.text: It might be that they took advantage of his inferiority complex toward his physique and his superb intellect.
scripts.translation: 他们或许是利用了他对体格的自卑，以及他过人的才智。

scripts.text: If he succeeded, they might have involved lower-level Laphines into the matter for less than desirable purposes.
scripts.translation: 如果研究成功，他们可能会把低阶拉菲尼也卷进来，拿去做不好的用途。

scripts.text: It could have been better off for your brother to have failed.
scripts.translation: 对你哥哥来说，实验失败或许反倒是件好事。

scripts.text: Even though it's unfortunate for him.
scripts.translation: 虽然这对他本人来说很不幸。

scripts.text: Could it mean that my brother is...
No, I'm sure there is some way.
I'll recover his body no matter what even if I were to do it by myself.
scripts.translation: 无论如何，就算只能靠我自己，我也要让他恢复原状。

scripts.text: Is there anything I can do to help?
You already helped me so much... If so, I'll ask you for even another favor. It's probably going to be the last one.
scripts.translation: 你已经帮我很多了...既然如此，我还想再拜托你一件事。这大概是最后一次了。

scripts.text: All of the ^0000CDingredients^000000 in this research report are very difficult for me to gather myself. {0} I would like to ask for your help.
scripts.translation: 这份研究报告里列出的材料，光靠我自己很难收集齐。{0}，能请你帮忙吗？

scripts.text: Ingredients I need are ^0000CDone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要以下材料各一份：拉菲尼翅膀碎片、萨法毛发、卡勒波迪药水、纯化魔力之石、黑暗卢恩、鲜血卢恩。 ^0000CD^000000

scripts.text: All I can trust is you {0}. Thank you.
scripts.translation: 我能信任的只有你，{0}。谢谢。

scripts.text: Did you bring all the ingredients?
scripts.translation: 你把所有材料都带齐了吗？

scripts.text: Ingredients I need are ^0000cdone of each of the following: Laphine's Wing Fragment, Hair of Sapha, Karvodailnirol, Purified Bradium, Rune of Darkness, Rune of Blood ^000000.
scripts.translation: 我需要以下材料各一份：拉菲尼翅膀碎片、萨法毛发、卡勒波迪药水、纯化魔力之石、黑暗卢恩、鲜血卢恩。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Um... Where did you say the items were {0}?
scripts.translation: 那个……{0}，你说的材料放哪儿了？
没有材料我就没法继续研究。

scripts.text: It must have been really difficult! Thank you so much!
scripts.translation: 你一定费了不少功夫！太感谢你了！

scripts.text: I'll try to continue the research with these.
scripts.translation: 我会试着用这些材料继续研究。

scripts.text: Thank you for helping me through all of this.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你一路帮我解决这些事。

scripts.text: This is nothing, but it's just a token of my appreciation.
scripts.translation: 这点东西不成敬意，就当作我的谢礼吧。

scripts.text: I wish you best of luck in the coming future {0}.
The research is still ongoing. If I had a thread of hope, I would hang on it, but I can't seem to find it just yet.
scripts.translation: 研究还在继续。哪怕只有一线希望，我也会抓住不放，可目前还没找到...

scripts.text: Excuse me. You can hear me, right?
scripts.translation: 不好意思，你听得到我说话吧？

scripts.text: I'm not a bad person. I'm just looking for someone in this prison.
scripts.translation: 我不是坏人，只是来这座监狱找个人。

scripts.text: - The suspicious man doesn't seem to want to talk at all -
scripts.translation: - 那个可疑男子似乎完全不想搭理人。 -

scripts.text: Hey, if you are asked something, would you at least respond?!
scripts.translation: 喂，别人问你话，至少回一句吧？！

scripts.text: All I am trying to do is just deliver this to him!
scripts.translation: 我只是想把东西交给他！

scripts.text: Right? Can you see this? This thing!!!
scripts.translation: 对，你看得见吗？就是这个！！！

scripts.text: What did you say you have?
- The letter was nowhere to be found -
Yes! A letter! I'm trying to deliver this to him!
scripts.translation: 对！一封信！我正要把它交给他！

scripts.text: Would you know who Wuhuru is?
It looks like ^0000cdyou are Wuhuru^000000. Your little brother wanted me to deliver this ^0000cdletter^000000 to you.
scripts.translation: 看来你就是乌胡鲁。你弟弟托我把这封信 ^0000cd^000000^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Although I didn't expect the delivery to be this way.
scripts.translation: 0交给你。没想到送信的过程会这么曲折。

scripts.text: - You leave Wuhuru alone to read through the letter -
I, I can't believe I did this to my little bro... Is Wuhari alright?
scripts.translation: 我、我竟然对弟弟做了这种事...乌哈里还好吗？啊...

scripts.text: If you have met Wuhari, as you can see, I didn't look like this originally. My brother and I had ^0000cdparticular small physiques.^000000 even among the lower-level Laphines.
scripts.translation: 既然你见过乌哈里，也看到了，我原本并不是这副模样。我和弟弟在低阶拉菲尼族中都算特别瘦小。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: So among Laphines, who value aesthetics so much, we couldn't help but always feel inferior.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族如此重视外表，我们因此总觉得自己低人一等。

scripts.text: Being physically disadvantaged relative to others, we always studied at home. Thanks to that, we were able to become much smarter than others.
scripts.translation: 因为体格不如别人，我们一直待在家里读书。也因此，我们比其他人聪明得多。

scripts.text: One day, a high-level Laphine named ^0000cdMwaridica^000000 came to visit me.
scripts.translation: 有一天，一位名叫姆瓦迪里卡 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He said that he is a member of a research facility, and that he wanted my help in a secret research project they were working on.
scripts.translation: 0的高阶拉菲尼族人来找我。他说自己是研究设施的成员，希望我协助他们进行一项秘密研究。

scripts.text: And that's when he gave me a research report that had some instructions and necessary ingredients.
scripts.translation: 他给了我一份研究报告，里面写着实验步骤和所需材料。那是一项

scripts.text: It was a research project to ^0000cdstrengthen one's physique to make the Laphines stronger and more beautiful^000000.
scripts.translation: 强化拉菲尼族体格、让他们更强壮也更美丽的研究。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I immediately said yes. For me, it was clearly a way of being recognized. There was no reason for hesitation.
scripts.translation: 我立刻答应了。那显然是个让我获得认可的机会，根本没有理由犹豫。而

scripts.text: And also, if I were to find the means to make myself bigger...
scripts.translation: 且，要是能找到让自己长高的方法...

scripts.text: He requested that I wouldn't share any of this information. So I complied with all of his requests.
scripts.translation: 他要求我对这件事保密，我便照他说的做了。连最

scripts.text: I didn't even share it with my brother who I trust so much.
scripts.translation: 信任的弟弟，我都没有告诉。

scripts.text: I don't know if that was good or bad...
scripts.translation: 我也不知道这样做究竟是对是错...

scripts.text: In any case, through much research, I finally had the results right before me.
scripts.translation: 总之，经过大量研究，我终于得到了结果。可

scripts.text: But we had no experimental subjects at hand.
scripts.translation: 当时没有合适的实验对象。

scripts.text: So I let myself become one.
And as you can see, the consequence was...
As soon as the experiment failed, that Laphine just withdrew himself right away.
scripts.translation: 实验一失败，那位拉菲尼族人就立刻抽身离开了。

scripts.text: I tried to take care of things on my own, but I ultimately ended up here.
scripts.translation: 我试着独自收拾残局，最后却落得被关在这里。

scripts.text: After obtaining this body, I realize that I'd rather have my small body back.
scripts.translation: 变成这副模样后，我才发现自己宁愿要回原来瘦小的身体。现

scripts.text: As it is now, I am a monster.
scripts.translation: 在的我简直就是个魔物。

scripts.text: I didn't want this for myself... My greed was excessive.
scripts.translation: 我并不想变成这样...是我太贪心了。

scripts.text: Only if I had known earlier...
scripts.translation: 要是我早点明白就好了...

scripts.text: I'm sorry, I talked too much.
Regardless, I think it's over for me to get out of here.
scripts.translation: 不管怎样，我想自己这辈子都出不去了。

scripts.text: If you can make it out of here, could you please let my brother know to figure out a way for me to return to my original self.
scripts.translation: 如果你能离开这里，能不能告诉我弟弟，请他想办法让我恢复原来的样子？

scripts.text: My brother, he is smaller than I, but has always been the smarter one.
scripts.translation: 弟弟比我还瘦小，却一直比我聪明。

scripts.text: Have you met Wuhari? What a relief.
scripts.translation: 你见过乌哈里了？那就好。

scripts.text: I can finally relax a little bit even in this prison.
scripts.translation: 在这座监狱里，我总算能稍微安心一点。

scripts.text: This jail cell feels particularly warm today.
scripts.translation: 今天这间牢房格外暖和。

scripts.text: I saw a dead corpse of a Laphine in the field.
scripts.translation: 我在野外发现了一具拉菲尼族人的尸体

scripts.text: ^0000cdIt was a dead corpse of a high-level Laphine.^000000 The way he seemed was suggestive of the Laphine who requested the research from you.
scripts.translation: 那是一具高阶拉菲尼族人的尸体。从他的情况来看，他似乎就是那个找你做研究的人。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And I also met someone who witnessed another bigger Laphine chasing after that Laphine before you were imprisoned here.
scripts.translation: 我还遇到一个目击者。他说，在你被关进这里之前，曾有另一位体型更大的拉菲尼族人追赶那位高阶拉菲尼。
后来，那位高阶拉菲尼被杀了。

scripts.text: What are you trying to say?
Are you telling me that I am a murderer?
Did you murder him out of anger?
scripts.translation: 你是因为气愤才杀了他吗？

scripts.text: What does it matter even if I were to... Reveal that I am a murderer...?
scripts.translation: 就算我承认...承认自己是杀人犯，又能怎么样？

scripts.text: I am trapped in this body no matter what...
scripts.translation: 反正我都被困在这副身体里了...

scripts.text: He convinced me that the goal of the research was to beautify and strengthen the Laphines and even set me up as the experimental subject!
scripts.translation: 他骗我说，这项研究是为了让拉菲尼族变得更美、更强，还让我亲自当实验对象！

scripts.text: And as soon as the experiment failed, he ran away!
scripts.translation: 实验一失败，他就逃走了！

scripts.text: He told me the truth only right before his death.
scripts.translation: 直到临死前，他才把真相告诉我。

scripts.text: His true goal was to prove to his authorities that ^0000cdhis skills as a researcher was for real^000000.
scripts.translation: 他的真正目的，是向上级证明自己确实有研究员的本事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He said that he didn't even examine the content of the experment or the ingredients themselves.
scripts.translation: 他说自己连实验内容和所用材料都没仔细看过。

scripts.text: And he also used dirty means to obtain the hair of a Sapha!
scripts.translation: 他还用卑劣的手段弄到了萨法的毛发！

scripts.text: The palace then discovered the means of this research, chased us down, and captured me for participating in the project.
scripts.translation: 后来宫里发现了这项研究的内幕，便派人追捕我们。我因为参与研究，也被抓了起来。

scripts.text: What exactly did I do wrong?
I was only a pawn in his ambitious schemes.
scripts.translation: 我不过是他野心计划中的一枚棋子。

scripts.text: It looks like his goals to engage in the study were similar to your own goals to participate.
scripts.translation: 看来你参与研究的目的，和他找你合作的目的差不多。

scripts.text: While you are a victim of his schemes, it is hard to justify what you have done... But
scripts.translation: 你确实是他阴谋的受害者，但你做过的事也很难让人原谅...

scripts.text: the way you are imprisoned here seems like you are paying for your actions.
scripts.translation: 不过，你被关在这里，也算是在为自己的行为付出代价。

scripts.text: Please... don't share this story with Wuhari.
scripts.translation: 求你...别把这些事告诉乌哈里。

scripts.text: Alright, I will act as though I have never made it here.
scripts.translation: 好吧，我会当作从没来过这里。

scripts.text: Thank you... I am indebted to you...
scripts.translation: 谢谢你...我欠你一个人情...

scripts.text: Would you please stop appearing out of nowhere?

scripts.translation: 我可是很脆弱、很敏感的！

scripts.text: What's going on! You shocked me!
What are you trying to do to me?
Oh, I was shocked for no reason.
About Wuhuru... Well, I don't really know the messy details...
scripts.translation: 到乌胡鲁...具体情况我也不太清楚...

scripts.text: I don't know how a guy who lived so peacefully all his life became like that.
scripts.translation: 他一向过得平静，真想不通怎么会变成那样。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, on the day that it happened, I heard a ^0000cdreally loud scream^000000...
scripts.translation: 说起来，事发那天我听见一声特别响的尖叫 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Many in the village were too scared to go out for awhile after hearing that.
scripts.translation: 000...村里好多人吓得有一阵子都不敢出门。

scripts.text: And not too long after, many people from the palace came over and took Wuhuru away.
scripts.translation: 没过多久，宫里就来了很多人，把乌胡鲁带走了。

scripts.text: For me, it was the first time I got out of the house in a while so all I saw was Wuhuru being captured.
scripts.translation: 那阵子我难得出一次门，所以只看见乌胡鲁被抓走。

scripts.text: But Wuhuru's appearance at the time... his appearance...
scripts.translation: 不过乌胡鲁当时的样子...他的样子...

scripts.text: Anyways, ^0000cdGoatie^000000 was also there with me, so ask him too.
scripts.translation: 总之，山羊仔当时也和我在一起，你去问问他吧。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He's really sharp with these kind of things so he might remember more.
scripts.translation: 0cd他对这类事很敏锐，应该还记得更多。

scripts.text: I came after talking with Masione...
Masione sent you? What's the problem?
scripts.translation: 马西奥内叫你来的？怎么了？

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you about Wuhuru.
Oh, you came for Wuhuru. But I don't know much either...
scripts.translation: 哦，你是来打听乌胡鲁的。不过我也不太清楚...

scripts.text: Ah! I just remembered seeing Wuhuru right before that happened!
scripts.translation: 啊！我想起来了，出事前我见过乌胡鲁！他和一个

scripts.text: At any rate, in all my days knowing Wuhuru, it's the first time I've seen him so happy.
scripts.translation: 我认识乌胡鲁这么久，还是头一回见他那么开心。

scripts.text: When I asked him why he was so happy, he showed me some ^0000cdpieces of paper^000000 and told me that he was going to look great soon...
scripts.translation: 我问他为什么这么高兴，他给我看了几张纸，说自己很快就会变得很帅... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: And the guy next to him would hint at him to keep quiet...
scripts.translation: 他身旁那人还示意他别声张...

scripts.text: Well, I was a bit concerned, but seeing him so happy, I couldn't say anything.
scripts.translation: 我当时有些担心，可看他那么高兴，也就没多说什么。

scripts.text: And it was after that when the big accident occurred.
scripts.translation: 那之后不久，就出了那场大事故。

scripts.text: What was the piece of paper?
That thing? Hmm, I don't know. I was too far to tell...
scripts.translation: 那东西吗？我也不知道，离得太远，看不清...

scripts.text: That's right, why don't you go see my ^0000cdhusband^000000. He was pretty close to Wuhuru so he might know more.
scripts.translation: 对了，你去问问我丈夫吧。他和乌胡鲁走得很近，可能知道得更多。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Did you want to know about something else?
I want to hear about the high-level Laphine who Wuhuru was working with.
scripts.translation: 我想了解乌胡鲁合作的那位高阶拉菲尼

scripts.text: Oh the high-level Laphine...? Yes~ I remember!
scripts.translation: 哦，那位高阶拉菲尼？对~我想起来了！

scripts.text: The stranger who came by with Wuhuru was a high-level Laphine. Are you talking about him?
scripts.translation: 和乌胡鲁一起来的陌生人就是高阶拉菲尼。你说的是他吧？

scripts.text: If you are talking about him, he quietly left the place after staying with Wuhuru for a bit.
scripts.translation: 要是说那个人，他和乌胡鲁待了一阵子后，就悄悄离开了。

scripts.text: After that, Wuhuru would just spend his days in his Yai.
scripts.translation: 从那以后，乌胡鲁就一直待在自己的雅伊里。

scripts.text: But that Laphine, ^0000cdhe did have impressive, beautiful wings that made him seem very elegant, but his gaze and something about him made him very suspicious^000000.
scripts.translation: 不过，那位拉菲尼确实有一双漂亮又惹眼的翅膀，显得十分优雅；可他的眼神和举止都透着可疑。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Hmm, come to think of it, ^0000cdPompe told me one day that he saw a terrible thing happening to a high-level Laphine in the land of blooming flowers^000000.
scripts.translation: 嗯...我想起来了，有一天蓬佩告诉我，他在花海之地看见一位高阶拉菲尼遭遇了可怕的事。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He did say that the Laphine that he saw at the time also had ^0000cdparticularly large and beautiful wings...^000000.
scripts.translation: 他说，当时那位拉菲尼也有特别巨大又漂亮的翅膀... ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Go see Pompe and check with him.
Have you ever been to the palace?
They say that it is so much more beautiful than our Yai's could ever be.
scripts.translation: 听说那里比我们的雅伊漂亮得多。

scripts.text: I guess people who have nothing can only dream.
scripts.translation: 一无所有的人，大概只能靠做梦了。

scripts.text: Do you need something from me?
I was wondering about the paper that Wuhuru was holding.
scripts.translation: 我想问问乌胡鲁手里那张纸的事

scripts.text: Yeah, that's right. My wife told me that he was holding something like that, but I have no idea what that was.
scripts.translation: 没错。我妻子说他当时拿着类似的东西，但我也不知道那到底是什么。

scripts.text: But who would you be to look for such a thing?
scripts.translation: 不过，你为什么要找那种东西？

scripts.text: Oh really? Come to think of it, I forgot to tell this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation: 哦，是吗？说起来，我忘了告诉乌哈里。乌胡鲁

scripts.text: Before Wuhuru was caputured away, Wuhuru's ^0000cdletter^000000 was placed on our window.
scripts.translation: 被抓走前，把一封信放在我家窗台上。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: He must have written it in preparation for his fate.
scripts.translation: 他大概是预感到自己的处境，才提前写了这封信。

scripts.text: He asked me to deliver a sealed ^0000cddocument^000000 to his brother.
scripts.translation: 他托我把一份密封的文件交给弟弟。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: We were so busy that we couldn't meet up with Wuhari even when we heard that he came back around here.
scripts.translation: ！我们实在太忙了。即使听说乌哈里回到附近，也没能见到他。

scripts.text: Hmm, I wonder if that sealed document is the paper that my wife was talking about?
scripts.translation: 嗯...妻子说的那张纸，会不会就是这份密封文件？不管怎

scripts.text: Whatever is it, give this to Wuhari.
scripts.translation: 样，你把这个交给乌哈里吧。

scripts.text: Let me see... Where did I put it...
I told myself that I'll keep it really safe, and that's why it's like this.
scripts.translation: 我一直提醒自己要把它收好，结果反倒弄成这

scripts.text: It's a bit wrinkled and stained, but it should be just fine to read.
scripts.translation: 样。虽然又皱又脏，应该还是看得清。
请帮帮那两个可怜的孩子。

scripts.text: I don't know how nice kids like them became like that...
scripts.translation: 真不明白，那么好的孩子怎么会变成那样...

scripts.text: It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
scripts.translation: 我也想帮她实现心愿，可这怎么可能呢？尤其是我

scripts.text: I know why you are here!
Tsk tsk. How could a young one like you be so forgetful.
scripts.translation: 啧啧，年纪轻轻怎么就这么健忘？

scripts.text: Do you need something else from me?
A high-level laphine? Hmm? I'm not sure who that was.
scripts.translation: 高阶拉菲尼？嗯...我不太清楚是谁。

scripts.text: I never saw him before. And that was also the last time I saw him.
scripts.translation: 我以前从没见过他，那也是我最后一次见到他。

scripts.text: Why don't you go see my wife? She was with me.
scripts.translation: 你去问我妻子吧，她当时也在场。

scripts.text: My wife is much sharper than me with these kind of things, so she'll probably be more helpful.
scripts.translation: 我妻子比我机灵多了，这种事问她应该更有帮助。

scripts.text: It's my wife's big wish to visit the palace.
I want to grant that wish for her, but how could that ever be possible.
scripts.translation: 我想帮她实现那个愿望，但怎么可能呢？尤其是考虑

scripts.text: Ouch! Whoa! Who is this? Is it a ghost?
Goatie sent you? What's the problem?
Is it because of what they gave me last time? Tell them they have to wait a bit longer.
scripts.translation: 了？是上次给我的东西吗？告诉他们再等一会儿。

scripts.text: That's not it. I was just curious about the Laphine you saw in the field.
scripts.translation: 不是，我只是想问问你在野外看到的那位拉菲尼。

scripts.text: Whoa! Don't even start with me!
I was doing my business in the field in the middle of a night, but there suddenly appeared two dark shadows!
scripts.translation: 有天半夜我在野外干活，突然出现了两道黑影！

scripts.text: At first, a ^0000cdhigh-level Laphine^000000 disappeared into distance so fast, and it was such a beautiful sight that I looked on for a while.
scripts.translation: 先是一位高阶拉菲尼飞快地消失在远方。那景象实在太美，我忍不住看了好一会儿。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: ^0000cdThe wings were really big and pretty.^000000
And then! Not too long after, suddenly!
^0000cdA huge Laphine^000000 was chasing after that high-level Laphine!
scripts.translation: ！！！一只巨大的拉菲尼追了上去！ ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I'm not sure if it was because it was so dark at the time, but ^0000cdhis body was so dark^000000 that I couldn't tell who it was.
scripts.translation: 也许是当时太黑了，那家伙全身漆黑，根本看不清是什么。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I didn't think much into it and returned home. But some time later a scream, so loud that could shake the entire field, ripped through the air.
scripts.translation: 我没多想，就回了家。过了一会儿，突然传来一声震彻整片野地的尖叫。那

scripts.text: It was such a scary scream.
And I was too afraid to go out for a while after that.
scripts.translation: 从那以后，我吓得好一阵子都不敢出门。

scripts.text: And a few days ago, when I went out to the field, I saw in the corner ^0000cda big corpse^000000!
scripts.translation: 几天前我又去野外，在角落里发现了一具巨大的尸体 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: I also saw many ^0000cdsuspicious tree branches^000000 scattered in the area.
scripts.translation: ！附近还散落着许多可疑的树枝。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: It was so disquieting that I didn't get near it...
scripts.translation: 那景象太吓人了，我没敢靠近...

scripts.text: Yeah! I don't know what kind of terrible thing happened, but ^0000cda big wing was ripped, and the more I think about it, it looks like the corpse of the Laphine that I saw^000000.
scripts.translation: 是啊！我不知道发生了什么可怕的事，但有一只巨大的翅膀被撕裂了。仔细一想，那应该就是我见过的那位拉菲尼。 ^0000cd^000000

scripts.text: Oh dear~~ I don't know why this kind of thing happened so suddenly.
scripts.translation: 天哪~~真不知道怎么会突然发生这种事。

scripts.text: A high-level Laphine should have great magic powers, but to see him dead so easily, the other huge Laphine must be something else.
scripts.translation: 高阶拉菲尼应该有强大的魔力，却这么轻易就死了。那只巨型拉菲尼一定非常可怕。

scripts.text: That's why I'm afraid to go out to the field.
What if that huge Laphine attacks me when I'm out and about in the field?
scripts.translation: 万一我在野外时，那只巨型拉菲尼袭击我怎么办？

scripts.text: My kids are too young, and I need to take care of them! I need to stay safe, you see!
scripts.translation: 我的孩子还小，我得照顾他们！我可得保护好自己！

scripts.text: You should stay away, too, if you can.
I wonder where he went. It should be around here...
scripts.translation: 不知道他去哪儿了...应该就在这附近。

scripts.text: Excuse me, if it's not too much trouble, could I talk to you for a second?
scripts.translation: 打扰一下，方便的话能占用您一点时间吗？

scripts.text: My father hasn't returned home for some time now, and when I visited his work, they said that he hasn't shown up there for a while either.

scripts.text: He's not one to vanish like that, so I asked around.
scripts.translation: 他不是会这样不告而别的人，所以我到处打听。

scripts.text: I heard that people saw him around here, but I can't find a trace of him anywhere.
scripts.translation: 听说有人在这附近见过他，可我怎么也找不到他。

scripts.text: Did you try asking the authorities?
I already did. In fact, they were already searching for him.
scripts.translation: 问过了。他们其实也在找我父亲。

scripts.text: I'm guessing they didn't make much progress.
scripts.translation: 我猜他们还没什么进展。

scripts.text: I'm worried something might have happened to him, so I came out searching for him myself.
scripts.translation: 我担心他出了什么事，所以亲自出来找他。

scripts.text: So, my suggestion is why don't we help each other find what each other needs throughout this search?
scripts.translation: 不如我们结伴寻找，途中也互相帮忙找各自要找的东西？

scripts.text: What do you think? I'm sure doing this together would be better than doing it alone.
scripts.translation: 你觉得怎么样？一起行动总比各自寻找强。

scripts.text: Oh great, that means you'll take my suggestion, right?
scripts.translation: 太好了，那你是愿意和我合作了，对吧？
