scripts.translation: 所以他们最近也借过书、读过书？

scripts.text: I borrowed some books as well to learn about people from Midgard since there are so many visitors coming from that area lately.
scripts.translation: 最近有很多米德加尔特的访客来这里，所以我也借了几本书，想了解一下他们。

scripts.text: Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
scripts.translation: 我、艾琳和波本有个共同点：我

scripts.text: That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation: 我不明白，为什么这会给我们三人都带来厄运。

scripts.text: I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
scripts.translation: 我觉得多米尼克可能知道些什么。他也许知道

scripts.text: Eirinn, Bourbon, and I have one thing in common.
scripts.translation: 我、艾琳和波本有个共同点：我

scripts.text: That is, we all read books recently.
But I don't understand why that brought bad luck to all three of us.
scripts.translation: 我不明白，为什么这会给我们三人都带来厄运。

scripts.text: I have a feeling that Dominic might know something.
scripts.translation: 我觉得多米尼克可能知道些什么。他也许知道

scripts.text: Oh, did you visit Dominic by any chance?
scripts.translation: 对了，你有没有去找过多米

scripts.text: Dominic takes care of the bookshelves and I feel like he might know something.
scripts.translation: 尼克？他负责管理书架，我觉得他可能知道些什么。
告诉塞西莉亚多米尼克的事

scripts.text: Dominic has always been like that so petty and strange.
scripts.translation: 作剧。多米尼克一直都这么小心眼，又古怪。

scripts.text: I hope you don't misunderstand us.
Most of the residents in Eclage;
No, an absolute majority of the residents here are never against outsiders.
scripts.translation: 居民——不，绝大部分居民都不排斥外来者。

scripts.text: It's just Dominic who's acting very weirdly so I hope you don't have a prejudice against us.
scripts.translation: 只有多米尼克的举止特别古怪，希望你别因此对我们抱有成见。

scripts.text: Anyway, now that I found out about it,
scripts.translation: 总之，既然我已经查清楚了，

scripts.text: Let's start planning for revenge, shall we?
scripts.translation: 我们来计划一下怎么报复他吧

scripts.text: I'll give Eirinn and Bourbon notice in advance.
You should go talk to them.
Oh, and as the manager of the warehouse let me give you something in return.
scripts.translation: 作为仓库管理员，我也该给你点回报。你帮忙找回了

scripts.text: You found lost items and helped here and there...so, think of it as a reward.
scripts.translation: 失物，还到处帮了不少忙...就把这个当作谢礼吧。

scripts.text: I'll get permission from above so that you can read any books from the bookshelves that Dominic is in charge of.
scripts.translation: 我会向上面申请许可，让你可以阅读多米尼克负责的书架上的书。

scripts.text: It's about where you came from and I'm sure you'll like it.
scripts.translation: 书里写的是你来自的地方，我相信你会喜

scripts.text: If your perspective on something changes, the way you evaluate that object changes as well.
scripts.translation: 欢。看待事物的角度变了，评价也会随之改变。从我们的
视角探索米德加尔特吧~！

scripts.text: You'll be able to read as many books as you want from the bookshelves in the plaza.
scripts.translation: 广场书架上的书，你想看哪本都可以。

scripts.text: Hope you have a good time in Eclage.
scripts.translation: 祝你在埃克拉珠玩得愉快。

scripts.text: I have to take inventory now,
so I can't talk to you anymore, sorry~
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but I hope you don't bother me.
scripts.translation: 事？我不拦着你在埃克拉珠四处走动，只要别来烦我就行。

scripts.text: Cecilia told me that someone's fooling around with people who borrowed books recently.
scripts.translation: 塞西莉亚告诉我，有人最近一直在捉弄借过书的人。

scripts.text: In principle, people living here in the capital of Eclage are not supposed to discriminate against outsiders, but not everyone is like that.
scripts.translation: 呵。原则上，住在埃克拉珠首都的人不该歧视外来者，但也不是人人都这么想。

scripts.text: I hate it so much when people in Eclage are talking about Midgard.
scripts.translation: 我最讨厌埃克拉珠的人谈论米德加尔特。

scripts.text: Why are they so fascinated about foreign areas when this place is perfect and peaceful.
scripts.translation: 这里明明完美又和平，他们为什么对外面的地方那么着迷？

scripts.text: I don't like fairies here writing about Midgard nowadays and I hate how those books are distributed far and wide.
scripts.translation: 我不喜欢这里的妖精最近写米德加尔特，更讨厌这些书到处流传。所

scripts.text: So, I decided to play a little trick on them.
scripts.translation: 以我决定给他们一点教训。

scripts.text: Bah, tell them if you want to!
They should know how scary I can be.
I won't stop you from walking around in Eclage but, don't bother me you outsider!
scripts.translation: 我不拦着你在埃克拉珠四处走动，但别来烦我，你这个外来者！

scripts.text: Bah, tell them if you want to!
They should know how scary I can be.
I feel like something bad is going to happen any minute...
scripts.translation: 不对劲。总觉得马上就要出什么事了...

scripts.text: - Do you want to throw the rat tail? -
- The rat tail became a rat even before hitting the ground. -
scripts.translation: - 鼠尾还没落地，就变成了一只老鼠。 -

scripts.text: What, where did it come from out of the blue!
scripts.translation: 什么？这东西怎么突然冒出来了！

scripts.text: I'm sure people from Midgard brought it here!
scripts.translation: 肯定是米德加尔特的人带来的！

scripts.text: - You were told to plant weeds. -
Hey, what are you doing over there?
You'd better not be doing anything weird.
I guess there's no such thing as 'weeds.' Every plant is special in its own way.
scripts.translation: 。说不定根本没有“杂草”这种东西，每种植物都有自己的特别之处。

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于米德加尔特的书。 -

scripts.text: Hey, outsider who said you can touch my books?
scripts.translation: 喂，外来者，谁准你碰我的书了？

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于卢恩·米德加兹城市的书。 -

scripts.text: Prontera, the capital of Rune-Midgarts, is filled with beautiful buildings that were thoroughly designed.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹的首都普隆德拉，到处都是精心设计的美丽建筑。

scripts.text: Here, they have a leader called 'king,' who used to arrange marriages.
scripts.translation: 这里的统治者被称为“国王”，过去还会替人安排婚姻。

scripts.text: There are many arenas, in which warriors race and wrestle to compete with each other.
scripts.translation: 这里有许多竞技场，战士们会在那里赛跑、摔跤，一较高下。

scripts.text: The group of winners are supposedly to get some kind of rewards, but seems like it lost its popularity nowadays.
scripts.translation: 据说胜者能得到某种奖励，不过这些比赛如今似乎已经不流行了。

scripts.text: You need to be careful because there are some people in Prontera with superhuman powers.
scripts.translation: 要小心，普隆德拉有些人拥有超凡的力量。

scripts.text: They're able to destroy any type of weapons or armors with a few punches, and what they use for that is just a small hammer.
scripts.translation: 他们只用几拳就能砸坏任何武器或盔甲，手里拿的却只是一把小锤子。

scripts.text: I don't understand why adventurers keep laying tools at their feet. Could it be that they're priests and people are offering a tribute to them?
scripts.translation: 我不明白冒险者为什么总把工具放在他们脚边。难道他们是祭司，人们在向他们献祭吗？

scripts.text: There's a village called Payon in the forest. It has a place called 'Palace' as well, although its purpose is unclear.
scripts.translation: 森林里有个叫斐扬的村庄，那里还有一处“宫殿”，用途不明。

scripts.text: Maybe it's a place used before Prontera became the capital of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation: 也许那是普隆德拉成为卢恩·米德加兹首都之前留下的...

scripts.text: Humans, too, establish border towns close to the boundary of their residential area, and the city of Aldebaran is one of them.
scripts.translation: 人类也会在居住区边界附近建立边境城镇，阿尔德巴兰就是其中之一。

scripts.text: In the middle of the village, there are clock-shaped monsters living in a clock tower. Further investigation is needed to find out why monsters appear in the middle of the village.
scripts.translation: 村子中央有座钟楼，里面住着钟形魔物。为什么村子中央会出现魔物，还得继续调查。

scripts.text: Although it's called a clock tower, there are more monsters inside than clocks. I personally count them my self, I really did!
scripts.translation: 虽然叫钟楼，里面的魔物却比钟还多。我自己数过，真的！

scripts.text: Geffen, a city built by great wizards, is characterized by Tower of Wizards in the middle of the city.
scripts.translation: 吉芬是伟大魔法师建造的城市，最显眼的就是城中央的魔法师之塔。

scripts.text: Come to think of it, there's a fountain in the center of Prontera, a clock tower in Aldebaran, and a tower in Geffen as well.
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，普隆德拉中央有喷泉，阿尔德巴兰有钟楼，吉芬也有一座塔。

scripts.text: Maybe human's urban planning is based on symmetry or circular placement. I think it's less sophisticated.
scripts.translation: 人类的城市规划或许讲究对称或环形布局。我觉得这可不怎么高明。

scripts.text: Izlude is a port city and is the gateway to Prontera. Since humans can't fly, they travel in big boxes.
scripts.translation: 依斯鲁得是座港口城市，也是通往普隆德拉的门户。人类不会飞，所以只能坐大箱子旅行。

scripts.text: I'm sure they think that big boxes made a great contribution to their civilization...but is it true?
scripts.translation: 我敢说，他们觉得大箱子对文明贡献很大...真有那么神奇吗？

scripts.text: Alberta is a place that people of Rune-Midgarts visit when they need to travel to other countries.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹的人要去别的国家时，常会经过艾尔贝塔。

scripts.text: There are many ships--a moving box that floats on water--ready and people travel on them.
scripts.translation: 那里有许多船——也就是能浮在水上的移动箱子——人们会搭船出行。

scripts.text: Seriously, human capability is...so disappointing. If they're wise enough, they'll use Warp-portal.
scripts.translation: 说真的，人类的本事真让人失望...聪明的话，直接用空间传送术不就好了。

scripts.text: Morocc Village is known to be a place where Morocc, the king of demons, rests.
scripts.translation: 梦罗克村据说是恶魔之王梦罗克的栖身之处。

scripts.text: Making waterways and lakes in the barren inhospitable desert...what an exceptional piece of work for humans.
scripts.translation: 在荒凉的不毛沙漠里开凿水道和湖泊...人类还真做了件了不起的事。

scripts.text: I think it's a very peaceful place...at least until monsters appear in the buildings where their leader is burried.
scripts.translation: 我觉得那里很宁静...至少在魔物出现在首领长眠的建筑里之前是这样。

scripts.text: There is the sea in the east of Rune-Midgarts, a desert in the south, forest and vegetation in the middle, and mountains in the north.
scripts.translation: 卢恩·米德加兹东临大海，南接沙漠，中部遍布森林与植被，北部则是群山。

scripts.text: If you ask children to draw a world, wouldn't they draw it like this?
scripts.translation: 如果让孩子画出一个世界，他们不也会画成这样吗？

scripts.text: However, it's not an ideal place nor is it a great place to live.
scripts.translation: 不过，那地方既不理想，也不适合居住。

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about cities in Rune-Midgarts. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于卢恩·米德加兹城市的书。 -

scripts.text: Humans often find great joy in venturing their lives in uncertain future.
scripts.translation: 人类常常会为了未知的未来冒险，并从中获得极大的乐趣。

scripts.text: Comodo is a place for people who gamble with their future for something called 'fortune.' It seems irrelevant to ruling the kingdom though.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛的人为了所谓的“运气”赌上自己的未来。不过，这似乎跟治理王国没什么关系。

scripts.text: Unidentifiable groups such as 'Female and Foot Volleyball' and 'Play Ranking Committee' got rid of games in that city.
scripts.translation: “女子与脚排球”和“游戏排名委员会”这类来历不明的团体，把城里的比赛都取消了。

scripts.text: Comodo was known to be a beach city filled with pleasure, and it used to be a place where you could find all sorts of entertainment. But I can't really say if it's still like that.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛曾是座充满欢乐的海滨城市，过去能在那里找到各种娱乐。不过现在是否依然如此，我就不清楚了。

scripts.text: There's a female priest, who is admired by the people of the village, and there seems to be good reasons for her existence.
scripts.translation: 村里有位受人敬仰的女祭司，她的存在似乎自有其道理。

scripts.text: People bring her diamonds as a tribute, and she gives them gods' gifts in return. Although it seems like you have to be pretty lucky to receive it...
scripts.translation: 人们献上钻石作为贡品，她则回赠神明的礼物。不过，想得到礼物似乎还得有相当好的运气...

scripts.text: First of all, I would like to start this book by expressing my respect to the challenging spirit of humans.
scripts.translation: 这本书开篇，我想先向勇于挑战的人类致敬。

scripts.text: In Umbala, where a gigantic tree forms a village, there are people who challenge themselves to jump off from tall trees for various reasons.
scripts.translation: 汶巴拉是一座由巨树构成的村庄，那里的人会因为各种理由挑战从高树上跳下。

scripts.text: It's kind of strange if you think about it. I thought jumping off from a tree was a type of coming-of-age ceremony for human males. I can't believe there's another reason for it.
scripts.translation: 仔细想想，这还真奇怪。我以为从树上跳下来是人类男性的成年礼，没想到还有别的理由。

scripts.text: Comodo is the only village in the southern part of this continent.
scripts.translation: 克魔岛是这片大陆南部唯一的村庄。

scripts.text: Then, what is Paros Lighthouse for?
scripts.translation: 那么，帕乐斯灯塔又是做什么用的？

scripts.text: Further investigation is delayed because only a sailor is stationed in that area currently and I couldn't find any evidence to suggest that a political or social organization is involved in that area.
scripts.translation: 目前那一带只有一名水手驻守，也没有证据表明那里有政治或社会团体活动，因此调查只好暂时搁置。

scripts.text: You can get to an island called Bahia by boat, and you can find an underground cave there.
scripts.translation: 乘船可以抵达一座名为巴伊亚的岛屿，岛上有个地下洞窟。

scripts.text: The existence of such a deep and long cave in an island is a geographical mystery!
scripts.translation: 岛上竟有如此深邃漫长的洞窟，真是地理学上的谜团！

scripts.text: Moreover, would any scholar be able to explain how humans here can breathe without gills in a place filled with water?
scripts.translation: 而且，谁能解释人类为何能在水下呼吸？那里明明全是水，他们又没有鳃。

scripts.text: Prontera is a big city, so ensuring the stable supply of resources is very important.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉是座大城市，稳定供应各类资源至关重要。

scripts.text: Especially, the supply of water resources is important for humans are vulnerable and they can't survive even for 30 days without water.
scripts.translation: 尤其是水，人类很脆弱，没有水连30天都活不了。

scripts.text: Therefore, they built a huge building that looks like a water and sewer facility...
scripts.translation: 所以他们建造了一座巨大的建筑，看起来像是供水和排污设施...

scripts.text: But why can't I find the entrance inside the city? Is it a structural problem? Or is it for security?
scripts.translation: 可为什么我在城里找不到入口？是建筑结构的问题，还是出于安全考虑？

scripts.text: Glast Heim, the ruins of what was once a great castle.
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆——一座宏伟古堡的废墟。

scripts.text: Soon, they're going to reveal what have happened here and the story behind it. So, let's focus on the development of the situation.
scripts.translation: 这里发生过什么、背后又有什么故事，很快就会揭晓。我们还是关注事态的发展吧。

scripts.text: Anyway, there are a number of monsters living together in more than 10 regions; all in the upper and lower parts of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 格拉斯特海姆的上层和下层分布着十多个区域，许多魔物在其中栖息。

scripts.text: More detailed geographic information on this region is...so limited that I want to just grab any urban engineer by the collar and start asking.
scripts.translation: 这个地区的详细地理资料少得可怜...真想揪住哪个城市规划师的衣领问个明白。

scripts.text: Although human civilization is advanced enough to establish a country, humans are not accumulating knowledge but merely shifting their focus from one to another,
scripts.translation: 人类文明已经发展到足以建立国家，却没有积累知识，只是不断把注意力从一处转向另一处，

scripts.text: and it seems like they're no longer able to differentiate a certain tree or grass from another.
scripts.translation: 他们似乎连不同种类的树木和草都分辨不出来。

scripts.text: Otherwise, they wouldn't have named this well-organized forest as 'the mysterious forest.' I can't believe they gave such a strange name to this forest just because they can't find their way out.
scripts.translation: 要不然，他们怎么会把这片规划整齐的森林叫作“神秘森林”？仅仅因为找不到路，就起这么奇怪的名字，真让人想不通。

scripts.text: They might have believed that language is an exclusive possession of human. But I'm sure they changed their mind after meeting us, the fairies.
scripts.translation: 他们或许曾认为语言是人类独有的。不过遇见我们这些妖精后，我相信他们改变想法了。

scripts.text: However, they're not surprised to see that some cats, much bigger in size than normal ones, are living in a socialized society and are able to communicate with humans.
scripts.translation: 可他们看到有些猫比普通猫大得多，还能组成社会、与人类交流，居然一点也不惊讶。

scripts.text: There's something I don't know. Should I reveal the truth?
scripts.translation: 有件事我还不清楚。要把真相揭露出来吗？

scripts.text: Breaking News: Thoughts on a secret place.
scripts.translation: 突发消息：关于一处秘密地点的见闻

scripts.text: There is constant exploitation and harassment going on in a monastery, not far from Prontera.
scripts.translation: 离普隆德拉不远的一座修道院里，剥削和骚扰的事一直在发生。

scripts.text: They lure people who attempt to walk in god's way and make them gather mushrooms or run long distances...why is this acceptable!
scripts.translation: 他们诱骗那些想走在神之道上的人，叫他们采蘑菇或长跑...这怎么能被允许！

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about the northern parts of Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看见一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是一本关于米德加尔特北部的书。 -

scripts.text: Humans continued to float big boxes on water and the sea, and finally, they began to use the sky.
scripts.translation: 人类先让大箱子漂在江河和海上，后来甚至开始征服天空。

scripts.text: Where are they going next? Underground? Or are they going to transcend time and space?
scripts.translation: 他们下一步要去哪里？地下？还是要穿越时空？

scripts.text: At this rate, people will be willing to travel to the past. Human's technological advancements require attention.
scripts.translation: 照这样下去，人类说不定还想回到过去。人类科技的发展可得好好留意。

scripts.text: Einbroch is filled with machines. They don't seem to manufacture a lot of industrial goods, but machines are their weapons definitely.
scripts.translation: 艾音布罗克到处都是机器。这里似乎不怎么生产工业品，不过机器肯定就是他们的武器。

scripts.text: What are those numerous factories producing, and for what are people working?
scripts.translation: 那么多工厂到底在生产什么？人们又是为了什么而工作？

scripts.text: Don't they know that civilization development doesn't necessarily improve the value of life?
scripts.translation: 他们难道不知道，文明进步未必能提升生活的价值吗？

scripts.text: If you take a train in Einbroch, you can get to a village called Einbech.
scripts.translation: 从艾音布罗克搭火车，就能到达一个叫艾音贝赫的村庄。

scripts.text: Of course I hate this form of transportation (smells like iron too much), but it's a useful for humans because of its cheap price and transport capacity.
scripts.translation: 我当然讨厌这种交通工具（铁锈味实在太重），不过它价格便宜、载货量大，对人类来说倒是很实用。

scripts.text: By the way, don't they have enough materials to make railroad tracks? When will they make extensions to the train routes?
scripts.translation: 说起来，他们的材料还不够铺铁轨吗？什么时候才会延长火车路线呢？

scripts.text: Hugel, a small rural village, is like Comodo of southern region.
scripts.translation: 毁葛是座小乡村，就像南方的克魔岛。

scripts.text: There are a variety of mini games and the landscape is very idyllic as well.
scripts.translation: 那里有各种小游戏，风景也很田园。

scripts.text: But aren't those entertainment facilities supposed to be in the center of a country?
scripts.translation: 不过，这些娱乐设施不是应该建在国家中心地带吗？

scripts.text: A city called Juno is even floating in the sky! How incredible is this.
scripts.translation: 竟然有座叫朱诺的城市漂浮在空中！太不可思议了。

scripts.text: And there is a special reward for those who escape the maze: there is a place where rebirth is given.
scripts.translation: 逃出迷宫的人还能获得特别奖励：那里有个能让人转生的地方。

scripts.text: Humans are truly scary. But I feel like I've seen this maze somewhere...
scripts.translation: 人类真可怕。不过，我好像在哪里见过这个迷宫...

scripts.text: In Rahel, the capital of Arunafeltz, there lives a small, cute, and white creature that seems really soft.
scripts.translation: 阿鲁纳佩斯首都拉赫的居民中，有一种小巧可爱、通体雪白，看起来软绵绵的生物。

scripts.text: If you thought of Siroma, you are wrong. It's not marine either.
scripts.translation: 如果你想到小雪兽，那就错了。它也不是海洋生物。

scripts.text: The answer is a girl who is both a priest and a leader. This is because Arunafeltz is a theocratic entity.
scripts.translation: 答案是一位女孩，她既是祭司，也是领袖。毕竟阿鲁纳佩斯是个神权国家。

scripts.text: In the plains of Audhumbla, there lives many monster flowers and herbivore animals.
scripts.translation: 奥丁神殿原野上生活着许多魔物花和食草动物。

scripts.text: Although one would think that they are not herbivores seeing how they attack humans, but
scripts.translation: 看到它们攻击人类，你或许会觉得它们不像食草动物，不过——

scripts.text: if they were really carnivores, what food would they live on? Moreover, there is no record of them eating the adventurers who travel by after attacking them.
scripts.translation: 如果它们真是肉食动物，又靠什么为生呢？而且，它们攻击路过的冒险者后，也没有把人吃掉的记录。

scripts.text: Veins, a village built on a hill, seems like a well-planned city.
scripts.translation: 伯仁斯这座建在山丘上的村庄，看起来规划得井井有条。

scripts.text: While it's confusing to know where you would exit and enter from, but
scripts.translation: 虽然让人摸不着头脑，不知道该从哪里进出，不过——

scripts.text: if you want to see interesting sights such as a stone eating up a coin you dropped, it's a good place to visit.
scripts.translation: 如果你想看看石头吞掉你掉落的硬币之类的奇景，这里倒值得一游。

scripts.text: There was also a place that was extremely hot somewhere in Arunafeltz..
scripts.translation: 阿鲁纳佩斯某处还有个热得惊人的地方...

scripts.text: The heat there felt like it would burn through my wings in their entirety. The residents of that place also did not seem very friendly.
scripts.translation: 那里的热浪像是要把我的翅膀整个烧焦，居民看起来也不太友善。

scripts.text: So I had to stop the expedition. I hope that you, the readers, would also distance yourselves from that place.
scripts.translation: 所以我只好中止探险。读者们也最好离那地方远点。

scripts.text: Well...It's not that I was afraid of the guardian there, you see!
scripts.translation: 我可不是害怕那里的守卫哦！

scripts.text: In Lighthalzen, there is a colossal building constructed by technicians. Although what they exactly do in there is a little suspicious...
scripts.translation: 里希塔乐镇有座由技术人员建造的巨型建筑，他们在里面究竟做什么，实在令人起疑...

scripts.text: I'm not sure if a profit-seeking corporation should be doing something like that.
scripts.translation: 我不确定以营利为目的的企业是否该做这种事。

scripts.text: It's also very strange that clean and dirty areas in the city are divided...
scripts.translation: 而且，城里的干净区和脏乱区竟然分得泾渭分明...

scripts.text: - I saw a book and stretched my hand out to reach for it. I think it's about various regions in Midgard. -
scripts.translation: - 我看到一本书，伸手去拿。我想那是介绍米德加尔特各地的书。 -

scripts.text: If you ride the boats in Alberta, you can get to various destinations.
scripts.translation: 从艾尔贝塔搭船，可以前往许多地方。

scripts.text: I don't know why so many of these boats end up at Alberta specifically, but for that, traveling is much easier.
scripts.translation: 不知道为什么那么多航线都从艾尔贝塔出发，不过这样旅行确实方便多了。

scripts.text: Places you can reach through Alberta are as follows.
scripts.translation: 从艾尔贝塔可以前往这些地方：

scripts.text: A country of Gods, Amatsu, a place of refuge, Kunlun, Luoyang where many martial art experts reside, Ayothaya in which a huge sculpture is present, and many others.
scripts.translation: 诸神之国天津町、避世之地昆仑、武术高手云集的洛阳、矗立着巨大雕像的哎哟泰雅，还有许多别处。

scripts.text: I can see that more places would be available in the future as delegates from many other countries are arriving there more recently.
scripts.translation: 最近许多国家的使节都抵达了那里，看来今后还会有更多地方开放通行。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is one famous destination.
scripts.translation: 有个地方是搭船能去的著名目的地。

scripts.text: Regrettably for them, they didn't take me just because I am a lone traveler. It wasn't even that they would give me a discount on the boat ride.
scripts.translation: 可惜他们没肯载我这个独自旅行的人，连船票折扣都不给。

scripts.text: As a scholar, I couldn't be more enraged by the ignorance of the Jawaii-bound ship's captain. Even during wars, historians are exempt from hostility.
scripts.translation: 身为学者，我对那位前往爪哇伊的船长的无知怒不可遏。即使身处战乱，历史学家也不该遭受敌意。

scripts.text: Also from Alberta, there is an island known for its high concentration of turtles.
scripts.translation: 从艾尔贝塔还能前往一座以海龟众多闻名的岛屿。

scripts.text: There are no regular routes, but after a long research, I found out that there is a captain who travels specifically to that place.
scripts.translation: 那里没有固定航线，不过经过一番调查，我发现有位船长专程前往。

scripts.text: Upon getting there, there were many exotic turtles including cold turtles, hot turtles, and ninja turtles.
scripts.translation: 到了那里，我看见各种奇特的乌龟：冰龟、火龟，还有忍者龟。

scripts.text: From Clock Tower Village, I could arrive at a snowing village through an elderly man who wears thick, red clothes all year around.
scripts.translation: 从钟楼村出发，找一位全年穿着厚重红衣的老人，就能抵达一座雪村。

scripts.text: The entire village was covered by snow, and as expected from a place that is preparing for a celebration, the atmosphere was great.
scripts.translation: 整个村庄都被白雪覆盖。那里正在筹备庆典，气氛果然很热闹。

scripts.text: Inside the village, there was also a place that produces toys for children, but for some reason, they chased me out.
scripts.translation: 村里还有一家生产玩具的工厂，不知为何，他们却把我赶了出来。

scripts.text: Among those places that can be reached by boats, there is a small island where a wrecked ship rests.
scripts.translation: 搭船能去的地方中，还有一座小岛，搁浅的船只就停在那里。

scripts.text: I'm not sure if the ship was to be salvaged, but it was already occupied by strange creatures.
scripts.translation: 我不清楚那艘船是不是准备打捞，不过已经有奇怪的生物占据了那里。

scripts.text: The main god of the faith practiced in this continent is Odin. Accordingly, there is a temple for Odin as well.
scripts.translation: 这片大陆信奉的主神是奥丁，因此也建有奥丁神殿。

scripts.text: I was also outcasted here. People had no conception of hospitality and generosity toward outsiders.
scripts.translation: 我在那里也被排斥了。人们对外来者毫无待客之道，更谈不上慷慨。

scripts.text: Near the south of the village were some docks. I researched a long time to see how these docks were being used, but I just couldn't find the answer.
scripts.translation: 村子南边有几个码头。我调查了很久，想弄清楚它们的用途，却始终没有头绪。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.
scripts.translation: 后来我跟着偷偷使用码头的冒险者，总算发现了他们前往的地方。

scripts.text: As scary as it was, what I saw there was truly shocking.
scripts.translation: 那地方令人毛骨悚然，我在那里看到的景象也着实令人震惊。

scripts.text: It is only right for an adventurer to record all that was seen, but because it is a politically sensitive material to be revealed, I will leave it at that.
scripts.translation: 冒险者理应记录所见的一切，但这件事涉及政治敏感内容，不便公开，就说到这里吧。

scripts.text: But soon, I discovered the destination from those docks by following adventurers who secretly utilized them.

scripts.translation: 那地方令人毛骨悚然，我在那里看到的景象也着实令人震惊。

scripts.text: Breaking News! Prontera's Issue Maker!! Exclusive Interview!!
scripts.translation: 突发新闻！普隆德拉的问题人物！！独家专访！！

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Hi, everyone. We have Mr. Hollgrehen, the master of refinement, here with us today. Hi, Mr. Hollgrehen.
scripts.translation: [记者]：大家好！今天请到精炼大师霍尔格伦先生。您好，霍尔格伦先生。
[霍尔格伦]：你好，很高兴见到你。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: What made you devote yourself to refinement for the last 10 years?
scripts.translation: [记者]：是什么让您在过去十年里一直专注于精炼？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I went to a swimming pool when I was little, and I could just float in the water even though I didn't know how to swim. I could just do it. That's how I started working as a refiner.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：小时候我去过游泳池，明明不会游泳，却能漂在水面上。我就这么漂起来了。这就是我后来成为精炼师的原因。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: What? You float well? Hmm? It sounds weird..
scripts.translation: [记者]：什么？您很会漂浮？嗯？听起来有点奇怪...

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Have you ever done refining in the water? Don't even start if you've never done it.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：你试过在水里精炼吗？没试过就别妄下评论。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Okay, I see. I heard you have an amazing skill. What is it?
scripts.translation: [记者]：原来如此。听说您有一项惊人的本领，是什么呢？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I can refine objects with my eyes closed.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：我能闭着眼睛精炼物品。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Isn't that why you're breaking objects?
scripts.translation: [记者]：所以您才老是把东西弄坏吗？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Have you ever done refining with your eyes closed? Don't even start if you've never done it.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：你闭着眼睛精炼过吗？没试过就别妄下评论。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: I see.. Could you show us then? Let's start with something lighter, like...a knife?
scripts.translation: [记者]：这样啊...能现场示范一下吗？先拿轻一点的东西，比如...小刀？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I don't do cheap weapons like that. It should be at least level 4.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：我可不精炼那种便宜武器。至少得是四级武器。

scripts.text: [Reporter]: Huh? Cheap weapons? You're kidding, right?
scripts.translation: [记者]：啊？便宜武器？您是在开玩笑吧？

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: I don't tell jokes. Oh good, you're holding an '+9 Ice Pick.' Give it to me. I'll upgrade it to 10.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：我从不开玩笑。哦，你手上这把是+9破甲短锥吧？给我，我把它升到+10。
[霍尔格伦]：尔格伦]：呜啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Hahaha, maybe I don't feel very well today. Oh! Today is Sunday, right? I forgot that sundays are not good for refining weapons. Maybe, armors will do. Right, it will definitely float.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：哈哈，今天状态可能不太好。哦，今天是星期天吧？我忘了星期天不适合精炼武器。也许盔甲可以。对，盔甲肯定浮得起来。

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: This is a pretty good armor. Is this +7 High Risk Valkyrie's Armor?
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：-[霍尔格伦]：这盔甲不错啊。是+7高等瓦尔基里之铠吗？
[霍尔格伦]：尔格伦]：呜啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Now that I think about it, today is a even-day. Even-days are not good for armor refining. Right, shoes will float well.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：仔细想想，今天是双数日。双数日不适合精炼盔甲。对了，鞋子肯定浮得起来。

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Hey, you're pretty well off. These are +9 Dull Black Leather Boots. I'll make you even richer.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：。 -[霍尔格伦]：你还挺有钱啊。这是+9黑色皮革长靴。让我给你升升级。
[霍尔格伦]：尔格伦]：呜啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Oh, now that I see the calendar, today is the first Sunday of this month. For some reason, I couldn't refine shoes well on first sundays. Right, today's perfect for clothes!!
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：哦，看日历才想起来，今天是这个月第一个星期天。不知为什么，我每逢第一个星期天都精炼不好长靴。对了，今天适合精炼衣服！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: It's +9 Wandering Valkyrie's Cape. Good, I'll upgrade this to 10 for sure.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：这是+9流浪者瓦尔基里斗篷。好，我一定能把它升到+10。
[霍尔格伦]：尔格伦]：呜啊啊啊啊啊！！！

scripts.text: [Hollgrehen]: Hahaha, I think I had something really important...I should go now.
scripts.translation: [霍尔格伦]：哈哈哈，我刚才好像有件要紧事...我该走了。

scripts.text: We apologize for not completing the interview due to the reporter's condition. - Editors.
scripts.translation: 由于记者身体不适，本次采访未能完成。——编辑部
《卢恩·米德加兹月刊》十一月号

scripts.text: This month's reader's memoir is on Malangdo, an island of cats. Aren't you excited to find out what's going on in Malangdo?!
scripts.translation: 本月的读者游记带你探访猫岛马兰岛。你不好奇马兰岛上发生了什么吗？！
探访马兰岛 × 精炼记录 ○

scripts.text: Malangdo, an island of cats. So soft and tender, ah...it's an island filled with lovely cats. Aww, what should I do...they're all so cute and lovely that I wanted to hug...
scripts.translation: 马兰岛，猫咪之岛。软绵绵、毛茸茸，啊...岛上满是可爱的猫咪。哎呀，我该怎么办...它们都太可爱了，好想抱一抱...

scripts.text: them...yes, I wanted to, until I met these scary father cat and his daughter.
scripts.translation: 它们...是啊，我本来想抱抱它们，直到遇见那只可怕的猫爸爸和他的女儿。

scripts.text: Yes, I was waiting to catch the King Octopus. I guess it was when I was passing by a boat? I met a cat with slanted eyes.
scripts.translation: 没错，我当时在等国王章鱼。大概是经过一艘船时吧？我遇见了一只眯眯眼的猫。

scripts.text: That cat introduced himself and told me that he studied in Morocc.
scripts.translation: 那只猫自我介绍说，他曾在梦罗克留学。

scripts.text: Then he assured me that he could upgrade my +9 Violet Fear to +10 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 接着他拍胸脯保证，能把我的+9纳户特基格的双剑精炼成+10。

scripts.text: He sounded so reliable since he studied abroad and all that, right? So I trusted him and gave him my +9 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 他留过洋，听起来特别可靠，对吧？所以我信了他，把+9纳户特基格的双剑交给了他。

scripts.text: Then my +9 Violet Fear shattered into pieces. I was so shocked because it was the only weapon that I had.
scripts.translation: 结果我的+9纳户特基格的双剑碎成了片。我震惊极了，因为那是我唯一的武器。

scripts.text: I spent all of my money to buy a Enriched Oridecon, too. Right, I couldn't trust him 100% even if he studied abroad.
scripts.translation: 我还花光了所有钱买了一块浓缩神之金属。是啊，就算他留过洋，我也不该百分之百相信他。

scripts.text: So I comforted myself and mourned for my +9 Violet Fear.
scripts.translation: 我只能安慰自己，为碎掉的+9纳户特基格的双剑默哀。

scripts.text: But that wasn't the end. After that, a little cat approached me, saying she has a hammer that can refine even the stars in the sky.
scripts.translation: 可事情还没完。后来一只小猫凑过来，说她有把连天上的星星都能精炼的锤子。

scripts.text: A hammer that refines the starts in the sky! Doesn't it sound awesome? Since I lost my only weapon, I thought I should strengthen my armors. So I gave her everything I had.
scripts.translation: 能精炼天上的星星！听起来多厉害啊？既然我失去了唯一的武器，就想着至少强化一下防具。于是把身上所有东西都交给了她。

scripts.text: Shoes, clothes, armor, and even helmet...everything I had is just gone...now that I think about it, she said it's a hammer that can refine the stars of the sky.
scripts.translation: 鞋子、衣服、盔甲，连头盔都没剩下...我所有东西全没了...现在想想，她只说那是能精炼星星的锤子。

scripts.text: But she didn't say it doesn't break things, right? So, if you ever visit Malando, be aware of those cats called 'Strip' and 'Shatter.' I'm a Rune Knight and I still catch Porings...you don't want to be like me...
scripts.translation: 可她没说不会把装备敲坏，对吧？所以你要是去马兰岛，小心那些叫“Strip”和“Shatter”的猫。我堂堂卢恩骑士，结果还在抓波利...你可别学我...

scripts.text: This is a story of 'Appearing in Morocc Chocheon****.'
scripts.translation: 这是一个关于“梦罗克晨星****现身”的故事。

scripts.text: You are working for.. The king.
This the prison where we put criminals.
scripts.translation: 这里是关押罪犯的监狱。外

scripts.text: Hey Guard~ I think the humidity here is too high. My skin is gonna be ruined. Is that ok? Huh?
scripts.translation: 喂，卫兵~我觉得这里湿气太重了，皮肤都要变差了。这样没问题吗？嗯？

scripts.text: ^000099Looking tired, the prison guard glances at the prisoner. He seems irritated from constantly bickering with the prisoner.^000000
scripts.translation: 狱卒疲惫地瞥了囚犯一眼。他似乎被囚犯没完没了的争吵惹恼了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Mr. Clever, you have to understand this. You are currently under a sentence as a prisoner.
scripts.translation: 聪明鬼先生，你得明白，你现在是囚犯，正在服刑。

scripts.text: Yes, I know. I know that. So please bring me some kind of furnace up here. The humidity is too much and making everything really sticky.
scripts.translation: 我知道，我知道。那就给我搬个炉子来吧。这里太潮了，弄得浑身黏糊糊的。

scripts.text: Don't you get it? There's no such thing as making the conditions favorable for a prisoner to serve their sentence.
scripts.translation: 你还不明白吗？囚犯服刑可没有改善待遇这一说。

scripts.text: ^000099The guard, holding his anger, just returns to his position. He is too gracious in letting the prisoner have his way.^000000
scripts.translation: 狱卒强忍怒火，回到了岗位。他对囚犯也未免太纵容了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Oh! You are the one from earlier. I'm so thankful that you're here! Please help me out. I can't seem to take care of things here.
scripts.translation: 哦，你就是刚才那位！太感谢你来了，请帮帮我。我实在应付不了这里的状况。

scripts.text: Don't you look elsewhere~ Don't you talk with other prisoners~ Look at me, only me~~ Be good to me when I'm with you~~
scripts.translation: 别东张西望~别跟别的囚犯说话~眼里只准有我~~跟我待在一起时，要乖乖听话哦~~

scripts.text: ^000099The situation was immediately understandable. The prison guard was in need of someone to help him out with the prisoner.^000000
scripts.translation: 情况一目了然：狱卒需要有人帮忙对付这个囚犯。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Well I didn't submit a requisition...
An official request? No, it's not even necessary. You came to visit Mr. Clever, right? Here, look. It's already been recorded.
scripts.translation: 正式申请？不用，完全没必要。你是来探望聪明鬼先生的吧？你看，这里已经登记好了。

scripts.text: ^000099It's probably better not to randomly make up an official record right in front of me.^000000
scripts.translation: 当着我的面随便编造官方记录，恐怕不太合适吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You are here.{0}I don't know what you did but Mr. Clever is quiet now.
scripts.translation: 你来了，{0}。不知道你做了什么，不过聪明鬼先生现在安静了。

scripts.text: Do I need to fill out a visitation form?
scripts.translation: 我需要填写探视申请吗？

scripts.text: No, no! What are you saying...{0}Your prison visits are welcome at any time. I'll do it for you especially if it's for Mr. Clever!
scripts.translation: 不不！你说什么呢……{0}随时欢迎你来探监。尤其是探望聪明鬼先生，我一定帮你安排！

scripts.text: ^000099Yeah, I keep thinking about it. It's probably better not to randomly make up an official record right in front of me.^000000
scripts.translation: 嗯，我也是这么想的。最好别当着我的面随便编造官方记录。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: {0}Are you already leaving? Ah... That's no good~ It just got quiet!!
scripts.translation: {0}，你这就要走了吗？啊……别呀，这里才刚安静下来！！

scripts.text: Well, I thought my time for the visit was over...
scripts.translation: 我还以为探视时间已经结束了...

scripts.text: What! What are you talking about? {0} Is the time for a visitation a problem for you? Here.. I will extend it for 3 hours!
scripts.translation: 什么！你在说什么？{0}，探视时间不够吗？来，我给你延长三小时！

scripts.text: ^000099How he makes things up so randomly... I don't have anything to say anymore...^000000
scripts.translation: 他怎么什么都能随口编出来...我都不知道该说什么了... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Has Clever been giving you problems again?...
scripts.translation: 聪明鬼又给你添麻烦了吗？...

scripts.text: It's not a song. {0}when you are not here, Mr. Clever keeps chanting some kind of spell and tortures me!
scripts.translation: 那才不是歌。{0}不在的时候，聪明鬼先生一直念着什么咒语折磨我！

scripts.text: Since you are here, let me first record this for you!
scripts.translation: 既然你来了，我先把这件事替你登记一下！

scripts.text: ^000099I'm getting used to this with his making stuff up all the time now.^000000
scripts.translation: 他总是这么胡编乱造，我都快习惯了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品种类好像太多了。减少种类后再试试吧。

scripts.text: ^000099Clever is still deep asleep. Be careful not to awaken him.^000000
scripts.translation: 聪明鬼还在熟睡。小心别把他吵醒。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Clever scribbled a map on my hand. It looks like the place where the books are.^000000
scripts.translation: 聪明鬼在我手上画了张地图，看起来像是藏书的地方。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099I see Clever working hard with his writing tools. It must be the new history report. ^000000
scripts.translation: 我看见聪明鬼正拿着笔认真写东西。那一定是新的历史报告。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Mm? Who are you? You aren't a visitor. Guard~!!! Guard~!!! There is a suspicious person here! What are you doing not taking him away?!
scripts.translation: 嗯？你是谁？你不是来探监的。卫兵~！！！卫兵~！！！这里有个可疑人物！怎么还不把他带走？！

scripts.text: Hmm, In any case, I've never seen you before. Why are you here to visit me?
scripts.translation: 嗯，总之我以前没见过你。你为什么来看我？

scripts.text: I never wanted to visit you either.
Oh~ Really? Ok, you get out of here. I'm going to start torturing the guard. Let's see... Alright, I'll sing to him!
scripts.translation: 哦~真的？那你滚吧。我要开始折磨那个狱卒了。让我想想...好，我给他唱歌！

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as Clever starts singing, the guard looks at me in exhaustion. Of course, it was torture for myself as well.^000000
scripts.translation: 聪明鬼一开口唱歌，狱卒就疲惫地看向我。当然，对我来说这也是一种折磨。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: For what crime? Why do you ask such a boring question?
scripts.translation: ？犯了什么罪？干嘛问这么无聊的问题？

scripts.text: I thought you were kind of interesting, seeing how you come to visit a stranger. How disappointing~ I'm going to sing the rest of this tune.
scripts.translation: 我还以为你会来看一个陌生人，应该挺有趣的呢。真失望~我要把这首歌唱完。

scripts.text: ^000099I saw real fear and despair in the guard's face. The prisoner known as Clever was getting ready to sing.^000000
scripts.translation: 我从狱卒脸上看到了真切的恐惧与绝望。名叫聪明鬼的囚犯正要开唱。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Please, I ask you. Please shut Mr. Clever's mouth. I've been listening to him for a year now and it's driving me insane. I can't beat a prisoner either...
scripts.translation: 求求你，帮帮我。让聪明鬼先生闭嘴吧！我听他唱了一整年，快被逼疯了。我又不能打囚犯...

scripts.text: Don't you look elsewhere~ Don't you talk with other prisoners~ Look at me, only me~~ Be good to me when I'm with you~~
scripts.translation: 别东张西望~别跟别的囚犯说话~眼里只准有我~~跟我待在一起时，要乖乖听话哦~~

scripts.text: The prisoner is singing a song that seems to come from another dimension.
scripts.translation: 囚犯正在唱一首仿佛来自异世界的歌。

scripts.text: Wait! Wait! Stop your singing for a minute!
Hmm? Why? Do you have an interesting story?
scripts.translation: 嗯？为什么？你有有趣的故事要讲吗？

scripts.text: Tell him about the journey until now.

scripts.translation: 告诉他米德加尔特的事

scripts.text: Ask him what he wants to eat.
Hmm. What do I want to eat? I have lots of things I want to eat. After all, I've been eating stale prison rice all this time. I had one thing in particular.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我想吃什么？想吃的可多了。毕竟我一直都在吃难吃的牢饭。有一样东西我尤其想念。

scripts.text: At one point, some adventurer shared with me as a present some ^000099Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000 and it was really refreshing.
scripts.translation: 以前有位冒险者送过我葡萄果汁草药茶，喝起来特别清爽。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you bring me ^0000991 cup of Grape Extract Herb Tea^000000, I'll tell you various gossip stories of Eclage in return. How's that?
scripts.translation: 给我带一杯葡萄果汁草药茶，我就告诉你一些埃克拉珠的秘闻。怎么样？ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Alrighty~ It was nice meeting you. I'm going to sing the rest of this tune.
scripts.translation: 好吧~见到你很高兴。我要把这首歌唱完了。

scripts.text: Ho~ Ok, then shall I wait for you getting some sleep?
scripts.translation: 呵~好吧，那我等你去睡一觉再来？

scripts.text: Hmm hmm.. Let me think for a bit...
^000099He looks like he won't wake up until I bring back some Grape Extract Herb Tea.^000000
scripts.translation: 看来不带葡萄果汁草药茶回来，他就不会醒。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Wow, you really brought me some. In any case, did you even request a visit? Hey~ Guard!! Don't you have to see if this guy came here with a formal visitation request? Random people can't be in here!
scripts.translation: 哇，你真的给我带来了。对了，你申请探监了吗？喂~卫兵！！你不该查查这家伙有没有正式探视许可吗？可不能让随便什么人进来！

scripts.text: NO I DON'T HAVE TO! I DON'T HAVE TO CHECK!
scripts.translation: 我才不用检查！不用检查！

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's irritated voice screamed from afar.^000000
scripts.translation: 远处传来狱卒恼火的吼声。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Well, the guard says it's ok. Thanks for bringing it to me. Since I am a prisoner, I don't have much to give aside from praying for a blessing upon home tree.
scripts.translation: 嗯，狱卒说可以。谢谢你把茶带来。我身为囚犯也没什么能给你的，就替你向家园之树祈求祝福吧。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你获得了家园之树的祝福，并得到基础经验值和职业经验值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Whew~ How refreshing. You are the only visitor I could appreciate this entire past year of imprisonment.
scripts.translation: 呼~真舒服。这一年牢狱生活里，你是唯一让我觉得开心的访客。

scripts.text: Yes, that's right~ I did promise you that.
There's so many. Why don't you choose one among these topics.
scripts.translation: 秘闻可多了。你挑个话题吧。

scripts.text: A story about the Seneth King's father
scripts.translation: 关于塞内斯王父亲的故事

scripts.text: A story about Seneth King's arsony
scripts.translation: 关于塞内斯王纵火的故事

scripts.text: The assistant chief of staff's real name
A dimensional rift in nearby regions
This is a secret gossip related to the old king. Have you heard about a first-rate criminal named Florence? He was a first-rate criminal, but he was the father of an old king named Seneth.
scripts.translation: 这是和老国王有关的秘密。你听说过一流罪犯弗洛伦斯吗？他虽是个大罪犯，却是老国王塞内斯的父亲。

scripts.text: What crime did he commit? Haha, no one knows that. But in Eclage, ^000099it's actually prohibited to mention the name Florence^000000.
scripts.translation: 他到底犯了什么罪？哈哈，没人知道。不过在埃克拉珠，提起弗洛伦斯的名字其实是禁忌。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you mention his name, you might be in the same situation as I am.
scripts.translation: 你要是提起他的名字，说不定也会落得和我一样的下场。

scripts.text: There's also a secret tale about Florence's son, King Seneth. Because of his low self-esteem related to having a criminal father, he is a king who implemented radical policies.
scripts.translation: 还有一段关于弗洛伦斯之子塞内斯王的秘闻。他因为父亲是罪犯而自卑，因此推行了激进的政策。

scripts.text: There are also rumors that he had a mental illness, I don't know to what degree that is true. I heard that he actually chewed through the stem of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 还有传言说他精神不太正常，具体是真是假我也不知道。听说他甚至啃断了世界树的树干。

scripts.text: Can you imagine? What it could mean for the Mayor to cause harm to Yggdrasil? It's a terrible thing.
scripts.translation: 你想想看，市长伤害世界树意味着什么？这可是件可怕的事。

scripts.text: There are rumors that after disconnecting himself from Yggdrasil, he grew sicker and sicker, and ultimately set himself on fire.
scripts.translation: 据说他与世界树断开联系后，病情日益加重，最后还放火烧了自己。

scripts.text: Of course, it's just a hearsay, so I can't guarantee that it's true, but I'm positive that ^000099he was the first Mayor to break the relationship with Yggdrasil^000000.
scripts.translation: 当然，这只是传闻，我不能保证属实。不过我敢肯定，他是第一位与世界树断绝联系的市长。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: This is a story that most Laphines don't recognize. The assistant chief of staff Shenime's real name is not Shenime.
scripts.translation: 大多数拉菲尼族都不知道这件事：参谋长谢尼梅的真名并不是谢尼梅。

scripts.text: But no one remembers what is real name is. It's the same with me. It's as if a giant eraser stormed through the mind.
scripts.translation: 但没人记得他的真名，我也一样。就像脑海里刮过一阵橡皮擦风暴，把一切都抹掉了。

scripts.text: All I know for sure is that Shenime is not his real name. So I conjured up an interesting story. Do you happen to know what it means to control the public?
scripts.translation: 我只确定谢尼梅不是真名，所以编了个有趣的故事。你知道操纵舆论意味着什么吗？

scripts.text: If you have a strong ability in controlling the public, I could make you believe that not just my name but my face also ^000099are my original ones even if they really weren't^000000.
scripts.translation: 只要擅长操纵舆论，我就能让你相信我的名字和长相都是原本的模样，即使它们根本不是。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Shenime formed that kind of identity... Or rather, changed into such an identity. But this is also one of many rumors. Heh.
scripts.translation: 谢尼梅塑造了那样的身份...或者说，变成了那种身份。不过这也只是众多传闻之一。呵。

scripts.text: I don't mean to brag, but I used to be a historian, researching the Alfheim continent along with geography, biology, and archaeology.
scripts.translation: 我可不是自夸，以前我当过历史学家，也研究阿尔夫海姆大陆的地理、生物和考古。

scripts.text: Recently, they discovered a suspicious rift in this vicinity. Because of how I am now, I couldn't check it out myself, but my colleague participated in the research team here and seemed to have brought back something.
scripts.translation: 最近有人在附近发现了可疑的裂隙。我现在这个样子，没法亲自去查，不过我的同事参加了调查，似乎带回了什么东西。

scripts.text: What do you mean something? Did he bring back something like a rift fragment?
scripts.translation: 你说的是什么？他带回了裂隙碎片之类的东西吗？

scripts.text: I think so. I don't know if you understand this, but if you utilize a dimensional rift fragment, you can travel through time or different dimensions.
scripts.translation: 大概吧。你可能不清楚，利用空间裂隙碎片可以穿越时间，或前往不同次元。

scripts.text: Yes, that is why I am here in the first place.
scripts.translation: 没错，我就是为此来到这里的

scripts.text: Oh, that's right. You are a human traveller from Midgard, so you would know more about this than I do.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了。你是从米德加尔特来的旅行者，这方面肯定比我懂。

scripts.text: In any case, the discovery of a rift in this vicinity is an absolute secret.
scripts.translation: 总之，在附近发现裂隙这件事绝对要保密。

scripts.text: How fun would it be to return to the past with the rift fragment~ I would be able to do whatever I want out of this boring prison.
scripts.translation: 要是能用裂隙碎片回到过去，该有多有趣啊~我就能离开这无聊的监狱，想做什么就做什么。

scripts.text: Hmm~ I've said too much. I think I talked to much for a cup of herb tea. I'm going to rest a little bit.
scripts.translation: 嗯~我说得太多了。为了喝一杯草药茶，我可真是说了不少。我要休息一会儿。

scripts.text: Oh right. You showed some interest when I talked about the dimensional rift fragment.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了。我提到空间裂隙碎片时，你好像很感兴趣。

scripts.text: If you are wondering about something, you can go find my friend ^000099Hiel^000000. He's as crazy as I am, but he's a good guy, hehehe.
scripts.translation: 有疑问就去找我的朋友希尔。他和我一样疯，不过人不错，呵呵呵。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Thanks for being my ears. I don't have the strength to talk any more, so I have to rest up.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你愿意听我说话。我没力气继续聊了，得休息一下。

scripts.text: ^000099Clever seems to be in deep sleep.^000000
I have many other gossip stories. What else do you want to hear about?
scripts.translation: 我还知道不少秘闻。你还想听什么？

scripts.text: Hey hey, who's this? You're my friend from earlier. Hehehe.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿，这位是谁？哦，是之前提到的那位朋友啊。呵呵。

scripts.text: I'm just gonna be on my way.

scripts.translation: 我觉得希尔的实验成功了

scripts.text: What? You don't find any inspiration from hearing my voice? That's sad.
scripts.translation: 什么？听我说话竟然没给你带来灵感？真令人难过。

scripts.text: Hold on... Keep your voice down. What did you just say?
I can't believe it. Did you help him? Wait, that's not the important part. The most important thing is understanding how that was possible.
scripts.translation: 不敢相信！是你帮了他吗？等等，这不重要。最要紧的是弄清楚他是怎么做到的。

scripts.text: Even a non-engineer like me understands that if the rift fragment reacts to pressure, it releases a force beyond understanding.
scripts.translation: 我虽不是工程师，也明白裂隙碎片一旦受到压力并产生反应，就会释放出难以想象的力量。

scripts.text: But I couldn't experience anything related to the rift from here. That means...
scripts.translation: 可我在这里并没有感受到任何裂隙相关的动静。这就说明...

scripts.text: That must mean that it succeeded without any particular side effects...
scripts.translation: 这说明实验成功了，也没有造成什么特别的副作用...

scripts.text: Yes, I see that Hiel must have resolved all technical aspects. Did something happen after the reaction? Could you tell me whatever you saw?
scripts.translation: 没错，看来希尔已经解决了所有技术问题。反应之后发生了什么？把你看到的一切都告诉我吧。

scripts.text: Two Laphines related to home tree appeared? I have to look for the history records that I organized. Wait here.
scripts.translation: 出现了两位与家园之树有关的拉菲尼族？我得找找整理好的史料。你等一下。

scripts.text: This is the area of interest I used to research prior to imprisonment. The history of the birth of Eclage. And they are parts of history that have not been recorded in the official history documents.
scripts.translation: 这就是我入狱前研究的领域：埃克拉珠诞生史。其中有些片段并未记载在官方史书里。

scripts.text: So it's part of the Unofficial history?
scripts.translation: 所以这是非官方史料的一部分？

scripts.text: Even if there are great accomplishments, there are times when those can't be recorded in the history.
scripts.translation: 有些伟大的事迹，也无法载入史册。

scripts.text: If there were ^000099oppositions among Dona forces^000000 of nobility, or ^000099slaughtering among Dona forces^000000, those acts cannot be recorded as official history.
scripts.translation: 如果贵族之间的多纳势力内部存在对立，或是多纳势力内部发生屠戮，官方史书都不会记载这些事。 ^000099^000000^000099^000000

scripts.text: Then how do those accounts get recorded?
scripts.translation: 那这些事又是怎么记录下来的？

scripts.text: Even if you don't want to reveal it, history is history. There is unofficial history as handed down among historians like me.
scripts.translation: 即便有人不愿公开，历史仍然是历史。像我这样的历史学家之间，会口耳相传一些非官方史料。

scripts.text: Of course, there would be thorny pieces of history among the higher-level members of Dona forces. There are a lot of facts distorted for political reasons. My job is to discover those aspects and correct them.
scripts.translation: 多纳势力的高层当然也有许多棘手的历史。很多事实都因政治原因遭到歪曲，而我的工作就是揭露并纠正这些问题。

scripts.text: Could your imprisonment be due to...
scripts.translation: 你被关起来，难道是因为...

scripts.text: No, I was only imprisoned for defacing properties...
scripts.translation: 不是，我只是因为在公物上乱涂乱画才坐牢的...

scripts.text: (I was foolish to expect something like that)
scripts.translation: （我真不该期待会有什么惊天内幕。）

scripts.text: I digressed a bit there. The story of the birth of Eclage is actually an unofficial history record handed down as classified material. But there have been parts of it that were incorrect.
scripts.translation: 我扯远了。埃克拉珠的诞生史，其实是以机密资料形式流传的非官方史料，不过其中有些记载并不准确。

scripts.text: First, the figure with the short hair. He must be the Dona named Etran who was recorded in the unofficial academy. He is the one who argued for Bifrost's recovery.
scripts.translation: 先说那个短发的人物。他应该是非官方学院史料中记载的多纳族埃特兰，主张复兴彩虹桥。

scripts.text: And the figure with the long hair, I'm sure he's a Dona named Robert. He's the head of the group that promoted the recovery of Bifrost and restored home tree.
scripts.translation: 至于长发那位，我确定是名叫罗伯特的多纳族。他带领众人推动彩虹桥复兴，并重建了家园之树。

scripts.text: They were excluded from the official history records for their deep antagonism despite their profound contribution to the birth of Eclage. However...
scripts.translation: 他们为埃克拉珠的诞生立下大功，却因彼此严重对立而被排除在官方史书之外。不过...

scripts.text: How does it seem from your perspective? Eclage is operating so peacefully. It's way too normal for a city that has been antagonized by high-class Donas.
scripts.translation: 你怎么看？埃克拉珠如今运作得如此安稳。要是高阶多纳族之间真的有那么深的仇怨，这座城市不该这么平静才对。

scripts.text: Doesn't really seem that way to me.
scripts.translation: 我倒没觉得有那么严重

scripts.text: Really? But at least take a look at this place's home tree. It's doing just so well! And all of the plant life in Bifrost are vividly alive... If there was an antagonist force, it should have been impossible.
scripts.translation: 是吗？可你看看这里的家园之树，长得多好！彩虹桥的植物也都生机盎然...如果真有敌对势力，这一切根本不可能。

scripts.text: Yes, it is just as you say. This place's home tree is alive and well. And the plant life of Bifrost are also vivacious...
scripts.translation: 没错，正如你所说，这里的家园之树生机勃勃，彩虹桥的植物也欣欣向荣...

scripts.text: If there was really as much antagonism as to be excluded from the history, Eclage and Bifrost could not be the way they are now.
scripts.translation: 如果他们真的对立到要被史书除名，埃克拉珠和如今的彩虹桥就不可能是这副模样。

scripts.text: The explanations would not be enough with just the documents in this jail cell. Hold on a minute. I will let you know where there are book references that you can use to look it up yourself.
scripts.translation: 光凭牢房里的这些文件还不足以解释清楚。等我一下，我告诉你可以去哪里查阅相关书籍。

scripts.text: I came back after viewing those references.
scripts.translation: 我看完那些参考资料后回来了

scripts.text: Looks like you read quite a bit. How did you like that journal? Others claim that it is a third-rate journal, but the information in that journal is actually more accurate than legitimate journals.
scripts.translation: 看来你读了不少。那本期刊怎么样？有人说它是三流刊物，可里面的信息其实比正规期刊还准确。

scripts.text: It's not that the journal itself is very systematic, but more so that it's not examined by the superiors because it's so negatively criticized for being a third-rate.
scripts.translation: 倒不是它的内容有多系统，只是因为被批成三流刊物，上面的人懒得审查它。

scripts.text: I thought that you were a savvy adventurer, but I guess I thought wrong.
scripts.translation: 吗？我还以为你是个机灵的冒险者，看来是我看走眼了。

scripts.text: Hoh~ You seem like you discovered something. Great, what did you find there?
scripts.translation: 哦~看来你发现了什么。很好，说来听听？

scripts.text: Are Dona and Papang in opposition?
scripts.translation: 多纳族和帕潘族彼此对立吗？
问问埃特兰和罗伯特的事
拉菲尼族喜欢君市长吗？

scripts.text: No, Dona and Papang are just words for distinction, not discrimination. Some without thought use them for fun but no one really thinks that way.
scripts.translation: 不，多纳和帕潘只是区分族群的称呼，不带歧视意味。虽然有人随口拿来开玩笑，但没人真这么想。

scripts.text: If you walk around talking about those things without caution, you'll become like me. Yes, certainly, I'm not in here because of that. Like I said before, I was charged for anonymous defacement of properties...
scripts.translation: 你要是不小心到处谈论那些事，就会落得和我一样的下场。当然，我可不是因为这个才被关起来的。就像我说的，我只是因为匿名涂鸦破坏公物被起诉...

scripts.text: ^000099I ended up imagining Clever's daily life of spray painting the walls, remembering the ones I saw in Monthly Eclage. ^000000
scripts.translation: 我不禁想象聪明鬼每天拿喷漆涂墙的样子，和《埃克拉珠月刊》里写的一模一样。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Oh, you talking about Mayor Jun? Just call him His Majesty. He is an idol-like existence to us.
scripts.translation: 哦，你说君市长？叫他陛下就行。他在我们心目中就像偶像一样。

scripts.text: Of course, pure scholars like Hiel and I don't care much for him. I heard he was very beautiful, but I don't really care about the current world.
scripts.translation: 当然，像希尔和我这样的纯粹学者不太在意他。我听说他长得很俊美，不过我对当今世界不怎么关心。

scripts.text: ^000099Along with that, Clever rattled on about things that I had no idea about like 'Valkyries are best. Uncle loves so much'.^000000
scripts.translation: 除此之外，聪明鬼还滔滔不绝地说些我听不懂的话，比如：“瓦尔基里最好了，叔叔最喜欢了。” ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You even looked up stories about Etran and Robert. In fact, we know that most Laphines here were established by the elder assemblies that influenced the noble forces at the time.
scripts.translation: 你还查了埃特兰和罗伯特的故事。事实上，当时这里的大多数拉菲尼族，都是由影响贵族势力的长老议会建立的。

scripts.text: However, the real history was built on the sacrifices of the young Laphines. At first, as a historian, I could not accept that truth.
scripts.translation: 然而，真正的历史是由年轻拉菲尼族的牺牲铸成的。起初，身为历史学家的我也无法接受这个事实。

scripts.text: Unofficial documents that are being constantly discovered always talk about the sacrifies of two young Laphines, so how could they be believed as legitimate?
scripts.translation: 不断出土的非官方文献都提到两位年轻拉菲尼族的牺牲，谁能轻易相信这才是正史呢？

scripts.text: So I tried to present on the topic by writing a related paper but... As expected, the outcome was terrible.
scripts.translation: 于是我试着写论文讨论这件事...结果不出所料，糟透了。

scripts.text: I mean what else could be done? It must have been ridiculous for them since a young scholar was insisting on his ideas just because he didn't like the recorded history.
scripts.translation: 还能怎么办呢？在他们看来，一个年轻学者只是因为不喜欢既有记载，就固执己见，当然很荒唐。

scripts.text: After losing my mind due to the presentation's failure, I was imprisoned after spray painting all Yai's of Eclage with 'Eat dirt you Laphine Official Aacademy scumbags'. Well, I could have avoided being caught.
scripts.translation: 报告发表失败后，我一时失控，在埃克拉珠所有的雅伊上喷了“吃土吧，拉菲尼官方学院的混蛋”，结果就被关起来了。其实我本来可以不被抓到的。

scripts.text: ^000099He's a pit bull to his roots.^000000
Hold on, the prison guard is looking this way. Let's see how he's doing and change the subject for a minute.
scripts.translation: 等等，狱卒正看着这边。先看看

scripts.text: Hold on, the prison guard is looking this way. Let's see how he's doing and change the subject for a minute.
scripts.translation: 他在做什么，暂时换个话题。

scripts.text: Hmm? It wasn't anything? I thought he had a problem with our having this conversation...
scripts.translation: 嗯？没什么事吗？我还以为他不想让我们聊这个呢...

scripts.text: ^000099(No, that's not it!! It's actually the opposite!)^000000
Well, let me make one thing clear. What I'm going to tell you from now, I never told anyone else until now.
scripts.translation: 先说清楚一件事：接下来我要告诉你的秘密，我从未对任何人说过。

scripts.text: If you don't like something about it, or don't want to involve yourself, just forget everything I told you. But if my story interests you, or you have an inkling of desire to help me...
scripts.translation: 如果你不喜欢其中任何内容，或是不想卷入，就把我说的一切都忘掉。但如果我的故事让你感兴趣，或者你愿意帮我...

scripts.text: Could you promise me that you'll keep everything that you hear from me a secret and help me out?
scripts.translation: 你能答应替我保守秘密，并帮我一把吗？

scripts.text: Well I got this far, I'll hear you out.
scripts.translation: 既然都聊到这一步了，我就听你说完

scripts.text: That's too bad. You are the only adventurer that I ever told this much. I guess I can't do much about it. Come back to me when you change your mind.
scripts.translation: 真遗憾。你是唯一一个听我说了这么多的冒险者。既然如此，我也没办法。等你改变主意再来找我吧。

scripts.text: Great. That's a deal. First, I thank you for this favor. I hope that home tree will have many blessings.
scripts.translation: 太好了，一言为定。先谢谢你愿意帮忙。愿家园之树赐福于你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 在获得家园之树的赐福后，你获得了经验值和职业经验值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: The reason why Hiel was researching rift fragments is because he has the same goal as I do. ^000099He wants to resolve things by directly meeting the Laphines of the past by transcending the space-time continuum.^000000
scripts.translation: 希尔研究裂隙碎片，是因为他和我有同一个目标。他想穿越时空，亲自见见过去的拉菲尼族。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: For me, it is to find out the truth about history and for Hiel, it is to obtain one of the limited copies of the interior architectural planning of home tree.
scripts.translation: 我的目标是查明历史真相；希尔的目标，则是取得家园之树内部建筑规划图的限量副本。

scripts.text: Somehow, it feels like Hiel's goal is different.
scripts.translation: 不知为何，感觉希尔的目标和你不太一样

scripts.text: Let him be. He's an engineer, so he has that passion only engineers have. While he sometimes lacks the sense of conventionality, but his ability as an engineer is considered outstanding.
scripts.translation: 随他去吧，他是工程师，有工程师特有的热情。虽然有时不太懂人情世故，但工程本领确实出众。

scripts.text: ^000099Well, even a person like you are far from the normal Laphines, aren't you...? The thought just crosses my mind.^000000
scripts.translation: 不过，像你这样的人也远不算普通的拉菲尼族吧...我脑中突然冒出这个念头。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: While we were talking about history this way, I bet the guy figured out dozens of ways to operate through and apply the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation: 我们聊历史聊到这儿，我敢说那家伙已经想出几十种操作和运用次元裂隙的方法了。

scripts.text: He might be already talking about the engineering manual with the Laphines of the past.
scripts.translation: 他现在说不定正和过去的拉菲尼族讨论工程手册呢

scripts.text: I ask that you would use Hiel's rift tool to meet with the past's Etran and Laphines.
scripts.translation: 麻烦你用希尔的裂隙工具，去见

scripts.text: And it's fine if they're trivial. I just ask that you would record them all in detail and get back to me.
scripts.translation: 哪怕只是些琐事也没关系。请你把所有事情详细记录下来，再回来告诉我。

scripts.text: I ask that you would use Hiel's rift tool to meet with the past's Etran and Laphines.
scripts.translation: 见过去的埃特兰和拉菲尼族。

scripts.text: And it's fine if they're trivial. I just ask that you would record them all in detail and get back to me.
scripts.translation: 哪怕只是些琐事也没关系。请你把所有事情详细记录下来，再回来告诉我。

scripts.text: Yes, did Hiel's research find good outcome?
scripts.translation: 对了，希尔的研究有进展吗？

scripts.text: Tell him about the things that happened.
As expected, the sacrifices of Etran and Robert, two young Donas, built this Eclage. Now it's for certain that the official history is recorded incorrectly.
scripts.translation: 。果然，是埃特兰和罗伯特这两位年轻多纳族牺牲自己，才建立了埃克拉珠。现在可以确定，官方历史记载有误。

scripts.text: Thank you so much. {0} if it weren't for you, I wouldn't have been able to achieve my long-cherished wish.
scripts.translation: 太感谢你了，{0}。要不是有你帮忙，我这辈子的夙愿恐怕就无法实现了。

scripts.text: Oh, wait... The two friends reunited together again, right?
scripts.translation: 哦，等等...那两位朋友后来重逢了吗？

scripts.text: I'm sure they would sometime soon, right?
scripts.translation: 我想他们很快就会重逢吧？

scripts.text: Yes, I guess we wouldn't know that at this point.
scripts.translation: 也是，现在的我们无从得知。

scripts.text: Well, I guess that doesn't matter anymore!
I feel like I accomplished something truly significant! Shall we sing?!
scripts.translation: 觉得自己完成了一件大事！来唱歌吧？！

scripts.text: ^000099I can see Etran's face through Clever's smile. This must be from the joy he's feeling.^000000
scripts.translation: 看着聪明鬼的笑容，我仿佛看到了埃特兰的脸。那一定是因为他心中充满喜悦。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Thank you for hearing me out all this time. Thanks to you, after my release from prison, I have much to record into the history with full confidence. In return, I will pray for home tree's blessings.
scripts.translation: 谢谢你一直听我倾诉。多亏了你，等我出狱后，就能满怀信心地把许多事写进历史。作为回报，我会祈求家园之树赐福于你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving the blessings to home tree from Clever, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 聪明鬼为你祈求家园之树的祝福后，你获得了基础经验值和职业经验值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Clever is diligently transcribing things on paper.^000000
scripts.translation: 聪明鬼正专心地誊写纸上的内容。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品种类好像太多了。减少种类后再试试吧。

scripts.text: It is said that the leaves from home tree have the length X with the average m and standard deviation of 4. If P(m<X<a)=0.3413 ... (Mumble mumble)
scripts.translation: 据说家园之树的叶长为X，平均值是m，标准差为4。若P(m<X<a)=0.3413...（喃喃自语）

scripts.text: ^0000ffIt doesn't look like I'll understand anything he says. Let's get out of here.^000000
scripts.translation: 他说的我好像完全听不懂。还是先离开这里吧。 ^0000ff^000000

scripts.text: Hmm? What brings a human traveler to my room? This is not a room that anyone can enter.
scripts.translation: 嗯？是什么风把人类旅行者吹到我的房间来了？这里可不是谁都能进的。

scripts.text: I was referred to meet you here.
Oh~ Someone referred you to me? Who was it? You better make sense, or I'll be sure to kick you out.
scripts.translation: 哦~有人介绍你来的？是谁？最好说清楚，不然我可要把你赶出去。

scripts.text: Oh really? Give me a minute. I'm going to wrap up what I am doing and come back.
scripts.translation: 这样啊？等我一下，我先把手头的事做完，马上回来。

scripts.text: I don't know that person! Aren't you suspicious!
scripts.translation: 我不认识那个人！你很可疑啊！

scripts.text: I don't really believe that you could have a normal conversation with the socially inept Clever, but I'll at least give you the benefit of the doubt. So, what did he tell you?
scripts.translation: 我不太相信你能和不善交际的聪明鬼正常聊天，不过姑且先信你一次吧。他跟你说了什么？

scripts.text: A story about the Seneth King's father
scripts.translation: 关于塞内斯王父亲的故事

scripts.text: A story about Seneth King's arsony
scripts.translation: 关于塞内斯王纵火的故事

scripts.text: The assistant chief of staff's real name
A dimensional rift in nearby regions
How uninteresting. I'm busy so why don't you go on your way.
scripts.translation: 真无聊。我很忙，你还是走吧。

scripts.text: I don't have much interest in the rumors about the royalty here.
scripts.translation: 我对这里的王族传闻没兴趣。呵~你还真会找话题。就像聪明鬼可能告诉你的，我房间里有一块次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text: I don't even know how this gossip is going to useful for me. Is this all you talked about with Clever?
scripts.translation: 我实在不明白这些八卦对我有什么用。你和聪明鬼就聊了这些？呵~你还真会找话题。就像聪明鬼可能告诉你的，我房间里有一块次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text: The current name of the assistant chief of staff is not real?
scripts.translation: 参谋长现在用的名字不是真名？

scripts.text: I mean, even so, how does that matter to me? I'd rather just continue my research.
scripts.translation: 就算如此，又关我什么事？我还是继续研究好了。

scripts.text: Hoh~ You really know how to find an interesting topic. As Clever may have told you, I have in my room a fragment of the dimensional rift.
scripts.translation: 呵~你还真会找话题。就像聪明鬼可能告诉你的，我房间里有一块次元裂隙碎片。

scripts.text: ^000099Hie, super excited, showed me a weird container filled with rubble and talked on and on for 30 minutes.^000000
scripts.translation: 希尔兴奋地拿出一个装满碎石的奇怪容器给我看，还滔滔不绝地讲了半个小时。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This is... irritating on a different level from Clever. I have to somehow stop his nonstop talking...^000000
scripts.translation: 这家伙的烦人方式和聪明鬼截然不同。我得想办法让他停下这没完没了的讲话... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Ask how the fragment was obtained
So what can you do with this?
Well, I am working on figuring that out. The past and the future. I just know for sure that you can trascend the conception of space and overcome the dimensional barriers.
scripts.translation: 我正在研究它的用途：过去、未来...我只确定一点，它能突破空间概念与次元屏障。

scripts.text: If you can operate the rift fragment properly, it would not be very hard to meet ^000099historical figures of the past^000000.
scripts.translation: 只要能正确操作裂隙碎片，见到过去的历史人物应该不难。哦...嗯...（泄气...） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Not too long ago, there was a huge dimensional rift. Although, lots of Laphine soldiers are regulating the area now.
scripts.translation: 不久前那里出现了一道巨大的次元裂隙。不过现在有许多拉菲尼族士兵在那一带巡逻。

scripts.text: Very briefly, for research purposes, they allowed access to the area. That's when I slipped one for myself.
scripts.translation: 简单来说，他们为了研究开放了那片区域，我就趁机偷偷拿了一块出来。

scripts.text: Of course, if this is discovered, I would immediately be jailed. So please don't let anyone else know.
scripts.translation: 当然，这事要是被发现，我马上就会坐牢。所以千万别告诉别人。哦...嗯...（泄气...）

scripts.text: Why are you getting down on yourself?
You see, I tried everything possible. Haha... This rift fragment won't listen to me at all. It is essentially void of any reaction.
scripts.translation: 我什么办法都试过了。哈哈...这块裂隙碎片根本不理我，几乎毫无反应。

scripts.text: What I really desire is to witness with my own eyes the kind of chemical reaction given off by this metaphysical thing.
scripts.translation: 我最想亲眼看看这件超自然物质会产生怎样的化学反应。

scripts.text: But it's not like I have the necessary resources or information... (Mumble mumble)
scripts.translation: 可我既没有所需的资源，也没有相关资料...（喃喃自语）
这家伙情绪起伏也太大了吧！ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099How does someone get so depressed so quickly?! ^000000
I heard that you human beings have succeeded in combining the right materials to create a reaction with the rift fragment. Is that true?
scripts.translation: 我听说你们人类已经把合适的材料组合起来，成功让裂隙碎片产生反应了。是真的吗？
我就是这样来到这里的

scripts.text: I guess those cats were right.
Guys who regarded themselves as former cat merchants came by here to sell books containing the knowledge of Midgard humans.
scripts.translation: 有几个自称前猫族商人的家伙来这里卖书，书里记载着米德加尔特人类的知识。

scripts.text: At that time, they told me that they knew the contents of humans' rift experiments, so I called them liars and kicked them out.
scripts.translation: 他们当时说知道人类进行裂隙实验的内容，我不信，就把他们当骗子赶走了。

scripts.text: Cats don't mess around with money.
Oh, is that right? I guess what they said was true. I'm really sorry to ask you this favor, but would you mind retrieving that information from them?
scripts.translation: 哦，是这样吗？看来他们说的是真的。真不好意思麻烦你，能帮我去找他们拿回那些资料吗？

scripts.text: I would like to go myself, but as you can see, I have to continue my research... And... (Fidget fidget)
scripts.translation: 我也想亲自去，可你看，我还得继续研究...而且...（扭捏）

scripts.text: Oh, are you here to help me out? I guess what they said was true. I'm really sorry to ask you this favor, but would you mind retrieving that information from them?
scripts.translation: 哦，你是来帮忙的吗？看来他们说得没错。不好意思要麻烦你，能帮我从他们那里取回那些资料吗？

scripts.text: Hmm, I'd like to, but I'm busy myself...
scripts.translation: 嗯，我是想帮忙，可我自己也很忙...

scripts.text: Sure, I'll go check it out.
Oh... I guess it was too much to ask for. That's too bad then.
scripts.translation: 哦...看来是我强人所难了。真遗憾。

scripts.text: Wow wow! Thank you so much! I'll return the favor by operating it together when the experiments are complete! In the meantime, I'll start preparing for material combination!
scripts.translation: 哇哇！太感谢你了！实验完成后，我会和你一起操作，报答你的帮忙！趁这段时间，我先准备材料组合！

scripts.text: Cat merchants are stationed at various places in El Dicastes which is far east of Mora village. I am not exactly sure which of those really have that information...
scripts.translation: 穆拉村以东很远的埃尔迪卡斯特，各处都驻扎着猫族商人。我不太确定哪位手里有那些资料...

scripts.text: Tell him about the materials necessary.
I see, both Dark Debris and Gem Stone are unfamiliar to me. Could it be that my work was just impossible to begin with...?
scripts.translation: 原来如此，暗黑碎片和宝石我都没听说过。难道我的研究从一开始就注定不可能...？

scripts.text: It does seem impossible. You should give up.
scripts.translation: 看来确实不可能。你还是放弃吧

scripts.text: I see, I guess changing the very physics is an impossible thing...
scripts.translation: 原来如此，改变物理法则果然是不可能的...

scripts.text: Would you do that for me?? If so, I have nothing more to ask!
scripts.translation: 你愿意替我做这件事吗？那我就没别的要求了！

scripts.text: Ooo, so this is what is called Dark Debris. I'm so glad that I can continue my experiments.
scripts.translation: 哦，原来这就是暗黑碎片。太好了，我的实验可以继续了。

scripts.text: I didn't say that I'd just give them to you.
scripts.translation: 我可没说要把它们给你

scripts.text: How ruthless... Saying that he won't give them after showing them to me.
scripts.translation: 也太无情了吧...给我看了，却又不肯给。

scripts.text: Wow~ This will be a big step forward in the scientific progress among the Laphines. I pray for your home tree's blessings.
scripts.translation: 哇~这会让拉菲尼族的科学向前迈出一大步。愿家园之树保佑你。

scripts.text: ^000099Upon receiving Scientist Hiel's blessings to home tree, you gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你获得了科学家希尔给予的家园之树祝福，并得到基础经验值和职业经验值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Wait, but where is the material you are talking about? I don't see it.
scripts.translation: 等等，你说的材料呢？我没看到啊。

scripts.text: Hmm... But this is very strange. I arranged them exactly the way it says on the documents, but why isn't there any reaction?
scripts.translation: 嗯...真奇怪。我明明完全按照文件上的说明摆好了，为什么一点反应也没有？

scripts.text: Hmm. Is it this way? No, that's not it. Is it this way? Okay here. We'll put this guy over here. And there.
scripts.translation: 嗯，是这样吗？不对。这样摆吗？好，就放这里。再把那个放到那边。

scripts.text: Ahh~ Why isn't this working! You, you have to react when I place you like this!! Ahh nothing is working! Whoa, it slipped from my hand! (CLASH)
scripts.translation: 啊~怎么还是不行！我把你摆成这样，你就该有反应啊！！什么都不管用！哎呀，滑出手了！（哐当）

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel, moving wildly for lack of reaction, dropped the Dark Debris to the floor. At this rate, it might shatter...^000000
scripts.translation: 希尔因迟迟没有反应而手忙脚乱，把暗黑碎片掉在地上。再这样下去，它可能会摔碎... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: I grabbed it before it dropped to the floor.
scripts.translation: 我赶在它落地前接住了

scripts.text: Hey, how can you handle something like this so carelessly! This is hard to find!
scripts.translation: 你怎么能这么不小心！这东西很难找的！

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as the Dark Debris was placed in the middle of Hiel's arrangement, everything went dark and a strange voice appeared out of nowhere.^000000
scripts.translation: 暗黑碎片刚放到希尔摆设的中央，四周便陷入黑暗，一个陌生的声音凭空响起。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Ok, let's say that you restore home tree first. Then what? What are you going to do about all of the energy it's going to suck from the land?
scripts.translation: 好吧，假设你先让家园之树复苏，然后呢？它会从土地吸走大量能量，你打算怎么办？

scripts.text: You might be right. To restore home tree, we will probably need a life force that is beyond our imagination. But even so, home tree must be revived.
scripts.translation: 你或许说得对。要让家园之树复苏，恐怕需要超乎想象的生命力。即便如此，我们还是必须让它复苏。

scripts.text: Then what are you going to do about all the other living creatures? The land might grow barren for at least decades, or even centuries. Are things aside from home tree not even considered living?
scripts.translation: 那其他生灵怎么办？土地可能会荒芜几十年，甚至几百年。难道除了家园之树，其他生命都不算生命吗？

scripts.text: Even if you sustain other life forms, it won't be for long without home tree. We have to tolerate the immediate losses. Don't you know that, Etran?!
scripts.translation: 就算保住其他生命，没有家园之树也撑不了多久。我们必须承受眼前的损失。埃特兰，你不明白吗？！

scripts.text: Sure, it would be easy to restore the land after we revive home tree!
scripts.translation: 等家园之树复苏之后，恢复土地当然就容易了！

scripts.text: But do we even have the right to let all other life forms die while we wait until home tree revives?
scripts.translation: 可我们有权让其他生命在等待家园之树复苏时死去吗？

scripts.text: I don't think anyone has that right! No one!
scripts.translation: 我不认为任何人有这种权利！谁都没有！

scripts.text: You are dreaming big, Etran. In any case, this isn't something that we can solve by arguing. I'm going to follow the decision of the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation: 埃特兰，你想得太理想了。总之，这不是争论就能解决的问题。我会遵从长老议会的决定。

scripts.text: Did you see that just now?! The weird sounds. Ahhh~ I'm an engineer who does not believe in spiritual things. Is it because I haven't studied enough? How could there be such an illogical occurrence?!
scripts.translation: 你刚才看见了吗？！那些奇怪的声音！啊~我可是个不信鬼神的工程师。难道是我研究得还不够？怎么会发生这么不合逻辑的事？！

scripts.text: Yes, what I heard was the same. I don't know what that was. And I never heard anything about reviving a home tree.
scripts.translation: 没错，我听到的也是这些。我不知道刚才那是什么，而且从没听说过复苏家园之树的事。

scripts.text: Ok, there's no other way. If it's not of our imagination, we have to confirm it again to identify what that sound really was. We have to make sure that it's just just some hallucinations.
scripts.translation: 好吧，只能再确认一次，弄清楚那声音究竟是什么。我们得确认那只是一场幻觉。

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel took more time to rethe arrangements = but the rift fragment did not react to any of his movements.^000000
scripts.translation: 希尔花了更多时间重新摆放装置，但裂隙碎片对他的操作仍毫无反应。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Looks like whatever I do won't let it react. Do you want to give it a try yourself?
scripts.translation: 看来我怎么弄它都没反

scripts.text: Looks like whatever I do won't let it react. Do you want to give it a try yourself?
I don't think this is anything spiritual, but rather a moment from the past.
scripts.translation: 我觉得这不是什么灵异现象，而是过去某个时刻的影像。

scripts.text: Do you have an idea of whose those voices may be?
scripts.translation: 你觉得那些声音可能是谁发出的？

scripts.text: No, no, I have no historical knowledge. But I do have a friend who is truly an expert in that field. He's also the person you met recently.
scripts.translation: 不，我不懂历史。不过我有位朋友是这方面的专家，而且你最近刚见过他。

scripts.text: Yeah, that's him. He really has problems with his social skills that left him in prison. In historical knowledge, he is truly unparallel.
scripts.translation: 没错，就是他。他社交能力差得很，才会坐牢。不过论历史知识，他无人能及。

scripts.text: If you want to figure out more about the content of that dialogue, it would be better to go and ask him. In the meantime, I'll analyze the arrangement of this.
scripts.translation: 想弄清楚那段对话的内容，最好去问问他。我会继续研究这个装置。

scripts.text: If you would like to find out more about the dialogue heard in the reaction, go talk to Clever in prison. He is far better than I am in that field.
scripts.translation: 想了解刚才听到的对话，就去监狱找聪明鬼吧。他比我更懂那方面的事。

scripts.text: While you are gone, I tried constructing a portable rift reactor, but I think there is a slight problem.
scripts.translation: 你不在的时候，我试着造了一台便携式裂隙反应器，不过好像有点问题。

scripts.text: Who in the world are you! How are you looking just like me? Answer me! Are you an imposter established by the Elder Assembly to be used after assassinating me?!
scripts.translation: 你到底是谁！为什么长得和我一模一样？回答我！你是长老议会派来刺杀我、再顶替我的冒牌货吗？！

scripts.text: Excuse me, please calm down and listen to me. My name is Hiel and the Elder Assembly no longer exists in the world.
scripts.translation: 请先冷静下来听我解释。我叫希尔，长老议会早已不复存在了。

scripts.text: You see... This is very complicated to explain... Where do I start...
scripts.translation: 这个嘛...实在太复杂了...我该从哪儿说起...

scripts.text: ^000099A Dona that looks surprisingly similar to Hiel (^990000Although he seems so much more dignified...^000099) is holding Hiel by his collar. Who could that Dona be?^000000
scripts.translation: 一个与希尔惊人相似的多纳族正揪着他的衣领（不过那人看起来威严得多...）。那位多纳族究竟是谁？ ^000099^990000^000099^000000

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but who are you?
scripts.translation: 不好意思，请问您是哪位？

scripts.text: I am a high-level Laphine Life Restorer. How are you related to this look-alike of mine?
scripts.translation: 00000。我是高阶拉菲尼族生命复原师。你和这个长得像我的人是什么关系？

scripts.text: ^000099Robert?... Is this the Life Restorer whose sillouette I've been seeing all this time?^000000
scripts.translation: 罗伯特？...难道这就是我一直看到的那位生命复原师的身影？ ^000099^000000
把事情经过解释给他听

scripts.text: Hmm, this is very difficult for me to comprehend. So you are saying that you are from thousands of years away? My head is beginning to hurt.
scripts.translation: 嗯，这实在难以理解。你是说自己来自几千年以后？我听得头都疼了。

scripts.text: Yes, but if I were to let you know another thing...
scripts.translation: 没错，不过我还想告诉你另一件事...

scripts.text: The engineer scientist Hiel and Sir Robert are very similar in appearance, but the way he carries himself is extremely different. So please refrain yourself from stating that the two look alike. It hurts me to listen.
scripts.translation: 工程师希尔和罗伯特爵士长得很像，可举止截然不同。请别再说你们长得相像了，听得我都难受。

scripts.text: I thought I was looking into a mirror.
scripts.translation: 我还以为自己在照镜子呢。

scripts.text: To hear that we are so different in quality, I am quite offended... At any rate, let me explain the current situation.
scripts.translation: 听说我们气质差这么多，我可有点受打击...总之，先让我说明一下目前的情况。

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel added his explanation of his research up to now. Robert seemed to follow most of the story.^000000
scripts.translation: 希尔补充说明了他迄今为止的研究，罗伯特似乎听懂了大半。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: That's the basic gist. Anyways, I'm having trouble remaining calm. I can't believe you, Sir Robert, really existed.
scripts.translation: 大致情况就是这样。总之，我实在很难冷静下来。真不敢相信罗伯特爵士真的存在！

scripts.text: You are like a legend to all engineering scientists. It's almost difficult to believe a person like you existed in the past.
scripts.translation: 对所有工程师来说，您简直是传奇人物。很难相信过去真的有您这样的人。

scripts.text: It's just so incredible how you were able to construct home tree in its amazing form by amalgamating the life and the setting.
scripts.translation: 您竟能将生命与环境融为一体，建造出如此壮观的家园之树，真是不可思议。

scripts.text: home tree... I can't believe it grew back... It was nearly an impossible task. It has restored to its full form in the future of thousands of years later?
scripts.translation: 家园之树...我真不敢相信它重新长起来了...这几乎是不可能完成的任务。几千年后的未来，它真的恢复了原貌？

scripts.text: It's true. I can show it to you if you'd like.
scripts.translation: 没错。您想看的话，我可以带您去

scripts.text: I thought it was impossible. In the end, it actually succeeded in the future. Please take me to home tree immediately! If you lied to me, I won't let you off easy.
scripts.translation: 我原以为绝无可能，没想到未来竟真的成功了。快带我去家园之树！你要是骗我，我可不会轻饶你。

scripts.text: His personality is like fire. If you would like to lead the way to home tree, please exit this place and go to the center of the plaza.
scripts.translation: 他的性子像火一样。如果你想前往家园之树，请离开这里，到广场中央去。

scripts.text: Hmm... I think this is the problematic area here. Darn, I should have had studied more.
scripts.translation: 嗯...问题应该出在这里。可恶，我早该多做些研究的。
罗伯特在交谈中消失了

scripts.text: Oh, that error. Hoh... Oh no! It's a problem that I did not anticipate.
scripts.translation: 哦，是那个故障啊。呵...糟了！我没料到会出这种问题。

scripts.text: Ahahhaa, no, it's not like that. I just found out a few minor problems while operating the portable rift reactor.
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈，没那么严重。我只是操作便携式裂隙反应器时发现了几个小问题。
