scripts.text: This thing is made portable, so the output is not very strong. In other words, the range of reaction is very limited.
scripts.translation: 这台机器为了方便携带，输出功率不高。也就是说，反应范围很有限。

scripts.text: To find Sir Robert, this machine's chronological frequency is set at the time right when we encountered him. We will be able to meet him many times over.
scripts.translation: 为了找到罗伯特爵士，我把机器的时间频率设定在与他相遇的那个时刻。我们可以多次和他见面。

scripts.text: The only problem is that... it has to be at a designated location.
scripts.translation: 唯一的问题是...必须在指定地点使用。

scripts.text: Does that mean it can't be at any other location?
scripts.translation: 所以不能在别的地方使用吗？

scripts.text: I think so, according to my estimation. Entities with life cannot communicate beyond the range of this reactor while inanimate objects are not affected the same way.
scripts.translation: 根据我的估算，应该不行。生命体无法在反应器范围之外交流，无生命物体却不受同样的限制。

scripts.text: ^000099(Holding up a very worn out pen)^000000 The pen that Sir Robert was using is still here as proof even though we lost contact with him.
scripts.translation: （举起一支磨损严重的钢笔）即使我们失去了联系，罗伯特爵士用过的钢笔仍留在这里，作为证据。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Then could we also meet his contemporary, Etran?
scripts.translation: 那我们也能见到和罗伯特同时代的埃特兰吗？

scripts.text: Theorectically, we could. However, we have to go to the location where he may have been. No matter how many times we operate this reactor here, we can only meet Robert.
scripts.translation: 理论上可以。不过得去他当时可能在的地点。在这里无论启动多少次反应器，都只能见到罗伯特。

scripts.text: We could expand this machine's output to increase the range, but at this time it's not possible. We can't do much else for now.
scripts.translation: 提高这台机器的输出功率，就能扩大范围，但现在还办不到。眼下我们也没别的办法。

scripts.text: Would you let me see that reactor for a minute?
scripts.translation: 能让我看看那台反应器吗？

scripts.text: I don't know how long it will take. It would be difficult to meet Etran and Robert simultaneously for now.
scripts.translation: 我也不知道还要多久。目前恐怕没法同时见到埃特兰和罗伯特。

scripts.text: You are not thinking of taking this out to Bifrost, are you? I think you are taking things too far. It's probably too dangerous.
scripts.translation: 你该不会想把它带去彩虹桥吧？这也太冒险了，实在危险。

scripts.text: I am a person who made it all the way here alive and well.
scripts.translation: 我可是一路平安地活着走到这里的

scripts.text: Don't you want to test out your theory?
scripts.translation: 你不想验证自己的理论吗？

scripts.text: No, I'm not worried about you. I'm worried that this precious reactor will break.
scripts.translation: 我才不是担心你。我担心这台宝贝反应器会坏掉

scripts.text: (It is so obvious that Hiel is genuinely in a dilemma)
Surely, it is dangerous. But what you're saying is right. The engineer's blood that runs through me wants to test this machine out.
scripts.translation: 确实危险。不过你说得没错，我身为工程师，真的很想试试这台机器。

scripts.text: Arg. Well, it can't be helped! Please be careful with this! While I do have a spare, that's the only one with the correct chronological frequency settings!
scripts.translation: 唉，好吧！没办法了。请务必小心！我虽然有备用机，但只有这台设定了正确的时间频率！

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel's rift reactor was obtained. The energy from the reactor feels like it's channeling through the body.
scripts.translation: 获得了希尔的裂隙反应器。反应器的能量仿佛在你体内流动。 ^000099

scripts.text: You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 你获得了基础经验值和职业经验值。 ^000000

scripts.text: Please handle the reactor with care. That's the only one we can use at this time...
scripts.translation: 小心操作反应器。目前能用的只有这一台...

scripts.text: You're back. {0} While you were gone, I added various functionalities onto the spare rift reactor.
scripts.translation: 你回来了，{0}。你不在的时候，我给备用裂隙反应器加了不少功能。

scripts.text: Now the rift will react wherever you are at the speed of light. Also infinite data transfer is now made available. Ah, what should I call this?
scripts.translation: 现在无论你身在何处，裂隙都会以光速产生反应。此外还实现了无限数据传输。啊，该给它起个什么名字呢？

scripts.text: Can we obtain a leaf of home tree?
scripts.translation: 能拿到一片家园之树的叶子吗？

scripts.text: Huh? Even if the reactor were to be very capable, it can't possibly do something like creating a home tree leaf. That just couldn't be. This is merely a communicator.
scripts.translation: 什么？反应器再厉害，也不可能凭空造出家园之树的叶子。这根本办不到，它只是个通讯器。

scripts.text: Explain to him the promise made with Etran.
scripts.translation: 向他说明你和埃特兰的约定

scripts.text: Hmm, even so, that's very difficult. Any action that harms a home tree leaf is illegal in Eclage. The consequence is immediate exile.
scripts.translation: 嗯，即使如此也很难。损害家园之树的叶子在埃克拉珠是违法的，会被立即流放。

scripts.text: Besides, dried up home tree leaves don't just drop to the ground, but transform into life energy and spread throughout the land. It's impossible to even pick them up as dried leaves.
scripts.translation: 而且，枯萎的家园之树叶不会落到地上，而是化成生命能量散布到各处。连枯叶都捡不到。

scripts.text: Hmm... I wonder if there's a way.
It won't be illegal if the creator of home tree himself hands you its leaf.
scripts.translation: 如果由家园之树的创造者亲手把叶子交给你，那就不违法了。

scripts.text: That's right. I don't know why I didn't think of that earlier. If it's Robert who gives you the home tree leaf, it would be perfectly fine.
scripts.translation: 没错。我怎么之前没想到呢？只要是罗伯特亲手交给你的家园之树叶子，就完全没问题。

scripts.text: Let's try channeling our way to Robert. Well... This isn't exactly to test out the machine's new functionality. (Hesitating)
scripts.translation: 我们试着通过机器联系罗伯特吧。嗯...这倒不完全是为了测试机器的新功能。（犹豫）
那就试着联系罗伯特吧

scripts.text: Hmm, that's too bad. If you are thinking of attacking home tree, it's way too dangerous. You'll just be jailed.
scripts.translation: 嗯，真遗憾。要是你想攻击家园之树，那也太危险了，只会害你被关进监狱。

scripts.text: Now, shall we start our communication? Place your hand on the reactor here.
scripts.translation: 那我们开始通讯吧。把手放在这里的反应器上。

scripts.text: It always feels like looking into a mirror whenever I meet Sir Robert...
scripts.translation: 每次见到罗伯特爵士，都像是在照镜子...

scripts.text: Not in the least bit delightful...
I only met him twice, and I feel really familiar and somewhat nostalgic when I meet him. I don't know how to call it. It's just a very familiar feeling.
scripts.translation: 我只见过他两次，可每次见到他都觉得很亲切，甚至有些怀念。我也说不上来，就是有种熟悉的感觉。

scripts.text: Oh, anyways, don't you lose your focus on the reactor. It is currently connecting.
scripts.translation: 哦，对了，集中精神看着反应器。现在正在连接。

scripts.text: Hey hey~ Now it's almost complete.
scripts.translation: 嘿~现在差不多快完成了。

scripts.text: The current range of this reactor surpasses Eclage and reaches Bifrost.
scripts.translation: 反应器的范围已经超出埃克拉珠，延伸到了彩虹桥。

scripts.text: If I modify it a bit, I am sure I could even freely select the time point of interest.
scripts.translation: 稍作改造后，我肯定就能自由选择要前往的时间点了。

scripts.text: Etran wanted me to thank you on his behalf.
scripts.translation: 埃特兰托我代他向你道谢

scripts.text: Really? I'm glad... I would like to one day help Sir Etran and Sir Robert to reunite within this reactor.
scripts.translation: 真的吗？太好了...希望有一天能让埃特兰大人和罗伯特大人在这台反应器中重逢。

scripts.text: ^000099Instantly, Hiel's smile reminded me of Robert. I must have been in the moment.^000000
scripts.translation: 希尔的笑容一下子让我想起罗伯特。我大概是被当时的气氛感染了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Oh, hello~ I'm busy as usual, ahah.
scripts.translation: 哦，你好~我还是一如既往地忙，哈哈。

scripts.text: I just came by to say hi.
scripts.translation: 我只是顺道来打个招呼
请求调整埃特兰的项链

scripts.text: Well, there's really nothing else to improve. I'll let you, {0}, especially to use this whenever you want.
scripts.translation: 嗯，已经没什么可改进的了。我特别允许你，{0}，随时使用这台机器。

scripts.text: Please come anytime to use it. I made it to reach a variety of time channels, but I don't exactly know what will come of it myself.
scripts.translation: 随时都可以来用。我把它改造成能连接各种时间通道，不过连我也不知道最后会连到哪里。

scripts.text: You mean Sir Etran's keepsake? I could try to utilize a special magic power stone to imbue the desired effects, but it is an expensive material costing 10 Splendide Coins...
scripts.translation: 你是说埃特兰大人的信物？我可以试着用特殊魔力石赋予它想要的效果，不过材料很贵，要10枚辉煌领域硬币...

scripts.text: I guess I'll come back next time...
Sure, let me know when you have them ready. I'll imbue the desired effects.
scripts.translation: 好，准备好后告诉我，我就为它赋予效果。

scripts.text: Oh ok, then should we try imbuing the effects? This process isn't my specialty so I'm a bit nervous, but... hahaha...
scripts.translation: 好，那我们现在就赋予效果吗？这不是我的专长，我有点紧张...哈哈。

scripts.text: Sure, let me know when you have them ready. I'll restore its effects.
scripts.translation: 好，准备好后告诉我，我会恢复它的效果。

scripts.text: It looks like you don't have enough coins. I would like to take care of it for you, but the material is just way too expensive...
scripts.translation: 你带的硬币好像不够。我很想帮你，可材料实在太贵了...

scripts.text: You don't seem to carry Etran's keepsake with you right now.
scripts.translation: 你身上好像没带埃特兰的信物。

scripts.text: Hmm, what else should I fix. I should have had studied more...
scripts.translation: 嗯，还要修什么来着？我真该多做些研究...

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品种类好像太多了。减少种类后再试试吧。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我身上的东西好像太重了。减轻负重后再试试吧。

scripts.text: ^000099He is busy fighting against Ford. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: 他正忙着和福特打架。再不阻止的话，可能就没机会跟他说话了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Where did you find that canned food?
scripts.translation: 你从哪儿弄来那些罐头的？

scripts.text: I brought it for you guys.
You are a human being and you eat canned food? What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你一个人类居然吃罐头？你在搞什么？

scripts.text: Shelby is looking away!! Ford doesn't miss this chance! (Pow pow)
scripts.translation: 谢尔比分心了！！福特不会放过这个机会！（砰砰）

scripts.text: ^000099The fight continues. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: 战斗还在继续。再不阻止的话，可能就没机会跟他说话了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: should I really receive this from you?......
scripts.translation: 你真的要把这个给我吗？...

scripts.text: Forget it if you don't want it.
Nah, I'm just kidding! Why would I?
scripts.translation: 骗你的啦！我怎么会不要呢？

scripts.text: Alright. What is it that you want? Is it what you asked earlier, about dimensional rift fragment?
scripts.translation: 好吧，你想要什么？是之前问过的次元裂隙碎片相关资料吗？

scripts.text: Ask about activating the rift fragment.
scripts.translation: 询问如何启动次元裂隙碎片

scripts.text: I see, that is what you wanted. It was really difficult to find out since even Midgard scientists try to keep the information away from everyone. Although the information itself was relatively simple compared to the security for it.
scripts.translation: 原来你想要这个。找到资料可不容易，连米德加尔特的科学家都想把它保密。不过比起重重防护，资料内容本身倒挺简单。

scripts.text: First, to activate the dimensional rift fragment, you need ^0000991 Dark Debris ^000000 to serve as a host. Since the fragment reacts with Moroq's body, you need something that at least resembles it.
scripts.translation: 首先，要启动次元裂隙碎片，需要1份暗黑碎片作为载体。碎片会和梦罗克的身体产生反应，所以载体至少得和它相似。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you have Dark Crystal, you could exert a greater force, but I could not attain that combination method.
scripts.translation: 如果有暗黑水晶，产生的力量会更强，不过我没能弄清楚那种组合方法。

scripts.text: If I were to arrange all of the ingredients, you need ^0000991Dark Debris ^000000in addition to ^000099Red/Yellow/Blue Gemstones, 2 of each^000000.

When you create a reaction with rift fragment with the Dark Debris as the host, the surrounding is placed under much metaphysical force. At that time, if you don't have something to offthat side effect = what would happen?
scripts.translation: 以暗黑碎片为载体和裂隙碎片反应时，周围会受到强烈的超自然力量影响。要是不拿东西抵消副作用，你猜会怎样？

scripts.text: You probably have seen it before. Like the dimensional rift found in Morocc, the area surrounding it deteriorates. The sacrificial fodder to prevent that are the gemstones.
scripts.translation: 你应该见过类似情况。梦罗克的次元裂隙周围就会逐渐衰败。宝石原石就是用来吸收影响的牺牲品。

scripts.text: Now, did I explain that enough? But why are you trying to activate such dangerous items as rift fragments? Are you trying to hold a ritual of summoning from hell or something?
scripts.translation: 这下解释清楚了吧？不过你为什么要启动这么危险的裂隙碎片？想举行什么地狱召唤仪式吗？

scripts.text: First hand him the canned food.
Hmm? What happened to the canned food you had until a minute ago? Why are your hands empty now?
scripts.translation: 咦？你刚才手里还有罐头，怎么一下子不见了？现在怎么两手空空？

scripts.text: Oh! Thanks! This is the first time to receive salary from a human being. I bless your future in the name of the Leopard God.
scripts.translation: 哦！谢啦！这是我第一次收到人类发的薪水。我以豹神之名祝福你的未来。

scripts.text: ^000099Shelby's chubby front paw pats your back to bless you. You gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 谢尔比用胖乎乎的前爪拍了拍你的背，为你送上祝福。你获得了基础经验值和职业经验值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: If you want cat merchant service, you should look for the agent, not me.
scripts.translation: 嗯？想用猫族商人的服务

scripts.text: If you want cat merchant service, you should look for the agent, not me.
scripts.translation: 就去找代理人，别来找我。

scripts.text: Why? Is it weird to see me after seeing all the cats that are so polite and overly excited?
scripts.translation: 怎么，见过那些礼貌又热情过头的猫之后，再看到我就觉得奇怪吗？

scripts.text: Meow~ How are youeow~ I really liked canned fisheow~!!...Is this what you wanted?
scripts.translation: 喵~你好吗喵~我最喜欢鱼罐头喵~！！...这就是你想听的吗？

scripts.text: Just because we are cats, it doesn't mean we are all the same. I'm also really depressed right now, so it's probably best for you to look for other cats to help you.
scripts.translation: 我们虽然都是猫，可也各不相同。我现在心情也很差，你还是去找别的猫帮忙吧。

scripts.text: Haha, I can't believe you are asking a cat about that. Our science is not something a lot of people pay attention to. We have our biggest interest in commerce and fishery.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，真不敢相信你会问一只猫这种事。没多少人关心我们的科学，我们最感兴趣的还是贸易和渔业。

scripts.text: Here's an advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation: 听我一句劝，别在我这儿浪费时间，去找别人帮忙吧。

scripts.text: Here's some advice. Don't waste your time with me. Look for other people to help you out.
scripts.translation: 听我一句劝，别在我这儿浪费时间，去找别人帮忙吧。

scripts.text: Let me remind you before you forget, the materials you need to activate the rift fragment are ^000099 1 Dark Debris, 2 of each red/yellow/blue Gemstone^000000.
scripts.translation: 免得你忘了，我提醒一下：启动裂隙碎片需要1份暗黑碎片，以及红、黄、蓝宝石原石各2颗。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey~ Did you do the past experiment well?
It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 物品种类好像太多了。减少种类后再试试吧。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我身上的东西好像太重了。减轻负重后再试试吧。

scripts.text: ^000099He is busy fighting against Shelby. If no one stops this fight, it might be impossible to ever talk to him again.^000000
scripts.translation: 他正忙着和谢尔比打架。再不阻止的话，可能就没机会跟他说话了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Tendery Brand Canned Foods^000000, which are used as salaries, are not being released. Ford is sad. ^000099Shelby^000000 over there also seem depressed~.
^000099Tendery Brand Canned Foods^000000, which are used as salaries, are not being released. Ford is sad. ^000099Shelby^000000 over there also seem depressed~.

Ford doesn't know a difficult thing like that. Ford knows sardines well! Also mackerels! ^000099Dimension... Stuff Shelby knows better!^000000 But Shelby isn't working because he's a down. I don't either!!
scripts.translation: 福特不懂那么复杂的东西。福特很懂沙丁鱼！还有鲭鱼！次元...那些谢尔比更懂！可谢尔比心情不好，不肯工作。我也一样！！ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099You hear the sound of two cats fighting.^000000
scripts.translation: 你听见两只猫打架的声音。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You gave us salary! You are kind! Shelby likes you too! We don't have to starve anymore!
scripts.translation: 你给我们发工资了！你真好！谢尔比也喜欢你！我们不用挨饿了！

scripts.text: ^000099Seeing how Shelby isn't screaming at Ford, he really must be in a good mood now.^000000
scripts.translation: 谢尔比没有冲福特大喊大叫，看来他的心情确实好多了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: I've never seen you before... Are you a visitor?
scripts.translation: 我以前没见过你...你是来探监的吗？

scripts.text: I see, I don't think I ever saw you on our visitor's list. Who are you visiting?
scripts.translation: 我好像没在访客名单上见过你。你要探望谁？

scripts.text: Huh? I've got a visitor? Yahoo! It's a visit! Yay~
scripts.translation: 嗯？有人来看我？耶！有人探监啦！太棒了~

scripts.text: ^000099The guard's expression grows dim. He looks so terrible upon just mentioning the name Clever...^000000
scripts.translation: 狱卒的脸色暗了下来。光是提起聪明鬼的名字，他就一脸痛苦... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Well, on the list at least... It doesn't seem like there is a visit scheduled with Clever...
scripts.translation: 嗯，至少名单上...没有安排探望聪明鬼的记录...

scripts.text: Hey~ Guard~ What are you doing? Open this cell quickly, would you! This is a visit, hahaha! If you interfere with my visits, I'm going to sing everytime you work! Aren't you excited?
scripts.translation: 嘿~狱卒~你在干什么？快开牢门！有人来看我，哈哈哈！你要是敢妨碍探视，我每次上班都唱歌给你听！是不是很期待？

scripts.text: Actually, why don't I start singing now?
^000099The guard's face grows even dimmer. His expression betrays his great irritation with the curent situation.^000000
scripts.translation: 狱卒的脸色更加阴沉了，神情里满是对当前状况的不耐烦。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You aren't on the list, but, haha, I guess this is an administrative error. Please go ahead. As far as the time for visitation, hm...
scripts.translation: 你确实不在名单上，不过，哈哈，大概是行政上的疏漏。请进吧。至于探视时间嘛...

scripts.text: You can take as much time as you want. Don't worry about it, and take your time.
scripts.translation: 你想待多久都行。别担心，慢慢来。

scripts.text: Hmm? You want to visit ^000099{0}^000000? I don't see that visitation on the list. Are you sure you made a formal request?
scripts.translation: 嗯？你要探望？我在名单上没看到预约。你确定正式申请过了吗？ ^000099{0}^000000

scripts.text: Please, I ask you. Please shut Mr. Clever's mouth. I've been listening to him for a year now and it's driving me insane. I can't beat a prisoner either...
scripts.translation: 求求你，帮帮我。让聪明鬼先生闭嘴吧！我听他唱了一年，快被逼疯了。我又不能打囚犯...

scripts.text: This is all thanks to you! The fact that Mr. Clever is sleeping, it means that he won't be awake for a few days.
scripts.translation: 这都多亏了你！聪明鬼现在睡着了，接下来几天应该都不会醒。

scripts.text: I don't know when's the last time I've had this much peace. I pray for the blessing of your home tree.
scripts.translation: 我都不记得上次这么清静是什么时候了。愿你的家园之树赐福于你。

scripts.text: ^000099You gained experience points and job experience points, thanks to Clever's sleep and the guard's happiness.^000000
scripts.translation: 多亏聪明鬼睡着了、狱卒心情大好，你获得了基础经验值和职业经验值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: ^000099I see a plain-looking journal. It seems to deal with third-rate gossip stories.^000000
scripts.translation: 我看到一本封面朴素的期刊，内容似乎都是三流八卦。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This must be the one that Clever talked about. Extreme articles are faded out. ^000000
scripts.translation: 辑）这应该就是聪明鬼提到的那本。激烈的评论部分已经褪色了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This isn't a history document. It's just a third-rate magazine. Let's look through the table of contents.^000000
scripts.translation: 这不是历史文献，只是一本三流杂志。先看看目录吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Is there a problem in Yggdrasil? A smell of death began to fill the peaceful land.
scripts.translation: 000000世界树出问题了吗？死亡气息开始弥漫在这片宁静的土地上。

scripts.text: Polluted gardens, dried lands, attack of various mutant life forms. A huge change is found in Laphine's place of life.
scripts.translation: 花园遭到污染，土地干涸，各种变异生物发起攻击。拉菲尼族的居住地发生了巨变。

scripts.text: ^000099(I flip through various faded out pages.)^000000

Laphine's leaders did not doubt that this is the best place for Yggdrasil's guardian. Because of the Elder Assemblly's pressure to establish at such a barren land, it is now difficult to control Laphine citizens.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族的领袖们原本深信，这里最适合成为世界树守护者的居所。但长老议会强迫他们在如此贫瘠的土地上建城，如今族人已难以管束。

scripts.text: Cursed times passed with many families and friends suffering through multiple diseases and attacks by indigenous life forms.
scripts.translation: 在那段黑暗时期，许多家庭和朋友饱受疾病与当地生物袭击之苦。

scripts.text: ^000099(The rest of it is faded out significantly, so it is hard to tell.)^000000
scripts.translation: （剩下的部分褪色得太严重，难以辨认。） ^000099^000000
第二章：长老议会的阴谋 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Elder Assembly continued to blame the Laphine leaders for ongoing failures.
scripts.translation: 长老议会将持续的失败归咎于拉菲尼族领袖。

scripts.text: Upon hearing that the land has been selected incorrectly, they internally decided to move the capital to the southern areas where the area is flourishing with forests.
scripts.translation: 得知选址有误后，他们私下决定把首都迁往南方森林茂密的地区。

scripts.text: The scouts sent south found the shocking truth. The forests in the south could not be close to being safe. 90% of the scouts sent were eliminated by an unknown monstrous figure.
scripts.translation: 派往南方的侦察队发现了惊人真相：南方森林并不安全。派出的侦察兵中有九成遭不明魔物杀害。

scripts.text: However, the Elder Assembly insisted that the area was our destiny and continued to delegate scouting teams. It was a ridiculous decision.
scripts.translation: 然而长老议会坚持认为那片土地是族人的命运，继续派出侦察队。这决定简直荒唐。

scripts.text: As for the leaders, they needed something drastic to oppose Elder Assembly's ridiculous demands. The elders were just too old and ambitious to think practically.
scripts.translation: 领袖们必须采取果断行动，反对长老议会荒谬的要求。那些长老年纪太大、野心太盛，根本不切实际。

scripts.text: At this point, two Donas, ^000099Etran and Robert,^000000 suggested large-scale restorative efforts to the leaders. These were individuals of greatest restorative abilities and authority among the Laphines.
scripts.translation: 这时，两位多纳族——埃特兰和罗伯特——向领袖们提出大规模复原计划。他们是拉菲尼族中最有能力、最有威望的复原专家。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: The leaders began to listen to the strategies suggested by the experts of nature restoration who lived out the principles of restoration all their lives.
scripts.translation: 领袖们开始听取自然复原专家的方案。他们毕生践行复原之道。

scripts.text: The suggestions made by the two Dona were crystal clear. ^000099It was to create an enormous home tree to directly fellowship with Yggdrasil and to restore the land all at once^000000.
scripts.translation: 两位多纳族的建议十分明确：建造一棵巨大的家园之树，直接与世界树沟通，一举复原土地。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: As expected, Elder Assembly completely undermines their suggestion. ^000099In order to create home tree, it was necessary to drain the life force from the land. ^000000
scripts.translation: 不出所料，长老议会彻底否决了他们的提议。因为建造家园之树需要汲取土地中的生命力。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: As such, ^000099creating a home tree to restore the land could be an obstacle instead.^000000 The Elder Assembly argued that the process would be impossible.
scripts.translation: 因此，建造家园之树来复原土地，反而可能造成阻碍。长老议会声称这根本办不到。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: And they continued to say that for everyone to live, it would be better to move to the south than to restore the barren land. That was their ploy to begin with.
scripts.translation: 他们还说，与其复原贫瘠之地，不如迁往南方，让所有人活下来。这从一开始就是他们的盘算。

scripts.text: ^000099(There are many ink stains that seem to purposely block out the writing here.)^000000
scripts.translation: （这里有许多墨迹，像是有人故意涂掉了文字。） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099(There are many ink stains that seem to purposely block out the writing here.)^000000
scripts.translation: （这里有许多墨迹，像是有人故意涂掉了文字。） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099If it is unfolded carefully, it may reveal the page.^000000
scripts.translation: 小心展开的话，或许能看清上面的文字。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There is a page of reflections by Laphine readers. It might be that they were anonymous, but the comments were written aggressively.^000000
scripts.translation: 这是拉菲尼族读者留下的评论页。或许是匿名留言，但语气都很激烈。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000Who ruined this part here? This is the only copy left!! I love this story.
scripts.translation: 回复：是谁把这部分弄坏了？这是仅存的一份！！我最喜欢这个故事。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I have another copy that I made. If you want it, let me know.
scripts.translation: ----回复：我还有一份自己做的副本。想要的话告诉我。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000Hey guys, do you know this? The Elder Assembly at first completely opposed the building of home tree. But it says in the history books that they're the ones that came up with the idea. Isn't that weird? Who's right?
scripts.translation: 回复：大家知道吗？长老议会最初完全反对建造家园之树，可历史书却说是他们提出这个主意的。这不奇怪吗？到底谁说得对？ ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000If you are a Laphine with a wing span greater than 180cm, I'll consider dating you.
scripts.translation: 回复：如果你是翼展超过180厘米的拉菲尼族，我就考虑和你约会。---------- ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: How did you come up with that?
scripts.translation: 回复：你怎么想出这种条件的？ ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000I heard this from my father, but to fight against Elder Assembly's decisions, ^000099Etran and Robert argued one another in front of the elders on purpose.^000000 Is that true?
scripts.translation: 回复：我听父亲说，为了反对长老议会的决定，埃特兰和罗伯特曾故意在长老面前争吵。这是真的吗？ ^990000^000000^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I heard that too. ^000099To make sure they seem authentic, they started arguing each other a bit by bit from a few days before the meeting^000000. That's the most controversial topic among historians.
scripts.translation: 回复：我也听说了。为了让演戏显得逼真，他们在会议前几天就开始一点点争吵。这是历史学家间最有争议的话题。 ^990000^000000^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000There are more idiots that believe this stuff. Hey kids, Eclage Monthly is a third-rate gossip magazine. Don't confuse it with history.
scripts.translation: 回复：还有人信这种鬼话。喂，小鬼...《埃克拉珠月刊》是三流八卦杂志，别把它和历史混为 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: Oh I see. Thank you so much for your wisdom. I guess if you leave comments like that on a third-rate magazine, you just look incredibly smart.
scripts.translation: ----------回复：噢，明白了。多谢指教。看来在三流杂志上留言，确实显得自己特别聪明。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE:^000000I'll be running with the high profile photo of Mayor Jun in undies. I'll give it to the first one to claim it!
scripts.translation: 回复：我要刊出一张君市长穿内衣的高清照片。谁先认领就送给谁！------- ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^990000RE-RE:^000000: I'll take the photo. I'll put you on our editorial staff.
scripts.translation: 回复：照片我要了，顺便把你招进编辑部。 ^990000^000000

scripts.text: ^000099(You've gathered information about the two Donas, Etran and Robert. Take a note of this and ask Clever about it)^000000
scripts.translation: （你收集到了关于两位多纳族——埃特兰和罗伯特——的资料。记下来，再去问问聪明鬼。） ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The book must be damaged. I can't really open it.^000000
scripts.translation: 这本书似乎损坏了，没法打开。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: Hmm? What is this? Am I dreaming? Something feels different.
scripts.translation: 嗯？这是什么？我是在做梦吗？总觉得哪里不一样。

scripts.text: Can you hear me? Would you be Sir Etran?
scripts.translation: 你听得到我说话吗？您是埃特兰大人吗？

scripts.text: You know my name? Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你知道我的名字？你是谁？

scripts.text: Are you telling me to believe that story? You are from the future of thousands of years away? That kind of science is available in the future?
scripts.translation: ？你要我相信这种说法？你来自几千年后的未来？未来竟有这种技术？

scripts.text: Explain to him about the rift reactor.
Sir Etran, it's not that we are from the future, but rather, we opened the walls between the past and the future just temporarily. I have so many questions to ask.
scripts.translation: 埃特兰大人，并不是我们来自未来，而是暂时打通了过去与未来之间的屏障。我有很多问题想请教您。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran suprisingly looks similar to Clever. Could it be that Clever and Hiel are reincarnations of Etran and Robert? No, that couldn't be...^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特兰竟然和聪明鬼长得很像。难道聪明鬼和希尔是埃特兰和罗伯特的转世？不，不可能... ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Ask about the fight with Robert.
scripts.translation: 询问他和罗伯特争吵的事

scripts.text: Hmm, the Elder Assembly is really a rotten organization. They're like fossils, still living in the times when Laphines began to exist.
scripts.translation: 长老议会真是腐朽不堪。他们像一群活化石，还活在拉菲尼族刚诞生的年代。

scripts.text: They try to interfere with presidency, politics, culture, and everything else. They are even minding the matters that deal with our survival.
scripts.translation: 他们想干涉领导层、人事、政治、文化，什么都要管。甚至连关乎我们生死的事也不放过。

scripts.text: The elders are trying to ignore the practical young leaders of this area who want to establish a capital nearby here. They are only trying to carve out their place in the center of this issue regarding the capital.
scripts.translation: 长老们不理会那些务实的年轻领袖。年轻人想在附近建立首都，长老们却只想在首都问题上争权夺势。

scripts.text: That's why they are pushing for the ridiculous idea of settling in the south.
scripts.translation: 所以他们才会极力推动那个荒唐的南迁计划。

scripts.text: The young Laphines could never accept that. That's why Robert and I made the outrageous claim that we could restore the area here and blocked off the movement toward the south.
scripts.translation: 年轻的拉菲尼族绝不会接受。于是罗伯特和我提出一个大胆的主张：复原这片土地，以此阻止南迁。

scripts.text: Of course... It would only be significant if we succeed. If we fail, many more young Laphines would be sent off to the south.
scripts.translation: 当然，只有成功才有意义。一旦失败，就会有更多年轻的拉菲尼族被送往南方。

scripts.text: I can no longer let the elders shed the blood of the young Laphines.
scripts.translation: 我不能再让长老们牺牲年轻拉菲尼族的性命。说实话，我没什么把握。如今彩虹桥已衰败得太严重，再多生命力也看不到尽头。

scripts.text: Oh yeah, you talking about the time we argued in front of the Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation: 哦，你是说我们在长老议会面前争吵的事。

scripts.text: That happened about a year ago from the dimension that I'm currently in. Because we wanted to draw the elders' attention to our idea, we made them focus on only two issues, home tree's restoration or the land's restoration.
scripts.translation: 那是我所在的维度里，大约一年前发生的事。为了让长老们正视我们的主张，我们把议题集中在两件事上：复原家园之树，还是复原土地。

scripts.text: We succeeded ultimately. They didn't even get to discuss the option of settling in the forests of the south. It just had too many Laphine lives at stake.
scripts.translation: 最后我们成功了。他们甚至没能讨论迁往南方森林的方案，因为那会牺牲太多拉菲尼族的性命。

scripts.text: If I could meet Robert later, I wish to continue that conversation.
scripts.translation: 若之后能再见到罗伯特，我还想把那次谈话

scripts.text: I honestly don't have much confidence. The Bifrost now is too deteriorated that no matter how much life force is used, there would be no end in sight.
scripts.translation: 继续下去。说实话，我没什么把握。如今的彩虹桥已衰败得太严重，再多生命力也看不到尽头。

scripts.text: Furthermore, the energy that the home tree consumes is just too colossal and too rapid.
scripts.translation: 而且家园之树消耗能量的规模太大，速度也太快。

scripts.text: Robert is probably doing everything he can. Once the home tree connected to a piece of land, the entire area will be consumed. To prevent that, he put his life on the line.
scripts.translation: 罗伯特一定在竭尽全力。家园之树一旦扎根某片土地，整片区域都会被它吸干。为了阻止这一切，他赌上了性命。

scripts.text: You get the idea right? Our roles are in two parts right now. Me, who focuses on pouring out the energy into the land. Robert, who blocks off the home tree's wild consumption.
scripts.translation: 明白了吗？我们现在各司其职：我负责把能量注入土地，罗伯特负责阻止家园之树疯狂汲取能量。

scripts.text: If the balance between us two is not maintained, the entire land will be destroyed along with home tree. The problem is, I just don't know if we are doing it all correctly.
scripts.translation: 如果我们无法维持平衡，整片土地和家园之树都会毁灭。问题是，我不知道我们的做法到底对不对。
实际上，你的计划成功了

scripts.text: You succeeded. Bifrost, full of flowers and grass, is a land of plenty.
scripts.translation: 你成功了。彩虹桥繁花绿草遍地，是一片富饶的土地。

scripts.text: Would you like to see for yourself?
Sure. Lead the way. I'll follow...
^000099The additional reaction does not get reduced.^000000
Oh? Something's familiar. Would you be that traveler from the future?
scripts.translation: 哦？这感觉真熟悉。你就是那位来自未来的旅行者吧？

scripts.text: You are here! I was worried that you wouldn't come back!
scripts.translation: 你来了！我还担心你不会再回来了！

scripts.text: After your visit, I felt so much lighter. I was also excited to control the life force.
scripts.translation: 你来过之后，我感觉轻松多了，也更有信心去操控生命力了。

scripts.text: More importantly, did you give the necklace to Robert? And what about the leaf of the home tree?
scripts.translation: 对了，你把项链交给罗伯特了吗？家园之树的叶子呢？

scripts.text: Give the necklace and the home tree leaf.
scripts.translation: 交出项链和家园之树的叶子

scripts.text: Wow, it was true that home tree has grown! What a relief!!
scripts.translation: 哇，家园之树真的长大了！太好了！！

scripts.text: But even so, it's a bit sad that he didn't keep the necklace...
scripts.translation: 不过，他没把项链留下，还是有点让人难过...

scripts.text: I see. Robert, as usual, is strong unlike me. That's Robert's strong point.
scripts.translation: 原来如此。罗伯特一如既往地坚强，而我却不一样。这正是罗伯特的过人之处。

scripts.text: And, Sir Robert also asked me to tell you this.
scripts.translation: 还有，罗伯特先生让我转告您：

scripts.text: That as much as you trust in me, ^000099I trust in you^000000...

scripts.translation: 罗伯特真的这么说？真的吗？

scripts.text: I think this is the first time he's ever said he trusts me ever since we started working together. Now I can just focus and give all my heart to putting energy into this land.
scripts.translation: 这是我们开始合作以来，他第一次说信任我。现在我可以全心投入，把能量注入这片土地了。
埃特兰的肩膀似乎微微颤抖。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: I didn't get to know you very long, but thank you, traveler from the future.
scripts.translation: 虽然我们相识不久，还是谢谢你，来自未来的旅行者。

scripts.text: By the way, the necklace that Robert refused to keep. I'll give it to you as a token of gratitude. Just keep it for yourself.
scripts.translation: 对了，罗伯特不肯收下的项链，就送给你作谢礼吧。请你留着。

scripts.text: Well then, I should get going. Also, please send my word of appreciation to the person who built this incredible machine.
scripts.translation: 那么，我该继续忙了。也请替我向制造这台奇妙机器的人道谢。

scripts.text: ^000099Etran's keepsake was received. It is possible to equip it, but ^ff0000to utilize its full strength,^000099 I would need Hiel's help later.^000000
scripts.translation: 你得到了埃特兰的信物。虽然可以装备，但要发挥它的全部力量，之后还得请希尔帮忙。 ^000099^ff0000^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099This is a grave where communication with Etran was established. He must have spent his last days around here.^000000
scripts.translation: 这里是与埃特兰建立联系的墓地。他晚年应该就在附近度过。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There is a cemetery unfitting with the tower. It's so worn down that it's difficult to tell whose graves these are.^000000
scripts.translation: 这座墓地和高塔格格不入。墓碑风化得太严重，已经难以辨认墓主。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: This is tough. The energy consumed by the home tree is greater than I thought. Even if Robert is providing some control, was this impossible to begin with?
scripts.translation: 这很难办。家园之树消耗的能量比我想象的要大。即使有罗伯特进行一些控制，这从一开始就是不可能做到的吗？

scripts.text: ^000099I'm here!! Let's take this reactor closer.^000000
scripts.translation: 我来了！！我们把反应器再往前移一点吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: Is this real. This isn't a dream, is it... {0}.
scripts.translation: 这是真的吗？这不是梦吧……{0}。

scripts.text: What you are seeing now is home for thousands of Laphine descendants, Bifrost the land of life.
scripts.translation: 你现在看到的，是数千名拉菲尼族后裔的家园——生命之地彩虹桥。

scripts.text: I wasn't wrong. I wasn't wrong.
^000099Etran started to sob and seemed to be free from the burden of his life. He seemed to remember something and asked a question.^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特兰开始啜泣，似乎卸下了生命中的重担。他似乎想起了什么，问了一个问题。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: But, what about Robert's home tree? What happened to his home tree?
scripts.translation: 那么，罗伯特的家园之树呢？长得怎么样了？

scripts.text: His home tree also grew very well.
scripts.translation: 他的家园之树也长得很好

scripts.text: I see. I would like to see the home tree he nurtured... Would you take me there too?
scripts.translation: 是吗...我真想看看他培育的家园之树...你能带我去看看吗？

scripts.text: Unfortunately, this reactor's range is too small that while I try to take you there, the connection will drop. I'm afraid it's impossible.
scripts.translation: 很遗憾，这台反应器的作用范围太小，带您过去的话，连接就会中断。恐怕办不到。

scripts.text: Did Robert really succeed too? Are you trying to keep his failures from me by any chance?
scripts.translation: 罗伯特真的成功了吗？你该不会是在隐瞒他的失败吧？

scripts.text: Should I bring something to prove it to you?
scripts.translation: 我该带点什么来证明给你看吗？
带一片家园之树的叶子

scripts.text: A cat's canned food? How does that have anything to do with home tree?
scripts.translation: 猫罐头？这和家园之树有什么关系？

scripts.text: Oh, I was just talking nonsense for a bit.
scripts.translation: 哦，我刚才随口乱说的。啊，家园之树的叶子！没错，家园之树长成后就会长出叶子，这种叶子是其他植物没有的。

scripts.text: A Laphine's coin? Is it something new? Does home tree produce coins now?
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族的硬币？那是什么新东西吗？家园之树还会长硬币？

scripts.text: No, that doesn't happen. I just chose a bad example.
scripts.translation: 不，不会那样。我只是举了个不恰当的

scripts.text: Ah, home tree's leaf. Tha's right. If a home tree grows properly, it would bare leaves. It's not something you can see in other plants.
scripts.translation: 例子。啊，家园之树的叶子！没错，家园之树长成后就会长出叶子，这种叶子是其他植物没有的。

scripts.text: How does a home tree leaf look like? Are there characteristics that make it unique such as color?
scripts.translation: 家园之树的叶子是什么样的？有什么特别之处吗，比如颜色？

scripts.text: I only heard about it. I never saw it myself. I've heard that a home tree with abundant life force demonstrates a gold color.
scripts.translation: 我只听说过，自己从没见过。据说生命力旺盛的家园之树会呈现出金色。

scripts.text: I don't know anything besides that. But if it is a real home tree leaf, there's no way I wouldn't be able to tell. The life reaction from a home tree leaf is incredible.
scripts.translation: 除此之外我就不知道了。但如果是真正的家园之树叶子，我肯定认得出来。它散发的生命反应非常强烈。

scripts.text: If you bring me a fully grown home tree leaf, I will never give up. You can't fake Robert's success, you see.
scripts.translation: 如果你带来一片完全成熟的家园之树叶子，我就绝不会放弃。毕竟罗伯特的成功是伪造不了的。

scripts.text: This necklace... Please give it to Robert. Tell him that I never gave up and that we must give our all...
scripts.translation: 这条项链...请把它交给罗伯特。告诉他我从未放弃，我们必须全力以赴...
