scripts.text: I said I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 我说我很抱歉。我很抱歉。

scripts.text: ^000099The reactor was activated but... For some reason, I'm getting annoyed.^000000
scripts.translation: 反应器启动了...不知为何，我有点烦躁。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Pan-galactic ultra genius engineer Hiel's strange and creepy workshop.
scripts.translation: 泛银河系超天才工程师希尔的怪异且令人毛骨悚然的工作室

scripts.text: Normal Laphines, animals, and Saphas are prohibited.
scripts.translation: 。禁止普通拉菲尼族、动物和萨法族进入。

scripts.text: If you would like to go down, please press the bell~
scripts.translation: 如果您想下去，请按下铃铛~

scripts.text: Baby, you don't know why I'm upset, do you?
scripts.translation: 宝宝，你不知道我为什么生气，对吧？

scripts.text: It seems like there are too many types of items. Let's try again after reducing the number of types.
scripts.translation: 看起来物品种类太多了。让我们减少种类后再试一次。

scripts.text: It seems like my possessions are too heavy. Let's try again after lightening the load.
scripts.translation: 我的物品似乎太重了。让我们减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text: ^000099It's a workshop with lots of oddities.^000000
scripts.translation: 这是一个充满奇奇怪怪东西的工作室。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099It looks like Hiel's preliminary rift reactor. It seems like it could be operated upon touching it.^000000
scripts.translation: 看起来像是希尔的初步裂隙反应堆。似乎触摸它就可以操作。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099As soon as the Dark Debris was placed in the middle of Hiel's arrangement, everything went dark and a strange voice appeared out of nowhere.^000000
scripts.translation: 当暗黑碎片被放置在希尔排列的中心时，一切变得黑暗，一个奇怪的声音不知从哪里出现了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: According to the estimation, the time it takes for home tree's restoration is at least 200 years. During that period, 80% of life forms on this land will be destroyed.
scripts.translation: 根据估算，家园之树的恢复至少需要200年。在此期间，这片土地上80%的生命形式将被摧毁。

scripts.text: However, if we were to take care of the life forms in the land without restoring home tree, without the basic resources to support the life forms, it will inevitably reach destruction. That period would not even last more than 400 years.
scripts.translation: 然而，如果我们不恢复家园之树，就无法维持这片土地上的生命形式。没有维持生命所需的基本资源，毁灭是不可避免的。那段时期甚至不会超过400年。

scripts.text: Will we enjoy long lasting peace taking into account the 200 years of sacrifice? Or, do we just die out after working to sustain life for 400 years.
scripts.translation: 考虑到200年的牺牲，我们能否享受长久的和平？还是说，我们在维持生命400年后就会灭绝。

scripts.text: We ask for the wisdom of Elder Assembly.
scripts.translation: 我们请求长老议会的智慧。

scripts.text: We will first consider your report. The assembly's decision is.... (Static... Static)
scripts.translation: 我们将首先考虑你们的报告。议会的决定是... (静电... 静电)

scripts.text: ^000099Noises interfered the voice and the present time returned.^000000
scripts.translation: 噪音干扰了声音，时间回到了现在。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099It looks like Hiel's preliminary rift reactor. It seems like it could be operated upon touching it.^000000
scripts.translation: 看起来像是希尔的初步裂隙反应堆。似乎触摸它就可以操作。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Hiel seems to continue with the improvement. It does not seem right to touch it.^000000
scripts.translation: 希尔似乎还在继续改进。现在去碰它似乎不太合适。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Could this be... the guys from last time?
scripts.translation: 难道这是...上次那几个人？

scripts.text: Come to think of it,{0}, you disappeared after leaving me in front of home tree!
scripts.translation: 说起来，{0}，你把我丢在家园之树前就消失了！

scripts.text: ^000099It was good that Robert appeared in such clarity. But he seems really mad about the time when the communication got cut off last time. Let's first calm his hand holding my collar up.^000000
scripts.translation: 罗伯特出现得如此清晰，这很好。但他似乎对上次通讯中断的事非常生气。先让他松开抓着我衣领的手吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Please give me some time to explain!
Hmm? The necklace in your right hand...
I bought it at the market.
You may fool others, but you can't fool me. Tell me straight. Where is that necklace from?
scripts.translation: 你可以骗别人，但骗不了我。老实说。那条项链是从哪来的？

scripts.text: As you know, this is Sir Etran's necklace.
scripts.translation: 如你所知，这是埃特兰大人的项链。

scripts.text: Sir Etran seemed exhausted. So I showed him how the future of his work looks like.
scripts.translation: 埃特兰大人看起来筋疲力尽，于是我让他看了自己努力的成果在未来是什么样子。

scripts.text: He didn't know whether his work was a success or a failure, but after seeing Bifrost full of life, he found the strength to continue.
scripts.translation: 他不知道自己的努力究竟成功还是失败，但看到生机盎然的彩虹桥后，终于有了继续下去的力量。
我明白了。原来是这么回事。

scripts.text: And Sir Etran asked me to deliver this necklace to you. It was to let you know that he won't ever give up the future of Bifrost he's seen.
scripts.translation: 埃特兰大人托我把这条项链交给您。他想让您知道，绝不会放弃自己所看见的彩虹桥未来。

scripts.text: The only thing is.. He was worried about how you were doing. Especially since he couldn't see whether your home tree grew successfully.
scripts.translation: 只是...他很担心您的情况，尤其是没法确认您的家园之树是否成功长成。

scripts.text: That can't be helped. The one who is putting in the life force cannot leave the place.
scripts.translation: 那也没办法。负责注入生命力的人不能离开那里。

scripts.text: Is it possible to obtain a home tree leaf?
scripts.translation: 能拿到一片家园之树的叶子吗？

scripts.text: Ah, you are trying to show Etran my home tree's leaf. You ask such an obvious question...
scripts.translation: 啊，你想把我家园之树的叶子拿给埃特兰看。你问得还真直接...

scripts.text: In fact, my home tree just bloomed up its first leaf. It's very big and full of splendor. Give me a minute.
scripts.translation: 我的家园之树刚刚长出第一片叶子。它又大又美。稍等我一下。

scripts.text: ^000099Robert's reaction has not emerged yet. He must be still in the process of obtainig a home tree leaf.^000000
scripts.translation: 罗伯特还没有回应，应该还在设法取得一片家园之树的叶子。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Take this home tree leaf. This is a leaf that I obtained myself, so it won't affect home tree much at all.
scripts.translation: 拿着这片叶子吧。这是我亲自摘下的，不会对家园之树造成什么影响。

scripts.text: And the necklace you gave me earlier, I understand very well the will of Etran, so you can just return it back to him.
scripts.translation: 至于你之前给我的项链，我明白埃特兰的心意。请把它还给他。

scripts.text: There's no way I would feel good after receiving a necklace from that kid. I know it might be troublesome, but please give it back to him.
scripts.translation: 收下那孩子的项链，我怎么可能心安？虽然麻烦你了，还是请把它还给他。

scripts.text: Oh, and please tell him I said this. As much as you trust in me, ^000099I trust in you^000000.^000000
scripts.translation: 还有，请把这句话转告他：正如你信任我，我也信任你。 ^000099^000000^000000

scripts.text: And to not cry anywhere he goes... Wait, no I take that one back.
scripts.translation: 还有，叫他别到处哭...等等，这句我收回。

scripts.text: ^000099After making that statement, Robert disappeared back into the reactor. In my hand were Robert's home tree leaf and Etran's necklace.^000000
scripts.translation: 说完后，罗伯特的身影消失在反应器中。我手里拿着罗伯特的家园之树叶和埃特兰的项链。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099With the energy from the golden leaf, my body and mind feel like they are rejuvenated. Gained experience points and job experience points.^000000
scripts.translation: 金色叶片的能量让我的身心仿佛重获新生。你获得了基础经验值和职业经验值。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The rift reactor is lying here. I guess I don't have use for it right now.^000000
scripts.translation: 裂隙反应器放在这里。现在应该用不上。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Now, the rift reactor could be used to look at the past, present, or other dimensions. Let's take a look at it whenever necessary. ^000000
scripts.translation: 现在可以用裂隙反应器查看过去、现在或其他次元。需要时再来看看吧。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: A person like you who doesn't know the power of love is destitute!!
scripts.translation: 不知道爱的力量有多强大的人，真可怜！！

scripts.text: ^000099It's been a while since I felt that about myself. Yes, indeed... This machine is getting on my nerves.^000000
scripts.translation: 我好久没这么有感触了。没错...这台机器真让我火大。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: CHTTTTSTATIC~~~~ ANG!?~~ CHTTTTT ~ oh my shoulder!!
scripts.translation: 嘶嘶嘶~~~~啊！？~~嘶嘶嘶~我的肩膀！！

scripts.text: ^000099Oh, I'm sorry. I'm going to leave this channel.^000000
scripts.translation: 啊，抱歉，我要退出这个频道了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey Robert, do you know? My sad expression... There is a sad legend here.
scripts.translation: 罗伯特，你知道吗？我这张悲伤的表情背后，还有个悲伤传说。

scripts.text: The person who drew me. He couldn't get into it when he was drawing the sad expression.
scripts.translation: 画我的那个人，画这个悲伤表情时怎么也画不出来。

scripts.text: Wait a minute! What are you trying to say. If you are trying to say something dangerous for the present time, you should let it be!!
scripts.translation: 等等，你想说什么？要是这话会影响现在，就别说了！！

scripts.text: Nah~ why not? This trascends time and space. Where else would I talk about it?
scripts.translation: 哎呀~有什么关系？这可是超越时空的对话，我还能在哪儿说？

scripts.text: Hm, ok fine. If that's the case, let's just hear the rest of that story. So what happened to that Mr. L?
scripts.translation: 好吧，那就听你把故事说完。那个L先生后来怎么样了？

scripts.text: (This guy mentioned his initial! Ok, this guy is making it more dangerous than I am!!) He took out equipments from the storage to see if he wants to refine them.
scripts.translation: （这家伙居然说出了首字母！他比我还危险！！）他从仓库拿了些装备出来，想看看要不要精炼。

scripts.text: His expression then is this one here. Isn't it sad?
scripts.translation: 他当时就是这副表情。很悲伤吧？

scripts.text: ^000099What if Etran and Robert were the prisoner and the guard?^000000
scripts.translation: 如果埃特兰和罗伯特就是囚犯和狱卒呢？ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey Guard~ I think the humidity here is too high. My skin is gonna be ruined. Is that ok? Huh?
scripts.translation: 嘿，卫兵~这里湿气太重了，我的皮肤都要毁了。这样行吗？嗯？

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were put to work as cat merchants.^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特兰和罗伯特被安排去当猫族商人了。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Welcome welcomeow~! We are cat merchants, always serving guests as our kingeow~! Special sale! One piece of meat for 200 Zeny!!
scripts.translation: 欢迎欢迎喵~！我们是猫族商人，会像招待国王一样招待客人喵~特价优惠！肉一块只要200 Zeny！！

scripts.text: If you buy it now, we will also give you 3 canned foodseow!! Buy lotseow!!!
scripts.translation: 现在买还送三罐猫粮喵！！多买些喵！！！

scripts.text: (Hey, Robert! Don't just stand there and imitate a cat or something! If you just stand still, we are gonna be kicked out!)
scripts.translation: （喂，罗伯特！别站着学猫叫啊！你再不动，我们就要被赶走了！）

scripts.text: ^000099Etran and Robert were placed in a Flight machine.^000000
scripts.translation: 埃特兰和罗伯特被安排进了一台飞行器。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey Robert, don't you love this machine that flies in the air?
scripts.translation: 嘿，罗伯特，你不喜欢这台能在天上飞的机器吗？

scripts.text: Huh? Why are you looking so green? What's wrong?
scripts.translation: 嗯？你脸色怎么发青了？不舒服吗？

scripts.text: Etran, I was looking for a restroom here.
Ok, so what about the restroom.
They don't have one here. No restrooms here.
scripts.translation: 这里没有洗手间。哪儿都没有。

scripts.text: ^000099We will be arriving at Izlude Airport in 6 hours. ^000000
scripts.translation: 我们将在6小时后抵达依斯鲁得岛机场。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hahahha, I can't keep myself from laughing after listening to you.
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈，听你这么一说我就忍不住笑。

scripts.text: Let us go as we are to Izlude!!!
scripts.translation: 我们就这样飞去依斯鲁得岛吧！！！

scripts.text: I'm going to bake a pie now.
Are you going to add some blueberries too? I love blueberry pies!
scripts.translation: 真的吗？会加蓝莓吗？我最喜欢蓝莓派了！

scripts.text: Of course. I'm also going to add some raspberries from morning and add some syrup too.
scripts.translation: 当然。我还会加上早上摘的覆盆子，再淋些糖浆。

scripts.text: Raspberries will add that berry citrus flavor!! I love raspberry pies! How many are you baking? Isn't two just too little?
scripts.translation: 覆盆子会增添莓果的酸香！我超爱覆盆子派！你烤几个？只烤两个不嫌少吗？

scripts.text: I'm going to bake 1. You aren't getting one.
Oh man~ I'm craving for some chilled beer and yakitori back in the human world~
scripts.translation: 哎呀~真想念人类世界的冰啤酒和烤串啊~

scripts.text: Robert! Robert! Did you see the new yakitori place here? They are doing a grand opening sale today! Let's go eat some!
scripts.translation: 罗伯特！你看到新开的烤串店了吗？今天开业大酬宾！一起去吃吧！

scripts.text: How could you be talking about beer? You should be ashamed of yourself, Etran~
scripts.translation: 串？）居然提啤酒？埃特兰，你该感到羞愧~

scripts.text: Huh?... You don't like beer, Robert?
scripts.translation: 咦？罗伯特，你不喜欢啤酒吗？

scripts.text: That's just something that humans drink. You go ahead. I don't really care for it.
scripts.translation: 那是人类喝的东西。你去喝吧，我没兴趣。

scripts.text: But do they have good yakitori there?
scripts.translation: 不过，那里的烤串好吃吗？

scripts.text: Yeah!! Totally good! Do you want to go? Huh?
scripts.translation: 好吃！！特别好吃！你也想去吗？嗯？

scripts.text: Well, it's not that I really want yakitori or anything, but....
scripts.translation: 我也不是特别想吃烤串啦，不过...

scripts.text: Etran is going to be back soon. By then, it should be ready.
scripts.translation: 埃特兰很快就回来，应该刚好能烤好。

scripts.text: Ah~ very good. Look at this perfect pie. The fragrance is amazing, too. Should I taste it a bit?
scripts.translation: 啊~真不错。看看这完美的派，香气也很棒。要不要先尝一口？

scripts.text: I'll eat it with him when Etran comes home.
^000099Robert who went over to Etran's house with the pie.^000000
scripts.translation: 罗伯特带着派去了埃特兰家。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Welcome to Etran's home! I went to Bifrost to water some plants! It's going to take at least two days because the land is so large. Any gifts can be left at the door.
scripts.translation: 欢迎来我家！我去彩虹桥给植物浇水了！地方太大，至少要花两天。有礼物的话就放门口吧。

scripts.text: Oh, I'm sure there won't be anyone with gifts. Especially nothing like Robert bringing a nicely baked pie, hahaha.
scripts.translation: 当然，肯定没人带礼物来。更不会有人像罗伯特那样带来刚烤好的派，哈哈哈。

scripts.text: Ok, I didn't! My gosh, I didn't bake the pie!!!
scripts.translation: 才没有！天啊，我根本没烤派！！！
童年好友：埃特兰与罗伯特 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: Hey, why are you crying like that?
Sob sob...Dona of the same class are making fun of my size and calling me a Papang...
scripts.translation: 呜呜...同班的多纳族笑我个子矮，还叫我帕潘族...

scripts.text: That's all it was? Just because they call you a Papang, it doesn't mean you, a Dona, will turn into a Papang! Those guys just wanted to see you cry. Why don't you stop crying?
scripts.translation: 就因为他们叫你帕潘族？你是多纳族，怎么可能就变成帕潘族！他们只是想看你哭，别哭了。

scripts.text: Really now... You cry too often.
I wish I was as calm and cool as you were, Robert.
scripts.translation: 我真希望自己能像你一样冷静又帅气，罗伯特。

scripts.text: Psh, you are 100 years too early to be as cool as I am...
scripts.translation: 哼，想变得像我这么帅，你还差一百年呢...

scripts.text: ^FF0000This is the place where those kids who make fun of Etran hang out often. Shall I see who they are?^000000
scripts.translation: 那些嘲笑埃特兰的小鬼常在这里出没。要不要查查他们是谁？ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Nobody knows why, but it was told that the Laphines who made fun of Etran were hospitalized for 4 weeks.^000000
scripts.translation: 没人知道原因，不过据说那些嘲笑埃特兰的拉菲尼族住院了四周。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: You shouldn't be a kid like this~ School violence is an unforgivable crime. Friends should stay away from violence and spend good times together.
scripts.translation: 别做这种幼稚的事~校园暴力不可饶恕。朋友之间应该远离暴力，好好相处。

scripts.text: ^0000993 minutes in boiling water... What after that. Does it mean it will die 3 minutes in boiling water? Do I pour the boiling water over a monster or something?^000000
scripts.translation: 沸水煮三分钟...然后呢？是说它会在沸水里煮三分钟后死掉吗？我要把沸水倒在魔物身上吗？ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Houston~ Houston~ This is CHTTTCHTTT~ We see a large tower and a tree. It seems like there are life forms here on this planet as well~ STATIC~ ^000000
scripts.translation: 休斯顿~休斯顿~这里是嘶嘶嘶~我们看到一座高塔和一棵树。这个星球上似乎也有生命体~杂音~ ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099Some desperate voices are heard. Not sure what the words, planets and life forms, are referring to.^000000
scripts.translation: 传来几道绝望的声音。我不明白他们说的“行星”和“生命体”指什么。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099There's too much static. Try adjusting the frequency. ^000000
scripts.translation: 杂音太多了。试着调一下频率。 ^000099^000000

scripts.text: ^000099The work desk is a huge mess.^000000
Looking at this beautiful field, the song sings itself~
scripts.translation: 看着这片美丽田野，歌声仿佛自然而然就响起来了~

scripts.text: It's always so beautiful with flowers blooming everywhere.
What is Eclage like? It's such a nice place.
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠是什么样的地方？那里真不错。

scripts.text: People wouldn't hate or hold each other at knife point if their hearts are filled with love for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation: 如果心里充满对花朵和大地的爱，人们就不会彼此憎恨，也不会刀剑相向。

scripts.text: You should avoid going into the tower. It's dangerous. We can't do much for the ones who have already entered, though.
scripts.translation: 别进塔里，那里很危险。至于已经进去的人，我们也帮不上忙。

scripts.text: I appreciate what you did last time. The earth seemed to be in a good mood, too. I could just feel it. Would you mind helping us again?
scripts.translation: 上次多亏你帮忙。大地看起来心情也很好，我能感觉到。你愿意再帮我们一次吗？

scripts.text: It seems like the earth is feeling well right now. A little break would be nice.
scripts.translation: 看来大地现在感觉不错，稍微歇会儿也好。

scripts.text: There are four in the work group. Don't forget to tell everyone.
scripts.translation: 工作组有四个人，记得通知大家。

scripts.text: Thanks. Can you hear the earth singing? The sound of flowers and trees dancing in the wind. You'll hear it someday.
scripts.translation: 谢谢。你听见大地的歌声了吗？那是花草树木在风中起舞的声音。总有一天你也会听见。

scripts.text: Glad you're here. We're about to start working again. Would you help us?
scripts.translation: 很高兴你来了。我们马上要重新开工，能帮帮我们吗？

scripts.text: Thanks so much! Tell Laphines to start working!
scripts.translation: 太感谢了！告诉拉菲尼族们开始工作吧！

scripts.text: Do you hear the voice of the earth fading to a whisper? Looks like it's not feeling well today.
scripts.translation: 你听见大地的声音微弱得像耳语吗？看来它今天不太舒服。

scripts.text: We should do something to bring cheer to the earth at a time like this!
scripts.translation: 这种时候，我们得想办法让大地开心起来！

scripts.text: We should go check if the adventurers are okay.
scripts.translation: 我们去看看冒险者们是否平安吧。

scripts.text: Should I say it's a relief that they're all alive...? Well...at least it's good that they're still alive.
scripts.translation: 该说他们都活着真让人安心吗...嗯...至少还活着就好。

scripts.text: There are three adventurers in the tower still. I understand they have their own reasons, but I can't help worrying about them.
scripts.translation: 塔里还有三名冒险者。我知道他们各有理由，可还是忍不住担心。

scripts.text: Please, make sure you check how the adventurers are doing. Who knows, you'll get some help from them in the future.
scripts.translation: 记得确认那些冒险者的情况。说不定以后会需要他们帮忙。

scripts.text: I'm glad they're all safe and sound. I'll be relieved if they finish their business quickly and go back...Thanks anyway!
scripts.translation: 他们都平安无事，真好。要是他们办完事赶紧回去，我就放心了。总之，多谢你！

scripts.text: I don't have any responsibility. But the earth will be sad if any of the adventurers gets hurt here.
scripts.translation: 这不算我的责任，但要是有冒险者在这里受伤，大地也会难过。

scripts.text: Will you help checking the safety of the adventurers today?
scripts.translation: 今天能帮我看看冒险者们是否平安吗？

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm kind of tired today.
Thanks! Make sure all three of the adventurers are doing well!
scripts.translation: 谢谢！确认那三名冒险者都平安无事吧！

scripts.text: Hmm, it's unfortunate, but I guess it can't be helped. I'm worried though, especially for the one who was singing.
scripts.translation: 嗯，真遗憾，不过也没办法。我还是很担心他们，尤其是那个唱歌的人。

scripts.text: Are the adventurers doing okay? Don't forget to check all three of them~
scripts.translation: 冒险者们都还好吗？记得确认他们三个人的情况哦~

scripts.text: Thank goodness they're all okay. What a relief. But did they tell you when they'll be out?
scripts.translation: 谢天谢地，他们都没事。真让人放心。他们有没有说什么时候出来？

scripts.text: Hmm...I can't just ignore them though...
scripts.translation: 嗯...可我还是没法对他们置之不理...

scripts.text: The adventurer on the third floor is starving!
scripts.translation: 三楼的冒险者快饿坏了！

scripts.text: Seriously...I can't believe it's an adventurer. Would you mind giving it some food if you have any?
scripts.translation: 真是的...居然会有冒险者饿成这样。你有食物的话，能分给他一点吗？

scripts.text: Let's see...this is all I've got. It's not much, but hopefully it'll help him.
scripts.translation: 我看看...手边只有这些。虽然不多，希望能帮上忙。

scripts.text: I should start checking their safety regularly. Stop by again later, please.
scripts.translation: 我得定期确认他们是否平安。请过一阵子再来。

scripts.text: Do you see the tower here? I don't know when it was built or who built it, but I heard it's been here since forever.
scripts.translation: 看到这座塔了吗？我不知道它何时建成、由谁建造，只听说它一直都在这里。

scripts.text: And we're trying to stop travelers going into the tower since there are monsters inside.
scripts.translation: 塔里有魔物，所以我们一直在劝旅行者别进去。

scripts.text: But you know, travelers...they want to go even more if it's dangerous.
scripts.translation: 可你知道，旅行者越听说危险，越想进去。

scripts.text: ^FF0000three adventurers^000000went into the tower recently. I'm not sure if they're still alive...
scripts.translation: 最近有三名冒险者进了塔。我不确定他们还活着没有... ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I should have tried harder to stop them...Could you go check if they're safe and sound?
scripts.translation: 我早该更努力地拦住他们...你能去看看他们是否平安吗？

scripts.text: I'll do it! I'm an adventurer, too!
Sorry, I can't do it right now.
Good. There are three adventurers in the tower right now.
scripts.translation: 好。塔里现在有三名冒险者。

scripts.text: The first adventurer went inside just now. He's pretty young and I gave him a good scolding. You'll find him in just a few minutes.
scripts.translation: 第一名冒险者刚进去没多久。他挺年轻，我还训了他一顿。进去几分钟就能找到他。

scripts.text: The second adventurer seemed like an uptight lady. I wonder how she's doing.
scripts.translation: 第二名冒险者看起来是位严肃的女士。不知道她怎么样了。

scripts.text: The third adventurer is the problem here...I don't know what he's doing but he's been inside for about a month now.
scripts.translation: 第三名冒险者最让人担心...不知道他在里面做什么，已经待了一个月左右。

scripts.text: He said proudly that he'll be out in a second and took his instrument to make a song inside the tower. But I haven't heard from him since then. Please look for him.
scripts.translation: 他信誓旦旦地说马上就出来，还带着乐器进塔唱歌。可之后就再没消息了。请帮我找找他。

scripts.text: It's nothing urgent, but I'm worried about the adventurers.
scripts.translation: 虽然不是什么急事，可我还是担心那些冒险者。

scripts.text: Four Laphines are preparing to work today. Make sure you tell every one of them.
scripts.translation: 今天有四位拉菲尼族要开始工作，记得逐个通知他们。

scripts.text: They're all preparing somewhere in the field.
scripts.translation: 他们都在田野某处准备着。

scripts.text: Ahng!? I think they already started the work. The field is breathing again. There are many stories to this field, you know.
scripts.translation: 啊？！他们好像已经开始工作了。这片土地又恢复生机了。这片土地的故事可多着呢。

scripts.text: You'll be able to hear its story from somewhere if you love flower, trees, and Laphines.
scripts.translation: 如果你喜欢花草树木和拉菲尼族，或许能在某处听到这片土地的故事。

scripts.text: I think their work for the field is finished for the day. By the way, ^FF0000there's another work. Ask about it if you're interested.^000000
scripts.translation: 他们今天的田野工作应该结束了。对了，还有别的工作，感兴趣的话可以问问。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Now that I see...you're a traveler, right? Sorry, I can't really notice anything unless I'm interested.
scripts.translation: 现在才注意到...你是旅行者吧？抱歉，除非是我感兴趣的事，否则我很难注意到。

scripts.text: I'll introduce myself first. My name is Fili and I'm a Laphine. I do a variety of work in Eclage. You can tell from these muscles, ahng?
scripts.translation: 先自我介绍一下，我叫菲利，是拉菲尼族，在埃克拉珠做各种工作。看看我这身肌肉就知道了，昂？

scripts.text: What's up with that 'ahng' sound you make?
scripts.translation: 你为什么总发出“昂”的声音？

scripts.text: It's just a habit, don't mind. Anyway, it's time to start the work for the day...you're a traveler, right? Can you help me?
scripts.translation: 只是习惯，别介意。总之，该开始今天的工作了...你是旅行者吧？能帮我吗？

scripts.text: See what kind of work it is.
Ahng? It's simple. Tell Laphines that are scattered all over the field to start today's work.
scripts.translation: 昂？很简单，告诉散布在田野各处的拉菲尼族开始今天的工作。

scripts.text: Laphines love this field, and in their own ways, they're sharing their energy with trees, grasses, winds, and the earth.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族热爱这片田野，会用自己的方式把能量分享给树木、草地、风和大地。

scripts.text: We're not sure how much it actually helps. They're mysterious creatures, you know.
scripts.translation: 我们也不知道这到底有多大作用。它们可是神秘的生物。

scripts.text: But we want to try anything that might help.
scripts.translation: 但只要可能有帮助，我们都愿意一试。

scripts.text: It's something that I've been doing by myself usually. But now that my shoulder is injured, I can't really leave this place anymore. Help me, please.
scripts.translation: 平时这些事都是我一个人做。可我伤了肩膀，没法再离开这里了。拜托你帮帮我。

scripts.text: Ahng? Well, too bad. But if you have time later, please drop by. I could use a little help here.
scripts.translation: 昂？真遗憾。之后有空的话再来吧，我正好需要人帮忙。

scripts.text: Look at this beautiful field filled with little blades of grass and twigs breathing!
scripts.translation: 看看这片美丽的田野，小草和细枝都在呼吸呢！

scripts.text: But for some reason, I feel like I can't hear them breathing anymore. So, little Laphines water and sing to cheer them up.
scripts.translation: 可不知为何，我好像听不见它们呼吸了。所以小拉菲尼族会浇水、唱歌，让大地打起精神。

scripts.text: I think it's time for Laphines to start today's work.
scripts.translation: 我想该让拉菲尼族们开始今天的工作了。

scripts.text: Take a look at this beautiful field. It feels like you can hear each twig and blade of grass singing, right?
scripts.translation: 看看这片美丽的田野。仿佛能听见每根细枝、每株小草都在歌唱，对吧？

scripts.text: Can you...hear the voice of the earth? It sounds very sad right now.
scripts.translation: 你...听得到大地的声音吗？它现在听起来很悲伤。

scripts.text: Whew, did I sing too much? I'm so thirsty. A glass of rice wine sounds great, hah~
scripts.translation: 呼，唱太久了吗？好渴啊。真想喝一杯米酒，哈~

scripts.text: Did the great Fili send you? Man, he's got skills for sure! I shall start singing then!?
scripts.translation: 是伟大的菲利派你来的？他可真有办法！那我开唱了！？

scripts.text: I suppose you came to tell me to start working? Don't worry, my voice will touch the earth~
scripts.translation: 你是来叫我开工的吧？放心，我的歌声会打动大地~

scripts.text: As soon as the Laphine started singing, it began to warm my heart.
scripts.translation: 拉菲尼族一开口歌唱，我的心也暖了起来。

scripts.text: I'm singing for flowers and the earth.
scripts.translation: 我在为花朵和大地歌唱。

scripts.text: I think it's time to start singing...
It feels great to sing for the earth.
I think the earth is running dry.
I think this is enough for the day. I have to take a break and draw water, too. Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 今天浇到这里就够了。我也得休息一下，去打点水。嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: I'll water these dying flowers and grasses again. This brings them back to life! Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 再给这些快枯萎的花草浇浇水，它们就能恢复生机！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: I'm watering here and there. You look so tired! Should I water you, too?
scripts.translation: 我正在到处浇水呢。你看起来很累，要不要也给你浇一点？

scripts.text: I'm sure Eclage needs a Laphine like me! Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 埃克拉珠肯定需要我这样的拉菲尼族！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: Oh, they started working? I'll start watering the earth then. I mean, sometimes we Laphines can be practical, too!
scripts.translation: 哦，他们开工了？那我也来给大地浇水吧。我们拉菲尼族有时也很务实呢！

scripts.text: Do you hear the sound of grasses and flowers coming alive again? It's all because I watered them diligently! Hehe~!
scripts.translation: 你听到花草重新焕发生机的声音了吗？这可都是我勤快浇水的功劳！嘿嘿~！

scripts.text: Hehe~! Now that I'm done watering, I should wait for the great Fili.
scripts.translation: 嘿嘿~水浇完了，该等伟大的菲利来了。

scripts.text: It's my job to water the earth.
scripts.translation: 给大地浇水就是我的工作。

scripts.text: It's important to warm up like this before you start dancing. One, two, three, four....
scripts.translation: 跳舞前这样热身很重要。一、二、三、四...

scripts.text: I would love to see the great Fili next time...
scripts.translation: 下次真想让伟大的菲利看看...

scripts.text: Ah, it's you again! You're so insensitive. Anyway, you're here to tell me to start working, right? I see, I see. You can go now.
scripts.translation: 啊，又是你！真不解风情。你是来叫我开工的吧？知道了，知道了。你可以走了。

scripts.text: I can't dance well when adventurers like you are watching! Don't worry and just go~ I won't slack off on the job, okay?
scripts.translation: 有冒险者看着，我跳不好！放心走吧~我不会偷懒的，好吗？

scripts.text: I do Hip Hop dancing moves whenever I feel sad. Huh? Oh, it's a dance style. It's very elegant and it makes your heart ache.
scripts.translation: 我难过时就跳嘻哈舞。嗯？那是一种

scripts.text: You mean the great Fili said to start the work? But why would he ask you to tell us?
scripts.translation: 伟大的菲利让我们开工了？他为什么不自己来告诉我们？

scripts.text: I could've showed Fili my new moves!
scripts.translation: 我本可以向菲利展示我的新舞步的！

scripts.text: Oh well, I'll just do the moves I was doing earlier today. You know, Fili should be the first one to see my new moves, so...
scripts.translation: 算了，我就跳今天早些时候跳的那些舞步吧。毕竟，菲利应该是第一个看到我的新舞步的人，所以...

scripts.text: So, how does dancing help the earth exactly...?
scripts.translation: 跳舞到底是怎么帮助大地的...？

scripts.text: Look at you, a cold-hearted adventurer! All the Laphines living in this area can feel it. We hear the sounds of the earth and creatures.
scripts.translation: 你可真是个冷酷的冒险者！住在这里的拉菲尼族都能感受到，我们听得到大地和生灵的声音。

scripts.text: You'll see as you continue your adventure. Anyway, I'll start working now.
scripts.translation: 继续冒险下去你就会明白了。总之，我要开工了。

scripts.text: I would really love to see the great Fili next time.
scripts.translation: 我真希望能再次见到伟大的菲利。

scripts.text: I do Hip Hop dancing moves whenever I feel sad. Huh? Oh, it's a dance style. It's very elegant and it makes your heart ache.
scripts.translation: 舞蹈，很优雅，看了会让人心疼。

scripts.text: When the grasses sway in the wind, doesn't it look like they're actually dancing?
scripts.translation: 当草儿在风中摇曳时，看起来是不是就像在跳舞一样？

scripts.text: Is this the first time that you're seeing a blooming field? It's so beautiful, just like me.
scripts.translation: 你第一次看到鲜花盛开的田野吗？真美，就像我一样。

scripts.text: It takes a cute person like me to bring joy to the earth...Too bad that you'll never be able to do so!
scripts.translation: 只有我这么可爱的人，才能让大地开心...可惜你永远做不到！

scripts.text: You're new, right? Tell him I'll start the work.
scripts.translation: 你是新来的吧？告诉他我这就开工。

scripts.text: You might think smiling to the earth always is nothing, but it's not that easy actually. I mean, it's hard to be cute like me in the first place~
scripts.translation: 你可能觉得一直对大地微笑很容易，其实没那

scripts.text: I hope someday the flowers, trees, grasses, and little creatures on this earth will smile with joy.
scripts.translation: 希望有一天，地上的花朵、树木、小草和小生灵都能开心地笑。

scripts.text: You mean you were asked a favor from the great Fili? Are you a new worker then?
scripts.translation: 你接受了伟大的菲利委托？那你是新来的帮手吗？

scripts.text: Don't be shy. I started working just recently, too. But since I was here first, I'm your boss, okay?!
scripts.translation: 别害羞嘛，我也是最近才开始工作的。不过我比你先来，所以我是你的老板，懂吗？！

scripts.text: We all love the earth, but we express it in different ways. Like, thorugh dancing or singing.
scripts.translation: 我们都热爱大地，只是表达方式不同，比如跳舞或唱歌。

scripts.text: Looks like...you're not really good at anything!
scripts.translation: 看起来...你似乎没什么特长嘛！

scripts.text: Well, what do you do then?
Oh come on~You're insensitive, too? Look at me, so cute and nice!
scripts.translation: 哎呀~你也太迟钝了吧？看看我，多可爱、多亲切！

scripts.text: My job is to share my smile with the earth. If I smile like this, I'm sure the earth will feel so much better!
scripts.translation: 我的工作就是把笑容分享给大地。我这样笑，大地一定会舒服多了！

scripts.text: Anyway, you should find some work for the earth as well. Tell Fili that I'll start working.
scripts.translation: 总之，你也该为大地做点事。告诉菲利我开始工作了。

scripts.text: As soon as he finished talking, he put on a bright smile.
scripts.translation: 他说完便露出了灿烂的笑容。

scripts.text: You might think smiling to the earth always is nothing, but it's not that easy actually. I mean, it's hard to be cute like me in the first place~
scripts.translation: 么简单。首先，要像我这么可爱就很难啦~

scripts.text: Don't you always smile when you remember good memories of the past?
scripts.translation: 想起美好的回忆时，你不也会笑吗？

scripts.text: I need to get a scoop. Something that will catch the eyes of adventurers!
scripts.translation: 我得挖到独家新闻，找到能吸引冒险者目光的大消息！

scripts.text: Anyway, this isn't an ordinary place. This place, it's filled with newsworthy stories!
scripts.translation: 总之，这里可不是普通的地方，而是新闻不断的好地方！

scripts.text: It's you again! Oh, is it because I'm a woman? Let me make it clear here. I'm going nowhere until I get a news item.
scripts.translation: 又是你！哦，因为我是女人，你就觉得我不行吗？我说清楚，在挖到新闻之前我哪儿也不去。

scripts.text: Oh my gosh! You scared me! What are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 天哪！你吓到我了！你在这儿干什么？

scripts.text: I see...I didn't know they're worried about me. But I can't go back now. I'm a journalist.
scripts.translation: 原来如此...我不知道大家这么担心我。可我现在不能回去，我是记者。

scripts.text: I write news articles for adventurers for a magazaine called Monthly Brigan.
scripts.translation: 我在一本叫《月刊布里根》的杂志上为冒险者撰写新闻。

scripts.text: I had a hard time coming here, and I feel like I'll get an exclusive scoop here any minute! But it's just not happening yet...
scripts.translation: 我费了好大劲才来到这里，总觉得随时就能挖到独家新闻！可现在还没动静...

scripts.text: Anyway, I'm doing well. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation: 总之，我过得很好。告诉他别担心。

scripts.text: This tower is very quiet yet mysterious. It's definitely something that adventurers would love, right?
scripts.translation: 这座塔既安静又神秘，冒险者肯定喜欢这种地方，对吧？

scripts.text: Gosh, you're just bugging me. Don't worry, I can take care of myself just fine!
scripts.translation: 真是的，别烦我了。我能照顾好自己！

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'll get the biggest scoop of the year!
scripts.translation: 放心，我一定会挖到年度最大新闻！

scripts.text: I'm exploring every inch of the tower. I'll write about it in my memoirs later.
scripts.translation: 我正在探索这座塔的每个角落，以后要把经历写进回忆录。

scripts.text: Don't take me lightly just because I'm young. I've already been to every part of Midgard continent. I'm a real adventurer, you know.
scripts.translation: 别看我年轻就小瞧我。我已经走遍米德加尔特大陆每个角落了，是真正的冒险者！

scripts.text: You really shouldn't worry about me. I'll go out when I'm done exploring...Tell him I'm doing okay.
scripts.translation: 真的不用担心我。探索完我就会出去...告诉他我一切都好。

scripts.text: I shall leave to explore different parts now.
scripts.translation: 我现在要去探索别的地方了。

scripts.text: Are you an adventurer, too? Don't you dare cut in here. I was here first.
scripts.translation: 你也是冒险者？别插队，是我先来的。

scripts.text: What do you mean? I didn't cut in!
scripts.translation: 你什么意思？我没有插队！

scripts.text: Well, I was exploring here first. So you should come back later. I'll be a great adventurer!
scripts.translation: 明明是我先在这里探索的，你晚点再来吧。我会成为伟大的冒险者！

scripts.text: Hah, that Laphine must be very idle, worrying about an adventurer. He shouldn't worry about a guy who's going to be the king of adventurers!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，那个拉菲尼族可真闲，居然担心一个冒险者。我可是要成为冒险者之王的人，没什么好担心的！

scripts.text: I'll leave my footprints in every part of the world, find all kinds of treasures and hide them somewhere. Every adventurer will try to follow my path then!
scripts.translation: 我要走遍世界每个角落，找到各种宝藏再藏起来。到时候每个冒险者都会追随我的足迹！

scripts.text: If you get an autograph from me now, you might be able to feed three generations of your family in the future. How does it sound, you want one?
scripts.translation: 现在拿到我的签名，将来能养活你们家三代人。怎么样，要不要？

scripts.text: You certainly are a poor judge of character! Anyway, tell him not to worry about me. I'll be the king of adventurers! I shall go explore more then.
scripts.translation: 你真不会看人！总之告诉他别担心，我会成为冒险者之王！我继续探索去了。

scripts.text: You want my autograph? If not, please don't interrupt.
scripts.translation: 你想要签名吗？不然就别打扰我。

scripts.text: Don't worry about me. I'll be a great adventurer!
Don't worry about me. I'll be a great adventurer!
This tower is mysterious. It's an interesting place.
This tower is mysterious. It's an interesting place.
No need to worry about me! ^FF0000I'll definitely go home this time!^000000 Thanks for everything! I'll take you out for a nice meal next time!
scripts.translation: 不用担心我！这次我一定会回家的！谢谢你帮忙！下次我请你吃顿好的！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Ah...What a relief...I'm so glad you're here. I was about to leave this tower alone! But I think I'm lost.
scripts.translation: 啊...总算松了口气...幸好你来了。我本来想独自离开这座塔，结果好像迷路了。

scripts.text: I'm hungry again from walking around so much...I'm so hungry that I can't walk anymore.
scripts.translation: 走了这么多路，我又饿了...饿得连路都走不动。

scripts.text: Did I walk too much? I'm covered with dust again. It keeps covering my eyes.
scripts.translation: 我是不是走太多了？身上又沾满灰尘，眼睛都快睁不开了。

scripts.text: Whew, I guess I was walking around really hard...somehow, I lost all the souvenirs they collected for me...
scripts.translation: 呼，我刚才一定走得太急了...不知怎么的，大家给我的纪念品全丢了...

scripts.text: Good to see you again, my friend!
I'm here to see if you're still alive.
It's from that muscular Laphine, right? He's a good guy. Tell him not to worry about me.
scripts.translation: 是那个肌肉发达的拉菲尼族送来的吧？他人很好。告诉他不用担心我。

scripts.text: I guess I'll have no problem finding my way out of this tower now. I'm full...and I just need to get a few more souvenirs...
scripts.translation: 现在我应该能找到出口了。我吃饱了...再收集几个纪念品就好...

scripts.text: I'll be fine if only I could get rid of those in my way, haha...We're almost out, right?
scripts.translation: 只要把挡路的家伙弄走就行，哈哈...我们快出去了吧？

scripts.text: I'm starving to death though... Could you please help me, my friend?
scripts.translation: 不过我快饿死了...朋友，能帮帮我吗？

scripts.text: I really liked the meat you brought. Except that it wasn't really well seasoned and the texture was a little crumbly...but...it was still eatable, haha...
scripts.translation: 我很喜欢你带来的肉。虽然调味不足，口感也有点散...不过还是能吃，哈哈...

scripts.text: Ah, how long has it been since the last time I saw food! Yummm! Thank goodness it's meat! I think it's a little tough...and not warm enough...but still, it's meat!!
scripts.translation: 啊，我多久没吃东西了！真好吃！谢天谢地是肉！虽然有点硬，也不够热...但这可是肉啊！！

scripts.text: Thank you so much!! Yum yum. You're such a good friend! Munch munch.
scripts.translation: 太感谢了！！好吃好吃。你真是我的好朋友！嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: I should get a hustle on and find a way out now! I feel like I can get out of here this time!
scripts.translation: 我得赶紧找出口！这次感觉一定能出去！

scripts.text: Food...I need food...It seems as if the sky is falling...
scripts.translation: 食物...我需要食物...感觉天都要塌下来了...

scripts.text: Seeing his eyes and hearing him coughing constantly, I can tell he needs something to eat, like meat.
scripts.translation: 看他眼神涣散，又咳个不停，应该是饿了，得给他吃点肉。

scripts.text: As you can see...I couldn't find a way out of this tower again. And I'm so hungry that I feel like I might pass out...
scripts.translation: 你看...我又找不到离开这座塔的路了。我饿得快晕过去了...

scripts.text: Ah...I'm so glad that I met a good friend like you.
scripts.translation: 啊...能遇见你这样的好朋友真好。

scripts.text: I thought I was so close to getting out of this tower. But when I looked around, I was at the same place again.
scripts.translation: 我以为快走出塔了，结果一看，又回到了原地。

scripts.text: Maybe this tower is under a curse.
scripts.translation: 这座塔说不定被诅咒了。

scripts.text: Or maybe it's just that you have a poor sense of direction?
...I wouldn't really deny that. But anyway, could you get me something to eat? I'm starving...
scripts.translation: ...我也不否认。总之，能给我点吃的吗？我快饿死了...

scripts.text: Alright! I'll be back in a second!
Thanks. I prefer meat, if possible...I really liked what you gave me last time, and I think acorns go well with meat. Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 谢啦。能给肉最好...上次你带来的东西真不错，我觉得橡果配肉也很合适。哈哈。

scripts.text: Why don't you just eat whatever I get you!
scripts.translation: 你就吃我带来的东西吧！

scripts.text: As long as I'm getting something to eat, I was just hoping for a good one. I'm sorry, but do me a favor please. I couldn't forget the taste of the meat.
scripts.translation: 有吃的就行，我只是想吃点好东西。不好意思，再帮我一次吧，我忘不了那肉的味道。

scripts.text: Okay...I see. I'll try to find another way then. If you meet that muscular Laphine on your way out, tell him I won't be able to see him again...
scripts.translation: 好吧...那我再想别的办法。你出去时要是遇到那个肌肉发达的拉菲尼族，告诉他我可能再也见不到他了...

scripts.text: Ahaha, no need to worry about me! I can do this by myself!
scripts.translation: 哈哈，不用担心我！我自己能搞定！

scripts.text: Hey, you really are a good adventurer! I'm actually starting to like you even more.
scripts.translation: 嘿，你真是个好冒险者！我越来越喜欢你了。

scripts.text: I'll take care of the rest. I can't just keep bothering you, right? Hahaha.
scripts.translation: 剩下的我自己来，不好一直麻烦你，对吧？哈哈。

scripts.text: These guys are not really visible and they're so annoying. Ah...I asked you to clean up, but it's not because I'm lazy or anything. Hahaha...
scripts.translation: 这些家伙不太显眼，却烦人得很。啊，我让你来清理可不是因为我懒，哈哈...

scripts.text: Eek! I was going to get out on my own while you were gone. But then I found something interesting...so I guess I was wandering around a little...
scripts.translation: 哎呀！趁你不在时我本想自己出去，可后来发现了有趣的东西...就到处逛了逛...

scripts.text: And then these guys piled up again!
scripts.translation: 然后这些家伙又堆起来了！

scripts.text: Of course I can do it on my own~ But if I do it alone, then I'll end up using too much of my energy, and then I'll get hungry again...
scripts.translation: 我当然能自己来~可那样太耗体力，之后我又会饿...

scripts.text: So you want me to help you brushing off the dust?
scripts.translation: 所以你想让我帮你拍掉灰尘？

scripts.text: How did you know? I think we're really clicking! If I have a chance, I'll let you join my guild later.
scripts.translation: 你怎么知道？我们真有默契！以后有机会，我让你加入我的公会。

scripts.text: Fight off some Cherenes then. You don't have to eliminate that many because I'll start fighting soon, too! Haha.
scripts.translation: 去打倒几只切雷涅斯吧，不用打太多，我很快也会加入战斗！哈哈。

scripts.text: I see. Just don't feel too guilty if you find me dead next time you're here. It's not your fault.
scripts.translation: 我知道了。下次你要是发现我死在这里，也别太自责，不是你的错。

scripts.text: I think I have enough souvenirs! They'll be surprised to see these souvenirs with lots of memories!
scripts.translation: 纪念品应该够了！朋友们看到这些充满回忆的东西，一定会很惊喜！

scripts.text: Thanks! Man, you're awesome! What a desirable and talented individual you are!
scripts.translation: 谢谢！你太棒了！真是个迷人又有才华的人！

scripts.text: I hope to see you again in Midgard! We should team up and begin a great adventure together!
scripts.translation: 希望能在米德加尔特再见！到时我们组队，一起展开伟大冒险！

scripts.text: I'll make sure to give my friends all the souvenirs you collected for me, and I'll tell them about you, too!
scripts.translation: 我会把你收集的纪念品送给朋友，也会告诉他们你的事！

scripts.text: I don't need that many. Maybe one for each of them?
scripts.translation: 我不用拿那么多，每人一份就够了吧？

scripts.text: Oh, come to think of it, I lost the bookmarks you collected for me...I mean the ones made of fallen leaves...I should collect them again...
scripts.translation: 对了，我把你收集的落叶书签弄丢了...得重新收集才行...

scripts.text: Would you mind helping me with that? What are friends for! Hahaha! Thanks!!
scripts.translation: 愿意帮我吗？朋友就是互相帮忙的嘛！哈哈，谢谢！

scripts.text: When I came to myself, I realized that everything you brought me was gone! I thought I put it right here!
scripts.translation: 回过神来才发现你带来的东西全不见了！我明明放在这里的！

scripts.text: I'm really really sorry, but could you help me again? Just the thought of seeing my friends makes me cry like this. Please~?
scripts.translation: 真不好意思，又要麻烦你了。一想到要见朋友，我就忍不住哭成这样。拜托啦~？

scripts.text: What a poor guy! I'll help him.
Bookmarks made of fallen leaves...Ah, they bring so many memories back and make my eyes teary. I'm sure my friends will love it!
scripts.translation: 落叶做的书签...啊，勾起好多回忆，我都快掉眼泪了。朋友们一定会喜欢！

scripts.text: I see...It's my fault. I'll probably end my life here, collecting souvenirs...but it's none of your business...
scripts.translation: 我明白了...是我的错。看来我只能在这里收集纪念品，直到死去...不过与你无关...

scripts.text: You're done collecting the bookmarks!? Full of reminiscences as expected. Everyone would love it!
scripts.translation: 书签都收集齐了吗！？果然满载着回忆，大家一定会喜欢！

scripts.text: I just finished writing a song. Do you want to listen?
scripts.translation: 我刚写完一首歌，想听听吗？

scripts.text: ^D96E26On that path again~I was wandering for a while~^000000
scripts.translation: 又走上那条路~我徘徊了好久~ ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: ^D96E26Familiar dungeon~full of monsters~and hunger in a maze~^000000
scripts.translation: 熟悉的迷宫~满是魔物~还有挥之不去的饥饿~ ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: ^D96E26when I was trying to run away~thankfully no monster was there~^000000
scripts.translation: 我正想逃走~幸好那里没有魔物~ ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: ^D96E26but I couldn't make it~that far~I was faint with hunger.^000000
scripts.translation: 可我没能走远~饿得快要晕倒了。 ^D96E26^000000

scripts.text: So far so good, right? If you think it's similar to another song, it's just your imagination!
scripts.translation: 目前听起来还不错吧？你要觉得像别的歌，那一定是错觉！

scripts.text: I think I've heard this before.
Thanks! If I have a chance, I'll make a song about how you helped me, too!
scripts.translation: 谢谢！有机会我也会写首歌，讲讲你怎么帮我的！

scripts.text: Ahaha...really? You might be right...? Oh well, I'll make another one, don't worry...
scripts.translation: 啊哈哈...真的吗？也许你说得对...算了，我会再写一首，别担心...

scripts.text: I should really get going now. I've been to most parts of the tower and I'm pretty full, too.
scripts.translation: 我真该走了。塔里大部分地方都逛过了，也吃饱了。

scripts.text: Thanks again, my friend! I hope to see you again somewhere. I can find a way out on my own.
scripts.translation: 再谢你一次，朋友！希望以后还能再见。我能自己找到出口。

scripts.text: Don't worry. I'm pretty much done writing a song. I'm almost done with the lyrics as well as the melody.
scripts.translation: 别担心，我的歌快写完了，歌词和旋律都差不多了。

scripts.text: ^FF0000By the time you're done collecting souvenirs,^000000 I'll probably be done. Thanks again, my friend.
scripts.translation: 等你收集完纪念品，我应该也差不多好了。谢啦，朋友。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: I've been thinking about it...and I think they would love ^FF0000bookmarks made of fallen leaves!^000000 It's full of reminiscences of the past! I'm sure!
scripts.translation: 我想了想...大家一定会喜欢用落叶做的书签！那满载着过去的回忆！我敢肯定！ ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: If you look at the books scattered all over the tower, there are bookmarks inside. I think it'll be a great gift for my friends even though it has someone else's memories.
scripts.translation: 塔里散落的书中夹着书签。虽然上面留着别人的回忆，但我觉得送给朋友会是很棒的礼物。

scripts.text: ^FF0000A good melody^000000 just came across my mind, and I think I should start writing a song now. You should collect souvenirs for me in the meantime.
scripts.translation: 我刚想到一段好旋律，得马上写首歌。你先帮我收集纪念品吧。 ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: Good job! Now, let's enjoy the rest of...No! I mean, let's find a way out!
scripts.translation: 干得好！现在来享受剩下的...不！我是说，快找条出路！

scripts.text: ...but then, I feel like something's missing. I should bring some souvenirs since I'll probably never come here again, right?
scripts.translation: ...不过总觉得还缺点什么。既然可能再也不来这里，不如带点纪念品回去？

scripts.text: Actually...I feel like my friends would just get mad at me if I go back empty-handed.
scripts.translation: 其实...要是空手回去，朋友们肯定会生我的气。

scripts.text: I should bring some souvenirs to make them feel better. Is there anything I could use?
scripts.translation: 我该带点纪念品让他们开心。有什么合适的东西吗？

scripts.text: Jellopies are good collectables...but I think it's a little too common. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation: 杰勒比结晶确实适合收藏...不过太常见了。还有别的吗？

scripts.text: Hey... but it's not something we can get around here.
Hmm? What's that for? I guess new items came out while I was travelling.
scripts.translation: 嗯？那是什么？我旅行期间出新道具了吗？

scripts.text: I can't get them unless I know what they are. Is there anything else?
scripts.translation: 我都不知道那是什么，怎么收集？还有别的吗？

scripts.text: Card Album... I can't give my friends something that might be come up with nothing! Anything else?
scripts.translation: 卡册啊...万一什么都开不出来，我可没法送给朋友。还有别的吗？

scripts.text: Loots from local monsters...hmm, that sounds interesting!
scripts.translation: 当地魔物的战利品...嗯，听起来不错！

scripts.text: I'm sure they haven't made it here yet. So it's something new for them, too! Right?
scripts.translation: 他们肯定还没见过这些，对他们来说也是新鲜玩意！对吧？

scripts.text: And it tells them where I've been to so far.
scripts.translation: 而且还能让他们知道我去过哪些地方。

scripts.text: That's a good idea. Let's think about what to collect then.
scripts.translation: 好主意。那我们想想收集什么吧。

scripts.text: Are you done yet? Well, I'm still working on the lyrics, too...but you have to hurry up. It's time to get out of here.
scripts.translation: 你弄好了吗？我还在写歌词...不过你得快点，我们该离开了。

scripts.text: Of course I'm lost because I have a poor sense of direction...but there's another reason to it, too!
scripts.translation: 我迷路是因为方向感差...不过还有另一个原因！

scripts.text: You see those guys over there? I think they're stopping me from finding a way out for some reason.
scripts.translation: 看到那边那些家伙了吗？我觉得它们在故意拦着我，不让我找出口。

scripts.text: No, you have to see them carefully. Those Dustballs over there are covering my eyes, and when I can't see clearly, I get sleepy and hungry...
scripts.translation: 不，你仔细看。那些尘埃球挡住了我的视线，看不清就会犯困、肚子饿...

scripts.text: I think it's just your imagination!
No, no. I'm sure they're stopping me. Get rid of them, please. Maybe just a couple of them? I have some lyrics coming into my mind just now...so I should write them down...
scripts.translation: 不，我确定它们在捣乱。拜托把它们赶走，几只就好。我刚想到几句歌词，得赶紧记下来...

scripts.text: Yey it's meat! I loooove meat!
scripts.translation: 耶，是肉！我最最最爱肉了！

scripts.text: Yum yum. Munch munch. Yum yum!
scripts.translation: 好吃好吃，嚼嚼嚼，好吃好吃！

scripts.text: Munch munch. Yum yum yum. Munch munch
scripts.translation: 嚼嚼嚼，好吃好吃，嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: Man, it's so good! This is it! Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 哇，真好吃！就是这个味道！好吃好吃。

scripts.text: If I find a way out, I should make a song for that muscular Laphine. Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 找到出口后，我要给那个肌肉发达的拉菲尼族写首歌。好吃好吃。

scripts.text: I'm not...sure when that would be though...munch munch.
scripts.translation: 不过...不知道要等到什么时候...嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text: Oh, it's nothing. Don't worry. I came into this tower by accident and I got lost. Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 没什么，别担心。我是不小心进了这座塔，结果迷路了。好吃好吃。

scripts.text: To tell you the truth, I got lost somewhere about 2 years ago and I traveled around to wherever. Yum yum.
scripts.translation: 说实话，我大概两年前就迷路了，只能到处流浪。好吃好吃。

scripts.text: and then I found this tower and came inside because I thought it'd be fun. But I haven't found a way out since then.
scripts.translation: 后来发现这座塔，觉得有趣就进来了，可从那以后一直没找到出口。

scripts.text: I feel so much better now. Thanks, my friend! This must be a destiny! Would you help me?
scripts.translation: 我感觉好多了，谢谢你，朋友！这一定是命运！你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Ah...I guess this is the fear of death...memories of the past are going through my mind like a flash...like happy moments we had at the south gate of Prontera...
scripts.translation: 啊...这就是死亡的恐惧吗...过去的回忆像走马灯一样闪过...比如我们在普隆德拉南门度过的快乐时光...

scripts.text: I guess this is it for me...I had such a good life...
scripts.translation: 看来我就要死在这里了...这一生过得真不错...

scripts.text: It's kind of sad that I'm actually starving to death...but I had a good time, my beloved guild members...
scripts.translation: 我快饿死了，真有点难过...不过我过得很开心，我亲爱的公会成员们...

scripts.text: I brought some meat from Fili!
scripts.translation: 我从菲利那里带了些肉！

scripts.text: Oh, I loooove meat! But...is there any vegetable?
scripts.translation: 哦，我超爱肉！不过...有蔬菜吗？

scripts.text: Like...garnishes for meat, you know. I could get tired of eating just meat...Could you get me some?
scripts.translation: 就是肉的配菜嘛。我怕光吃肉会腻...能帮我找点吗？

scripts.text: I mean something like acorns! I saw a pile of acorns just outside the tower.
scripts.translation: 像橡果那样的东西！我在塔外看到一堆橡果。

scripts.text: I'm here to see if you're doing okay.
I don't know if I should say I'm okay...or not...
scripts.translation: 我也不知道自己算不算好...

scripts.text: I haven't eaten anything for days...I feel like I'm going to pass out any minute.
scripts.translation: 我好几天没吃东西了...感觉随时都会晕倒。

scripts.text: But for now, I'm ^FF0000still^000000 alive...but no one knows until when...ah, I'm getting sleepy again...
scripts.translation: 不过我还活着...谁知道还能撑多久...啊，我又困了... ^FF0000^000000

scripts.text: You know that Laphine outside...yes, that muscular Laphine...tell him to bring me some food before I die.
scripts.translation: 你知道外面那个肌肉发达的拉菲尼族吧？让他在我死前给我带点吃的。

scripts.text: It doesn't have to be delicious...just give me any food...I feel so weak that I can't even walk.
scripts.translation: 不用好吃的...随便给我点吃的就行...我虚弱得走不动了。

scripts.text: Ah, I felt so dizzy that my head was spinning before, and now I can't see anything at all! Is it night or day? I'm so hungry...
scripts.translation: 刚才我头晕得天旋地转，现在什么也看不见了！这是白天还是晚上？我好饿...

scripts.text: A glass of red potion for breakfast~another glass of red potion for lunch~you're already addicted~ Ah, I'm too hungry to sing...
scripts.translation: 早餐一杯红色药水~午餐再来一杯红色药水~你已经上瘾啦~啊，我饿得唱不动了...

scripts.text: You are not wearing the correct equipment
scripts.translation: 你没有穿戴正确的装备
蘑菇的当前状态为-，九的当 {0}
新奥兹要设置哪个物品？
新奥兹你是来确认图像的吗？

scripts.text: What you see right now is a regular expression.
You want a little more smile?
scripts.translation: 兹想笑得更开心一点吗？

scripts.text: Tell me all that you want!
- You have too many items to proceed with the conversation
scripts.translation: - 您的物品栏已满，无法继续对话

scripts.text: How did you get up here?
Are you a monster that I created?
scripts.translation: 难道你是我创造的魔物？

scripts.text: I have a job for you, so strengthen yourself to the level of an incubus and then return to me!
scripts.translation: 我有事交给你。先把自己练到魅魔的程度再回来！

scripts.text: Busy, busy, busy! Monsters, I have to create more monsters!
scripts.translation: 忙死了！我得创造更多魔物！危险！不知

scripts.text: Danger! I don't know when attack will come!
scripts.translation: 道敌人什么时候会来！它来了

scripts.text: How did you get up here? I kept many monsters around the tower!
scripts.translation: ！你怎么上来的？我在塔周围放了那么多

scripts.text: There's no way anyone could have invaded it! That means, you... you are!
scripts.translation: 魔物！没人能闯进来才对！难道你...你是！

scripts.text: Are you a monster that I created?
I want to know about the tower.

scripts.translation: 这是一只会说话的虫子！

scripts.text: Why am I in a tower?
It's been so long that I forgot everything!
scripts.translation: 塔里？过了太久，什么都忘了！

scripts.text: Just because I made you without much effort are your eyes just that much deficient?!
scripts.translation: 你这魔物！就因为我随手把你造出来，你就觉得我的眼光这么差吗？！

scripts.text: Professor Worm probes his own face and becomes shocked. He sees his own face through the silver plate and is really shocked.
scripts.translation: 沃姆教授摸摸自己的脸，惊讶不已。他从银盘里看到自己的倒影，更是大吃一惊。

scripts.text: When did my handsome face become like this? My name is...
scripts.translation: 我英俊的脸怎么变成这样了？我叫...

scripts.text: My goodness, I even forgot the name!
Don't just stand there please go and find my portrait!
scripts.translation: 了！别愣着，快去找我的画像！

scripts.text: You came all the way up here in your free time and you are telling me you're busy?!
scripts.translation: 你利用空闲时间特意跑到这里来，却告诉我你很忙？！

scripts.text: Well, you have to be curious.
While my memory got worse my intuition improved so much!
scripts.translation: 的记忆虽然越来越差，直觉倒是敏

scripts.text: If you want to hear what you want to hear help me get my memory back!
scripts.translation: 锐多了！想知道答案就帮我恢复记忆！

scripts.text: Among the many books on the shelves in this room my portrait is bookmarked inside somewhere. Please find it!

scripts.text: Oh, yes. Mayor has bestowed a wing on you.
scripts.translation: 啊，对。市长赐给你一对翅膀。

scripts.text: It's nothing huge, but it's not common, either.
scripts.translation: 这不是什么稀罕的宝物，不过也不

scripts.text: Just shake it gently and you'll find yourself in Eclage anytime.
scripts.translation: 常见。轻轻一摇，你就能随时回到埃克拉珠。

scripts.text: It's an item that fits you perfectly. I mean you, who work for the king. Hehe.
scripts.translation: 这东西很适合你——这位为国王效力的人。呵呵。

scripts.text: Ah, you've come at just the right time.
I heard you've been going to Bifrost Tower recently?
scripts.translation: 你最近常去彩虹桥塔？既然你

scripts.text: I wanted to ask you a favor since you're going there anyway...
scripts.translation: 本来就要去，想请你帮个忙...

scripts.text: Actually, I'm sponsoring a scholar of magics.
scripts.translation: 其实我资助了一位魔法学

scripts.text: He needs some materials for experiments, and I was told you can find the materials in Bifrost Tower.
scripts.translation: 者。他需要一些实验材料，听说你能在彩虹桥塔里找到。

scripts.text: If it's okay, can you do me a favor?
scripts.translation: 方便的话能帮我一个忙吗

scripts.text: Of course I'll give you a big reward.
I was worried since it's something unexpected for you. I'm so glad.
scripts.translation: 这事有些突然，我本来还担心你不答应。太好

scripts.text: Collect the following items for me, please.
scripts.translation: 了。请替我收集以下物品。

scripts.text: I need Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves.
scripts.translation: 我需要尘埃球和落叶书

scripts.text: You can find them inside the tower.
Bring me 10 of each for now, please.
I need 10 dustaballs and 10 bookmarks made of fallen leaves.
scripts.translation: 我需要10个尘埃球和10枚落叶书签。在塔里就能找到。

scripts.text: You can find them inside the tower.
This should last for a while.
Who is the scholar of magics?
Scholars and alchemists who belong to the door of truth fall short in many areas aside from research.
scripts.translation: 理之门的学者和炼金术士，除了研究之外，很多方面都捉襟见肘。

scripts.text: Some of them can't make a living and things like that...
scripts.translation: 有些人甚至难以维持生计...我

scripts.text: The one I'm sponsoring is one of them.
scripts.translation: 资助的那位就是其中之一。

scripts.text: I would like to meet him.
That's not going to be possible.
He is in the middle of a very important experiment, and since he's so sensitive, he doesn't like meeting strangers.
scripts.translation: 正在做非常重要的实验，性格又敏感，不喜欢见陌生人。

scripts.text: It's difficult for me to tell you about him and besides, I'm not obligated to tell you about his personal information.
scripts.translation: 我不便透露他的事，也没有义务公开他的个人信息。

scripts.text: Don't bother to ask about him anymore.
A scholar of magics? There's no one with that name among the scholars I know.
scripts.translation: 他。魔法学者？在我认识的学者中没有叫这个名字的人。

scripts.text: Avant that you just asked isn't he a genius who disappeared decades ago after doing some inappropriate experiments?
scripts.translation: 你刚才提到的阿旺，不是那位几十年前做了不当实验后失踪的天才吗？

scripts.text: I don't know where you heard about him but you should give up. You won't be able to find him.
scripts.translation: 我不知道你在哪里听说的，但你还是放弃吧。你找不到他的。

scripts.text: Are you still interested in the scholar that I was sponsoring?
scripts.translation: 你还在打听我资助的那位学者吗？

scripts.text: Unfortunately, he disappeared all of a sudden.
Since he was interested in humans like you, I was going to arrange a meeting for you two,
scripts.translation: 既然他对你们人类感兴趣，我本来打算安排你们见面的，但我

scripts.text: but I don't know where he is...
Mayor ordered us to heighten security around the Orb.
scripts.translation: 市长命令我们加强宝珠周围的警戒。

scripts.text: I don't know why, but you should pay attention, too.
scripts.translation: 我不知道原因，不过你也该多留

scripts.text: Since you're still working for the king and all...right?
scripts.translation: 心。毕竟你还在为国王效力，对吧？

scripts.text: Anyway, are you still interested in the scholar of magics that I was sponsoring?
scripts.translation: 总之，你对我资助的那位魔法学者还感兴趣吗？

scripts.text: That's what you wanted to ask in the first place, right?
scripts.translation: 你一开始想问的就是这个，对吧？

scripts.text: Do you know anything about his research?
scripts.translation: 你知道他的研究内容吗？

scripts.text: He told me he would do me a favor if I sponsored him.
scripts.translation: 道。他告诉我，如果我资助他，他会帮我一个忙。
讨厌他这种突然消失的行为。

scripts.text: Ah...I'm starting to have a headache.
Mayor is ordering me to reinforce the guards for the Orb without even telling me why...
scripts.translation: 。市长连原因都不说，就命令我加强宝珠周围的守卫...

scripts.text: and the scholar that I was sponsoring is gone...
scripts.translation: 而且我资助的那位学者也失踪了...天

scripts.text: Ha...I think I might have been cheated.
He promised to do a research on the topic that I'm interested in, only if I sponsored him for a certain period of time.
scripts.translation: 己可能被骗了。他答应只要我资助他一段时间，就会研究我感兴趣的课题。

scripts.text: Did you know what he was researching?
scripts.translation: 你知道他在研究什么吗？

scripts.text: What did you want him to research about?
What he asked for was pretty simple.
I provided a place for living and researching and the cost of materials used when doing a research upon my request.
scripts.translation: 提供住处和研究场地，并支付按我要求开展研究所需的材料费。

scripts.text: I thought he was doing a research on the topic that I was interested in.
scripts.translation: 我以为他在研究我感兴趣的课题。前几天你

scripts.text: Didn't you give me the materials the other day?
scripts.translation: 不是把材料交给我了吗？就

scripts.text: The ones related to the monsters inside the tower.
scripts.translation: 是那些和塔里魔物有关的东西。

scripts.text: He just ran away when I had fed him, housed him, and provided him with the materials for experiments!!
scripts.translation: 我给他提供食宿和实验材料，他却就这么逃走了！！真让

scripts.text: Why do you complain after so long a time?
...I thought about it and I didn't have anyone else to talk to.
scripts.translation: ...我想了想，实在找不到别人倾诉。

scripts.text: I wasn't sponsoring him in secret, but still...
scripts.translation: 我资助他并没有刻意隐瞒，不

scripts.text: When I asked about his whereabouts to the scholars in the gate of the truth, they didn't know either...
scripts.translation: 过...我去真理之门问他的下落，那里的学者也不知道...

scripts.text: ...and I was going to ask him to do a research on Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation: ...我本来还打算让他研究迷雾森林。

scripts.text: I have to look for another scholar now.
scripts.translation: 现在只好另找一位学者了。

scripts.text: I didn't want to provide him with food and a place to live for free,
scripts.translation: 我不想白白提供食宿，所以

scripts.text: so I asked him to do a research on Bifrost Tower.
That's all I did, and I don't know anything other than that.
scripts.translation: 我做的就这些，其他一概不知。

scripts.text: When he finishes the research, I was going to ask him to do another research on Hazy Forest.
scripts.translation: 本想等他完成研究后，再让他研究迷雾森林。

scripts.text: But I didn't know he would be irresponsible like this.
scripts.translation: 没想到他这么不负责任。我

scripts.text: I'm going to have to find another scholar who is more eligible for the job.
scripts.translation: 看来我得找位更称职的学者。

scripts.text: Anyway, this is what happened to me.
By the way, you who work for the king do you know what is on Mayor's mind nowadays?
scripts.translation: 对了，身为国王的协力者，你知道市长最近在想什么吗？

scripts.text: Mayor has to be a representative of Laphines as a whole.
scripts.translation: 市长必须代表全体拉菲尼族。

scripts.text: If he's planning something on his own, it's unacceptable.
scripts.translation: 如果他擅自行动，我们不能接受。

scripts.text: What do you want to know?
He ordered to reinforce the guard around the Orb.
scripts.translation: 。市长下令加强宝珠周围的警戒。你知

scripts.text: To what extent should you tell him?
So, you're saying that the scholar I was sponsoring is 'the Avant?'
scripts.translation: 么？你是说我资助的学者就是“阿旺”？

scripts.text: You didn't even know the name of the person you were sponsoring?
scripts.translation: 你连资助的人叫什么名字都不知道？

scripts.text: It's just that he went by a different name.
scripts.translation: 可能！他只是用了另一个名字。

scripts.text: Anyway, if what you're saying is true, then it is a big problem.
scripts.translation: 如果你说的是真的，那事情就严重了。

scripts.text: But from my observation, I've never seen him talking to other people.
scripts.translation: 不过据我观察，我从没见过他和别人交谈。

scripts.text: Considering his personality, he might have done it out of interest, not with a specific purpose.
scripts.translation: 以他的性格，或许只是出于兴趣，并非有什么特定目的。

scripts.text: Actually I'm hoping that he did it out of interest.
scripts.translation: 其实我希望他真的只是好奇。

scripts.text: The incident in Splendide alone gives me a headache...but things are getting even worse.
scripts.translation: 光是辉煌领域的事件就够让我头疼了...现在情况更糟。

scripts.text: Although you're a foreigner, you're under obligation to protect the Orb since you know everything.
scripts.translation: 你虽是外国人，但既然知道内情，就有责任保护宝珠。

scripts.text: I hope not, but if something bad happens I would like you to help me.
scripts.translation: 希望不会出事，不过真有状况的话，还请你帮忙。

scripts.text: Now I should focus more on deploying the guards.
Mayor Jun didn't feel safe for some reason and because of that, he ordered us to tighten guard?
scripts.translation: ？君市长不知为何觉得不安，所以才下令加强警戒？

scripts.text: I should do it if he says so.
I should believe that Mayor gave us the order after considering it normally and logically.
scripts.translation: 令，我就照办。我应该相信市长是经过理性考量才下令的。

scripts.text: I thought you were the one who Mayor Jun trusts the most in Eclage.
scripts.translation: 。我还以为你是君市长在埃克拉珠最信任的人。

scripts.text: Whatever the reason is, I should believe that Mayor gave us the order after considering it normally and logically.
scripts.translation: 不管原因是什么，我都该相信市长是经过理性考量才下达命令。

scripts.text: You don't want to follow his order?
I'm just worried that the corrupt blood might have clouded Mayor's judgement.
scripts.translation: 从！只是担心市长受到腐化血脉影响，判断出了差错。

scripts.text: Fine. Let's put it this way.
You seem to trust and follow Mayor Jun not caring about the sense of uneasiness among us.
scripts.translation: ：即使我们心存不安，你似乎依旧信任并追随君市长。

scripts.text: We pray that the modern Mayor will be like the wind that just passes by.
scripts.translation: 我们祈愿现任市长如风般平静地过去。

scripts.text: Once is enough of that kind of a strong wind.
scripts.translation: 那种狂风，有一次就够了。

scripts.text: I don't know why Mayor is so obsessed with the Orb but since he made that decision after talking to you, I'm sure you had great influence on him as well.
scripts.translation: 我不知道市长为何如此执着于宝珠。不过他是在和你谈过后才下令的，你肯定也对他产生了很大影响。

scripts.text: what happens to the Orb, the pride and origin of us Laphines.
scripts.translation: ，身为拉菲尼族骄傲与起源的宝珠会发生什么

scripts.text: Of course you should be there, too.
I hope you intervene actively in this matter.
scripts.translation: 希望你能积极介入此事。

scripts.text: Although we can't let any other races to be in charge of the Orb since it is very meaningful to us Laphines,
scripts.translation: 宝珠对我们拉菲尼族意义重大，不能交给其他种族负责，

scripts.text: shouldn't you wait and see whether Mayor, the one you trust so much, has made the right decision or not?
scripts.translation: 你不该亲眼看看自己如此信任的市长，究竟有没有做出正确决定吗？

scripts.text: If he's not right, it's a problem for me as well!
scripts.translation: 如果他做错了，我也脱不了干

scripts.text: I'm just keeping my eyes on him since you never know when he will reveal his personal ambitions just like Seneth did.
scripts.translation: 系！我只是在留意他，毕竟谁也不知道他会不会像塞内斯那样显露野

scripts.text: Who can be sure about his integrity? This could be a manipulative trick that looks fine only on the surface.
scripts.translation: 心。谁能保证他真心正直？这也可能只是表面好看的操纵伎俩。

scripts.text: However, the presence of Mayor itself is perfect and worthy of reverence.
scripts.translation: 不过，市长的身份本身完美而崇高，值得敬畏

scripts.text: Therefore, we have to stay vigilant while hoping that he would make the right decisions.
scripts.translation: 。所以我们只能保持警惕，同时盼着他做出正确决定。

scripts.text: So this is only for caution's sake.
There is only one thing I want.
I want you to be a witness and judge whether a series of actions taken around the Orb were truly for the sake of the Orb and Laphines or not.
scripts.translation: 我希望你作个见证人，判断围绕宝珠采取的一系列行动，是否真的是为了宝珠和拉菲尼族。

scripts.text: How much do you know about the Orb?
A crystal filled with concentrated magical powers, pride of all Laphines?
scripts.translation: 是蕴含浓缩魔力的水晶，也是所有拉菲尼族的骄傲。

scripts.text: I'm talking about something structural, noot those abstract concepts.
scripts.translation: 我说的是具体结构，不是抽象概念。

scripts.text: Have you ever looked up to see the ceiling of the plaza, which is decorated with the Orb?
scripts.translation: 你抬头看过广场的天花板吗？宝珠就装饰在那里。

scripts.text: Even if you have, you would have been blinded by the bright light.
scripts.translation: 有。就算看过，耀眼的光也会让你睁不开眼。

scripts.text: Why are you saying all this?
In the ceiling, there are light fixtures installed to bring out the brightness of the Orb even more.
scripts.translation: 你吗？天花板上装有照明设备，让宝珠显得更加明亮。

scripts.text: The Orb is always exposed in the plaza and since all Laphines have their eyes on it the guards who protect the Orb look down from the ceiling where the light fixtures are installed.
scripts.translation: 宝珠一直展现在广场上，所有拉菲尼族都看着它；守卫宝珠的卫兵则从装有照明设备的天花板上方俯视广场。

scripts.text: In other words, it is easy to harm the Orb once the ceiling is attacked and disabled.
scripts.translation: 换句话说，只要攻击天花板并使其失效，宝珠就很容易遭到破坏。

scripts.text: Do you want to go and take a look?
It should be fine if it's you.
Moreover, you are under obligation to judge whether the king has made the right decision or not.
scripts.translation: 问题。而且你有责任判断国王的决定是否正确。

scripts.text: I don't understand why you're telling me this important information.
scripts.translation: 我不明白你为什么把这么重要的事告诉我。

scripts.text: Give me some time to think about it.
You need some time to think about it?
I'm not usually this hospitable to a foreigner, but I see.
scripts.translation: 时可不会对外国人这么客气，不过也好。

scripts.text: When you held Shenime's hand, you felt a sharp pain in your hand.
scripts.translation: 你握住谢尼梅的手，掌心突然一阵刺痛

scripts.text: You took your hand off quickly and examined it, but nothing was there.
scripts.translation: 。你赶紧抽回手检查，却什么也没发现。

scripts.text: Now, this is the place you should watch carefully.
scripts.translation: 去吗？这里正是你该仔细观察的地方。

scripts.text: The place where the lighting for the Orb is installed in other words, the place where the guards stay is the ceiling.
scripts.translation: 宝珠照明设备所在的位置，也就是卫兵驻守的地方，在天花板上

scripts.text: It's a place that you pass by before going up to the palace.
scripts.translation: 。那是上宫殿前会经过的地方。

scripts.text: I heard you are helping out here and there nowadays.
scripts.translation: 听说你最近到处帮忙。一定

scripts.text: - You have too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续任务。 -

scripts.text: Is this how people feel when they lose blood?
The feeling of magical powers oozing out of my body...
scripts.translation: 魔力正从我体内流失...抱

scripts.text: Sorry. I'm a little bit tired.
He must be very tired from replacing the magical powers of the Orb.
scripts.translation: 着了。替换宝珠的魔力一定让他累坏了。

scripts.text: I'm not so happy about it, but Avant is in the process of making something that will replace the Orb's inner core.
scripts.translation: 虽然我不太情愿，但阿旺正在制作替代宝珠核心的东西。他要

scripts.text: If he suceeds, things will be the way they used to be, right?
scripts.translation: 是成功，一切就能恢复原状了吧？

scripts.text: Seriously...I can't believe I have to ask him a favor.
scripts.translation: 真是的...我竟然得向他求助。..

scripts.text: My head is cluttered with too many things.
scripts.translation: 我脑子里塞满了各种事。

scripts.text: The brains of Mayor is supposed to be filled with hundreds of thousands of drawers...
scripts.translation: 市长的脑海本该装着成千上万个抽屉...可现在连

scripts.text: But this is way beyond that.
Ah, I just want to whine. Where did my brother go...?
scripts.translation: 啊，我只是想发发牢骚。我哥哥去哪儿了.

scripts.text: If other Laphines see me like this, they'll probably be frightened.
scripts.translation: ..？其他拉菲尼族看到我这样，大概会吓一跳吧。

scripts.text: You see. I feel like either knowledges of a thousand years or memories of a ten thousand years is so useless.
scripts.translation: 哈——你看，千年的知识、万年的记忆，到头来好像全无用处。

scripts.text: I'm racking my brains searching through all the memories, informations, and history of every Mayor,
scripts.translation: 我绞尽脑汁翻遍历代市长的记忆、情报和历

scripts.text: but there's no such thing as ways of fighting against the king of demons.
scripts.translation: 史，却找不到对付魔王的方法。

scripts.text: I should probably leave this to an expert?
I don't know who you are, but could you wait until I call you?
scripts.translation: ..我不知道你是谁，不过能等我通知你再来

scripts.text: I'll have to meet you some day, but now is not the right time.
scripts.translation: 吗？总有一天我会见你，但现在还不是时候。

scripts.text: ... this was a popular way of greeting each other, but I guess it's not fun anymore.
scripts.translation: 生人。...这曾是很流行的问候语，不过现在好像没什么意思了。

scripts.text: Anyway, you who came from a long way away
There is a truth that you would like to tell me?
If that's the case, you will be very busy from now on.
scripts.translation: 如果真是这样，你接下来会很忙。

scripts.text: You have to do a lot of work in order to convince me, the elders, and many other Laphines.
scripts.translation: 为了让我、长老们和其他拉菲尼族相信你，你得做不少事。

scripts.text: Of couse I could trust everything you say,
scripts.translation: 我当然可以相信你说的话，但

scripts.text: but will other Laphines accept a Mayor Jun who is swayed by a word of a foreigner?
scripts.translation: 其他拉菲尼族会接受一个被外国人三言两语说动的市长吗？

scripts.text: Especially when that Mayor Jun is me. Ah...
scripts.translation: 尤其是这个市长就是我。唉...

scripts.text: Here, in Eclage, You have to get more recognition from Laphines.
scripts.translation: 在埃克拉珠，你得赢得更多拉菲尼族的认可。

scripts.text: Do I have to make a contribution?
You don't have to make a face.
No matter what I look like to you, I am the history and the spirit of Laphines, and also the protector of Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation: 不管你怎么看我，我都承载着拉菲尼族的历史与精神，也是世界树的守护者。

scripts.text: Do you think I, who inherited the will of Yggdrasil, don't know anything?
scripts.translation: 你觉得继承了世界树意志的我会什么都不知道吗？我

scripts.text: I don't blame you since it is ignorance.
scripts.translation: 不怪你，毕竟你不了解情况。

scripts.text: The war of Jotunheim will soon be over.
scripts.translation: 约顿海姆的战争很快就会

scripts.text: And it will happen not by constraint, but as a result of mutual agreement.
scripts.translation: 结束。不是靠强迫，而是靠双方达成共识。

scripts.text: don't worry about it and do you want to work with me for Eclage?
scripts.translation: 人，别担心。你愿意和我一起为埃克拉珠效力吗？

scripts.text: Then why do you make war and disregard the truth?
scripts.translation: 那你为什么发动战争、无视真相？

scripts.text: I'll tell you when we get closer to each other.
I'm not obligated to talk about this important subject with a person I just met.
scripts.translation: 会告诉你。我没义务向刚认识的人谈这么重要的事。

scripts.text: For now, I will tell the administrative ruler, the elders, and all the guards
scripts.translation: 眼下我会把你的事告诉行政官、长老和所有卫兵。

scripts.text: and you will enjoy all the rights in Eclage as a person who works for the king.
scripts.translation: 替国王效力的人，你在埃克拉珠可以享有一切权利。

scripts.text: It's a part of building relationships with me, the king of a race. You don't like it?
scripts.translation: 这是和我——一族之王——建立关系的一环。你不喜欢

scripts.text: If that's the case, I guess there's no friendship between the two of us.
scripts.translation: 吗？那看来我们之间也谈不上什么友情了。

scripts.text: What do you mean 'the two of us?'
Friends who share their secrets from now on?
scripts.translation: 嗯...从今往后互相分享秘密的朋友？

scripts.text: Anyway, I allow you to visit anytime.
However, if you don't meet my expectation, you won't get anything.

拉菲尼族人说的话真有

scripts.translation: 这里是处理公务的办公区。你

scripts.text: Professor has been under the weather nowadays.

The Laphine standing in front of you is tall and dark-skinned, and he has small wings.
scripts.translation: 站在你面前的拉菲尼族人身材高大、皮肤黝黑，背上长着一对小翅

scripts.translation: 膀。他似乎是上层拉菲尼族多娜和下层拉菲尼族帕潘格的混血。而

scripts.translation: 。我们是双胞胎，所以长得很像。

scripts.translation: 你是来把手里的那封信交给我的吧？

scripts.text: Maybe this is what he meant when he told me that I might have a guest over soon.
scripts.translation: 他大概是想给我个惊喜，才说很快会有客人来吧。我

scripts.translation: 他说要介绍一位朋友给我，我想那个人就是你。

scripts.text: It's a long story, but I think you should know.
scripts.translation: 说来话长，不过我觉得你应该知道

scripts.translation: 。除了介绍你之外，卡尔还在信里提到了另一件事。

He wants me to find Avant.
And he says you'll be a great help?

...and the father of me and Kar.

scripts.translation: 选你？如果是不想告诉别人的事，他直接告诉我就行了。

scripts.text: Anyway, I don't know Avant's whereabouts.
scripts.translation: 总之，我不知道阿旺在哪。我

scripts.translation: 不想知道他的下落，也想阻止卡尔去找他。不过他一定有自己的理由。

scripts.text: In reality, we're nothing more than materials for his experiments.
scripts.translation: 。实际上，我们不过是他的实验材料

scripts.text: We are just objects that were made in an effort to prove his hypothesis.
scripts.translation: ，是他为了验证假设而制造出来的实验品。

scripts.text: So, there can't be any relationship or love between us.

scripts.translation: 卡尔去找阿旺，或许是想除掉他。

scripts.translation: 你知道塞内斯吗？他是混血，却当上了市长。

scripts.text: Avant must have been interested about the fact that half-blood became Mayor.

scripts.text: So, he developed a couple of hypotheses and did experiments in order to prove them.
scripts.translation: 于是他提出了几个假设，并通过实验加以验证。

scripts.text: Kar is a piece of work that Avant created with thorough preparations,
scripts.translation: 卡尔是阿旺经过周密准备创造出来的作品，

scripts.text: while I am an accident that always happens in experiments.
scripts.translation: 而我则是实验中常见的意外。总之，卡尔

scripts.text: Anyway, Kar became the king but lost his whole life.
scripts.translation: 虽然成了国王，却赔上了整个人生。

scripts.text: However, his hatred for Avant hasn't changed a bit.
scripts.translation: 不过，他对阿旺的恨意丝毫未减。

scripts.text: But now, Kar is looking for Avant...?
scripts.translation: 但现在卡尔竟然在找阿旺...？

scripts.text: Maybe he changed his mind or he has a plan.
scripts.translation: 也许他改变了主意，或者另有计划。

scripts.text: After becoming Mayor, that crybaby has grown so much.
scripts.translation: 当上了市长以后，那个爱哭鬼真的长大了不少。

scripts.text: You must be kidding that he's a crybaby.
scripts.translation: 你说他是爱哭鬼，一定是在开玩笑

scripts.translation: 吧。我认识的卡尔杜伊自信又能干...

scripts.text: His personality has changed a lot ever since he became Mayor.
scripts.translation: 知道。他当上市长以后，性格变了很多。我

scripts.translation: 一直想亲眼看看他现在的样子。

scripts.text: What if you go and see him in person?
If I do, younger Laphines are going to be scared.
scripts.translation: 我要是去了，年轻的拉菲尼族人会害怕

scripts.text: I'm not Dona nor Papang. I don't belong anywhere.
scripts.translation: 的。我既不是多娜，也不是帕潘格

scripts.translation: ，哪里都不属于。弗洛伦斯曾经想创造一个混血族群。他

scripts.text: Anyway, we should look for Avant?
It's been decades since his stupid experiment was caught by the elders and he disappeared.
scripts.translation: 他那愚蠢的实验几十年前就被长老们发现，之后他便销声匿迹。我

scripts.text: I'm sure he's somewhere celebrating the success of his experiments.
scripts.translation: 敢肯定他正躲在某处，为实验成功而沾沾自喜。他

scripts.translation: 最好查清楚他是谁、来自哪里。

scripts.text: You can easily find Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves anywhere in this tower.

scripts.translation: 那个邪恶的家伙只顾着笑，什么也

How could I have forgotten about him?
I was too focused on Avant that I totally forgot about him.
scripts.translation: ？我光顾着阿旺的事，完全忘了他。

scripts.translation: 参谋长还不知道阿旺已经被关起来了。

scripts.text: If he's the one who was pulling wires from behind, he'll be worried by now...

scripts.translation: 这个忙。卡尔或我亲自出面都不太合适。

scripts.text: Especially, if Kar does so, other Laphines might misunderstand him.
scripts.translation: 尤其是卡尔亲自去的话，其他拉菲尼族人可能会误会

scripts.translation: 所以我希望你能帮帮他

scripts.translation: 查到什么就回卡尔那里。

scripts.text: I'm going to talk to Kar.
I've been spending more time at the palace thant here.
scripts.translation: 我最近待在宫殿里的时间比这里还

scripts.translation: 多。毕竟得输送魔力，替代宝珠的核心...

scripts.text: I'm so thankful to you for your help.
Once everything goes back to normal, I would like to talk to you some more.
scripts.translation: 等一切恢复正常，我还想和你多聊聊。

scripts.text: I'll tell you where the laboratory Yai is.
scripts.translation: 我告诉你实验室雅伊的位置。

scripts.text: If you follow this road and head east...

scripts.translation: 确认希西藏好后，你敲响雅伊的门。

scripts.translation: 敲了一会儿，你感觉到有人走近，随后门上打开一扇小窗，只露出一只眼睛。

I almost didn't recognize him because he changed his hair color. But the way he looks and talks is pretty much the same. Disgusting!
scripts.translation: 得肯定是他。他虽然换了发色，但模样和说话的方式都没变，差点没认出来。真恶心！

scripts.text: Did you pack Dustballs and bookmarks made of fallen leaves?

scripts.text: Otherwise, he'll be suspicious of you.
Let's get out of here before he notices us.
scripts.translation: 趁他还没发现我们，先离开这里。

scripts.text: We have to tell Kar about this first.
scripts.translation: 得先把这件事告诉卡尔。

scripts.text: Since it's Avant's Yai, there might be equipped with some devices.
scripts.translation: 既然是阿旺的雅伊，里面可能装了什么机关。

scripts.text: Anyway, let's wait and see if there's any chance.

scripts.text: Let's wait a little more. We should go inside once he's gone.

我感觉到一些魔法装置

scripts.text: The more I see it, I think this Yai is not the real deal.
scripts.translation: ...仔细一看，这座雅伊似乎不太寻

scripts.text: It's a Yai connecting to the scholar of magics' secret research lab.
